title.en: 1787: designing a federal republic
title.zh: 1787：设计联邦共和国

summary.en: The proposed United States Constitution assigned powers to a national legislature, an executive and a judiciary while preserving important roles for the states. Its institutional design attempted to make a union function across communities with conflicting interests. The document also embedded compromises protecting slavery, including rules for representation and the return of people held to service. Its language of popular government therefore coexisted with profound exclusions. Ratification, implementation and amendments subsequently changed how the system worked. Reading the original text alongside later struggles makes constitutional history a study of contested arrangements rather than a completed promise of equal freedom.
summary.zh: 美国宪法草案将权力分配给全国立法、行政与司法机关，同时保留州的重要职能，试图协调利益不同的社会。但文本也包含保护奴隶制的妥协，例如代表席位计算与逃亡被奴役者返还条款。因此，人民政府语言与深刻排斥并存。批准、实施与修正案继续改变制度。将原文与后来斗争对读，宪政史便是不断争议和改造的安排，而非已完成的平等自由承诺。

dateNote.en: The convention signed the proposed constitution on 17 September 1787; ratification and the new federal government followed in later years.
dateNote.zh: 制宪会议于1787年9月17日签署草案；批准和新联邦政府成立在随后年份。

sources.title: The Constitution of the United States: A Transcription
sources.evidenceNote: The convention signed the proposed constitution on 17 September 1787; ratification and the new federal government followed in later years.

title.en: 1788: a penal colony on Eora lands
title.zh: 1788：在原住民土地上建立流放殖民地

summary.en: The First Fleet established a British convict settlement at Sydney Cove, bringing imperial punishment and colonial expansion into the same project. The newcomers depended on supplies, unfamiliar farming and tightly controlled labor. They arrived in a landscape already governed and used by Aboriginal communities, including the Eora peoples of the Sydney region. Competition over land and food quickly produced violence and resistance. This event begins a history of British colonization in Australia, not the history of the continent itself. Reading it alongside much older Indigenous sites makes visible both the newcomers’ institutions and the societies whose lands they occupied.
summary.zh: 第一舰队在悉尼湾建立英国流放犯殖民地，把帝国刑罚与殖民扩张结合起来。新来者依赖补给、陌生环境中的农业与受严密控制的劳动。然而这里早已有原住民社会的治理和土地使用，包括悉尼地区的埃奥拉人。土地与食物竞争迅速引发暴力和抵抗。1788年开启英国殖民史，而非澳洲大陆历史；与更古老原住民遗址对读，才能同时看到殖民制度及被占土地上的社会。

dateNote.en: The settlement at Sydney Cove began on 26 January 1788; First Fleet arrivals at Botany Bay occurred earlier that month.
dateNote.zh: 悉尼湾殖民据点始于1788年1月26日；舰队同月稍早已抵达植物湾。

sources.title: The First Fleet arrives at Sydney Cove
sources.evidenceNote: The settlement at Sydney Cove began on 26 January 1788; First Fleet arrivals at Botany Bay occurred earlier that month.

title.en: France: revolution, citizenship and war
title.zh: 法国：革命、公民身份与战争

summary.en: The French Revolution dismantled the old monarchy and transformed arguments about sovereignty, citizenship and political legitimacy. Its course moved through competing constitutional experiments, republican government, execution of the king, the Terror and war with foreign powers. Participants disagreed sharply over who should exercise authority and how a revolution should defend itself. Events in France also reverberated across the Atlantic, provoking both enthusiasm and fear. Napoleon’s rise closed this conventional revolutionary decade without ending its consequences. The period demonstrates how demands for liberty could coexist with exclusion, coercion and struggles over the meaning of popular government.
summary.zh: 法国大革命推翻旧王朝，改变主权、公民身份与政治合法性的讨论。革命经历多种宪政尝试、共和建政、处决国王、恐怖统治和对外战争。参与者对谁应掌权、革命应如何自卫存在尖锐分歧。事件也震动大西洋两岸，引发支持与恐惧。拿破仑崛起结束通常所称的革命十年，却未终结其影响；自由诉求始终与排斥、强制及民治含义之争交织。

dateNote.en: 1789–1799 follows the conventional revolutionary decade; subsequent Napoleonic government and wars have their own chronology.
dateNote.zh: 1789—1799年采用通常所称的革命十年；后续拿破仑统治与战争另有分期。

sources.title: The United States and the French Revolution, 1789–1799
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of State, Office of the Historian
sources.evidenceNote: 1789–1799 follows the conventional revolutionary decade; subsequent Napoleonic government and wars have their own chronology.

title.en: Haiti: enslaved people make a revolution
title.zh: 海地：被奴役者发动革命

summary.en: An uprising of enslaved people in Saint-Domingue transformed a profitable French plantation colony into an independent state. The struggle intertwined abolition, civil rights, rival revolutionary projects and intervention by European powers. Toussaint Louverture emerged as a major leader, while Jean-Jacques Dessalines led the final break with France after renewed attempts to impose colonial control. The revolution challenged the contradiction between proclamations of liberty and economies built on slavery. Foreign governments’ reactions also exposed the interests behind their principles: the United States delayed recognition until 1862. Haitian independence was won through the decisions and sacrifices of people whom colonial society had denied political standing.
summary.zh: 圣多明各被奴役者的起义，将法国获利丰厚的种植园殖民地变成独立国家。废奴、公民权、不同革命方案与欧洲列强干预相互交织。杜桑·卢维杜尔成为重要领袖；法国再次试图恢复殖民控制后，德萨林领导最终决裂。革命揭露自由宣言与奴隶经济的矛盾，外国反应也显示原则背后的利益，美国直到1862年才承认海地。独立来自被殖民秩序剥夺政治地位者的行动与牺牲。

dateNote.en: 1791–1804 covers the main revolutionary struggle from the northern uprising to independence; diplomacy and conflict continued afterward.
dateNote.zh: 1791—1804年指从北部起义至独立的主要革命阶段，随后外交与冲突继续。

sources.title: The United States and the Haitian Revolution, 1791–1804
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of State, Office of the Historian
sources.evidenceNote: 1791–1804 covers the main revolutionary struggle from the northern uprising to independence; diplomacy and conflict continued afterward.

title.en: Mexico: insurgency, alliance and independence
title.zh: 墨西哥：起义、结盟与独立

summary.en: Miguel Hidalgo’s revolt opened a long struggle against Spanish rule, followed by insurgent campaigns and political projects associated with José María Morelos and others. Independence was eventually achieved through an alliance between former enemies, including Vicente Guerrero and the royalist officer Agustín de Iturbide. Their Plan of Iguala proposed a constitutional monarchy and brought together groups whose visions of the future were far from identical. Mexico’s initial independent government therefore emerged from both popular insurgency and conservative negotiation. The end of colonial rule did not settle the balance between central authority, provincial autonomy and social change.
summary.zh: 米格尔·伊达尔戈起义开启长期反西班牙统治斗争，莫雷洛斯等继续军事行动与政治建构。独立最终依靠昔日敌人结盟，包括格雷罗与保王军官伊图尔维德。《伊瓜拉计划》提出君主立宪，把未来愿景并不一致的群体联合起来。因此，新国家同时来自民众起义与保守协商。殖民统治结束后，中央权力、地方自治与社会变革之间的关系仍未解决。

dateNote.en: The revolt began in September 1810; the 1821 Plan of Iguala and Treaty of Córdoba accompanied the final break from Spanish government.
dateNote.zh: 起义始于1810年9月；1821年《伊瓜拉计划》和《科尔多瓦条约》伴随最终脱离西班牙政府。

sources.title: Independence from Spain to President Porfirio Díaz
sources.evidenceNote: The revolt began in September 1810; the 1821 Plan of Iguala and Treaty of Córdoba accompanied the final break from Spanish government.

title.en: South America: campaigns that broke Spanish rule
title.zh: 南美洲：结束西班牙统治的战争

summary.en: Independence movements developed through regional uprisings, shifting alliances and competing projects for government. Simón Bolívar’s northern campaigns and José de San Martín’s advance through Chile toward Peru connected struggles across the continent. The royalist stronghold in Peru made victory there strategically important; Antonio José de Sucre’s success at Ayacucho helped break its power. People joined royalist or independence forces for varied reasons, including local interests and conflicts over social hierarchy. Independence created new states but did not automatically produce one united political community. Decisions about monarchy, republicanism and regional autonomy continued to divide the victors.
summary.zh: 南美独立运动通过地方起义、变动联盟与竞争的建政方案发展。玻利瓦尔的北方战役与圣马丁经智利进军秘鲁，将大陆各地斗争连接起来。秘鲁是保王派核心，苏克雷在阿亚库乔的胜利帮助击破其力量。人们因地方利益和社会等级冲突等不同原因加入双方。独立产生新国家，却未自动形成统一政治共同体；君主制、共和制与地方自治继续使胜利者分裂。

dateNote.en: 1810–1825 is a selected interval from major juntas to the defeat of royalist power in Upper Peru; independence dates differed by country.
dateNote.zh: 1810—1825年选取主要自治委员会兴起至上秘鲁保王势力失败阶段，各国独立日期不同。

sources.title: Spanish South America: independence movements
sources.evidenceNote: 1810–1825 is a selected interval from major juntas to the defeat of royalist power in Upper Peru; independence dates differed by country.

title.en: Waterloo: a coalition defeats Napoleon
title.zh: 滑铁卢：联军击败拿破仑

summary.en: Napoleon’s return from exile reopened a European conflict that many governments believed had ended. At Waterloo his army faced Wellington’s multinational force, while the arrival of Blücher’s Prussians proved crucial to the coalition victory. The battle ended Napoleon’s renewed attempt to rule France and became a powerful subject of national memory. It is also a reminder that familiar stories centred on one famous commander can conceal the contributions of allies and ordinary soldiers. The battlefield belongs to a wider diplomatic and military struggle over Europe’s political order after years of revolutionary and imperial warfare.
summary.zh: 拿破仑流放归来，使欧洲冲突再次爆发。滑铁卢战场上，他面对威灵顿率领的多国军队，布吕歇尔的普鲁士军队到达对联军胜利至关重要。这场战役结束拿破仑重新统治法国的尝试，并成为国家记忆的重要主题。只围绕著名将领的叙述容易遮蔽盟军与普通士兵；战役也属于革命和帝国战争之后重建欧洲秩序的更广泛斗争。

dateNote.en: The battle took place on 18 June 1815; the pin represents the battlefield, not the extent of the coalition war.
dateNote.zh: 战役发生于1815年6月18日；标记代表战场，并非整个联军战争范围。

sources.title: The Battle of Waterloo
sources.evidenceNote: The battle took place on 18 June 1815; the pin represents the battlefield, not the extent of the coalition war.

title.en: Waitangi: an agreement with different meanings
title.zh: 怀唐伊：含义不同的条约

summary.en: Te Tiriti o Waitangi was negotiated between Māori rangatira and representatives of the British Crown amid expanding settlement. Most signatories signed the Māori text, whose language about governance and chiefly authority differed significantly from the English version’s statement about sovereignty. Some leaders signed after debate, while others refused or had no opportunity. These differences matter to understanding later conflict over land and authority; the treaty cannot be treated as an uncomplicated surrender of a single unified Māori sovereignty. Its texts and the promises surrounding them became central evidence in continuing arguments about the relationship between Māori and the Crown.
summary.zh: 欧洲移民扩张之际，毛利首领与英国王室代表协商《怀唐伊条约》。多数签署者签的是毛利文本，其中治理权与首领权威的表述，与英文“主权”存在重要差异。有些首领讨论后签署，另一些拒绝或没有机会。理解后来的土地与权力冲突，必须重视这些差异，不能把条约当成毛利人简单统一地交出主权。文本及相关承诺持续成为毛利人与王室关系争论的依据。

dateNote.en: First signed on 6 February 1840; signatures were collected elsewhere during the following months. The two language texts are not equivalent.
dateNote.zh: 首次签署于1840年2月6日，随后数月各地继续签署；两种语言文本并不等义。

title.en: The New Zealand Wars: land and sovereignty
title.zh: 新西兰战争：土地与主权

summary.en: British and colonial forces fought a series of conflicts with Māori communities over authority and the expansion of settlement. Māori defended land and political autonomy, but alliances did not divide neatly along ethnic lines: other Māori communities supported the Crown for their own reasons. Fighting moved between regions and took different forms rather than constituting one continuous campaign. Deaths and subsequent confiscations caused lasting damage to many communities. The wars show why colonial histories require attention to local decisions and competing claims, and why the signing of a treaty did not by itself settle questions of sovereignty.
summary.zh: 英国与殖民地军队因统治权和移民扩张，与毛利社会展开一系列战争。毛利人保卫土地与自治，但阵营并非完全按族群划分，另有毛利群体基于自身理由支持王室。战争发生于不同地区、形式各异，并非一场连续战役。伤亡和随后的土地没收对许多社区造成长久破坏。殖民史必须关注地方选择与不同权利主张，签署条约本身并未解决主权问题。

dateNote.en: 1845–1872 covers the main sequence conventionally grouped as the New Zealand Wars; coercion and resistance continued afterward.
dateNote.zh: 1845—1872年指通常归入新西兰战争的主要阶段；其后强制行动与抵抗仍在持续。

title.en: 1857: rebellion against Company rule
title.zh: 1857：反抗东印度公司统治

summary.en: Indian soldiers’ revolt spread into a wider challenge to East India Company authority, involving rulers and ordinary people with different grievances. Annexations, military conditions and fears about religious interference contributed to unrest. Delhi became a symbolic centre when rebels sought the support of the Mughal emperor, while Lucknow, Jhansi and other regions followed their own courses. Suppression brought severe violence, including indiscriminate reprisals. The British replaced Company government with Crown rule and reorganized the army. The rebellion was neither a uniform national campaign nor merely a barracks dispute: it joined distinct struggles within a crisis of colonial power.
summary.zh: 印度士兵反叛扩展为对东印度公司权力的更广挑战，统治者与普通人带着不同不满参与。吞并政策、军队待遇及宗教干预恐惧推动动荡。起义者争取莫卧儿皇帝支持，使德里成为象征中心；勒克瑙、占西等地各有发展。镇压伴随严酷暴力和无差别报复。英国以王室统治取代公司政府并改组军队。这既非完全统一的民族运动，也不仅是军营争端，而是多种斗争汇入殖民危机。

dateNote.en: The main uprising began at Meerut in May 1857; major centres fell in 1858, while resistance associated with Tantya Tope continued into 1859.
dateNote.zh: 主要起义始于1857年5月密拉特，核心据点1858年失守，坦蒂亚·托普等抵抗延至1859年。

title.en: The U.S. Civil War: union, slavery and emancipation
title.zh: 美国内战：联邦、奴隶制与解放

summary.en: Slavery and the political status of African Americans lay at the heart of the crisis that produced secession and civil war. The Union initially fought to preserve the country, while the Confederacy defended a political order founded on slavery. Emancipation became a central Union war aim, and African American service contributed directly to victory. The destruction of slavery was secured constitutionally in 1865, but ending legal bondage did not settle questions of citizenship, land or equal protection. The war changed the federal state and millions of lives, while leaving Reconstruction to confront the contested meaning of freedom.
summary.zh: 奴隶制与非裔美国人的政治地位，是分离危机和内战的核心。联邦起初为维护统一而战，邦联维护以奴隶制为基础的秩序。解放后来成为联邦核心目标，非裔参军也直接促成胜利。1865年宪法废除奴隶制，但结束法律上的奴役并未解决公民权、土地或平等保护。战争改变联邦国家与数百万人生，重建时期继续面对自由究竟意味着什么。

dateNote.en: 1861–1865 covers the war; the Thirteenth Amendment abolished slavery in 1865, while Reconstruction continued afterward.
dateNote.zh: 1861—1865年为战争时期；第十三修正案于1865年废除奴隶制，重建时期随后继续。

title.en: 1867: a Canadian federation begins
title.zh: 1867：加拿大联邦的开端

summary.en: The Province of Canada, New Brunswick and Nova Scotia joined in a federal union under British legislation. Dividing the Province of Canada into Ontario and Quebec gave the new federation four provinces, not the full territory shown on a modern Canadian map. Other provinces and territories entered through later processes with distinct circumstances. Confederation also did not immediately create complete independence from Britain; external autonomy and constitutional change developed over generations. The event is best understood as one institutional beginning within a longer history of expansion, negotiation and conflict over whose authority would govern northern North America.
summary.zh: 加拿大省、新不伦瑞克和新斯科舍依据英国法律组成联邦；加拿大省分为安大略与魁北克，因此最初只有四省，并非今日地图的全部疆域。其他省区经各自不同过程加入。联邦成立也未立即实现对英国的完全独立，外交自主与宪制变化历时多代。1867年是在更长的扩张、谈判与北美北部统治权冲突中，一个重要的制度起点。

dateNote.en: The federation began in 1867; the initial four provinces were Ontario, Quebec, Nova Scotia and New Brunswick. Later accessions must be dated separately.
dateNote.zh: 联邦始于1867年，最初四省为安大略、魁北克、新斯科舍与新不伦瑞克；后续加入另有年代。

sources.title: Provinces and territories: the Canadian federation
sources.evidenceNote: The federation began in 1867; the initial four provinces were Ontario, Quebec, Nova Scotia and New Brunswick. Later accessions must be dated separately.

title.en: 1875: Tonga defines a constitutional kingdom
title.zh: 1875：汤加建立宪制王国

summary.en: King George Tupou I’s constitution and the creation of a parliament helped define Tonga as a unified kingdom in an era of expanding foreign power. The arrangements combined existing chiefly relationships with selected constitutional ideas, including a Hawaiian model sent to the king. Parliament included government officials, nobles and elected representatives, and received powers over taxation and legislation. This was not modern equal participation: royal and chiefly authority remained central. Tonga’s choices show Pacific leaders adapting institutions to strengthen sovereignty, while also reshaping political relationships within their own society. Constitutional borrowing was an active political strategy.
summary.zh: 乔治·图普一世颁布宪法并建立议会，在外来势力扩张时代强化统一王国。制度结合原有酋长关系与选择吸收的宪政观念，其中包括送到国王手中的夏威夷宪法。议会由政府官员、贵族和民选代表组成，拥有税收与立法权限，但并非现代平等参与，王权与贵族权力仍居核心。汤加展现太平洋领导人主动改造制度、维护主权并重组内部关系的策略。

dateNote.en: The constitution was granted on 4 November 1875; parliament had opened in September to discuss the proposed settlement.
dateNote.zh: 宪法于1875年11月4日颁布；议会已于9月开会讨论拟议制度。

title.en: 1888: Brazil abolishes slavery
title.zh: 1888：巴西废除奴隶制

summary.en: The Lei Áurea ended legal slavery in Brazil after generations of resistance and a growing abolitionist movement. Earlier laws had restricted the slave trade or freed particular groups, but campaigners demanded complete abolition. Enslaved people also acted through the courts: archival cases document individuals pressing legal claims to freedom decades before the final law. The legislation signed by Princess Isabel was therefore one decisive moment in a much longer struggle, not freedom simply bestowed from above. Abolition ended a legal institution that had supported plantations, mines and other work, while leaving the social consequences of enslavement to be confronted afterward.
summary.zh: 《黄金法》在长期抵抗和废奴运动推动下终结巴西法律上的奴隶制。此前法律限制奴隶贸易或解放特定群体，但活动者要求彻底废除。被奴役者也通过法院争取自由，档案保留了最终立法数十年前的自由权诉讼。因此，伊莎贝尔公主签署法令是长期斗争的关键时刻，并非自由仅由上层恩赐。制度虽被废止，奴役造成的社会后果仍有待面对。

dateNote.en: Law 3,353 was signed on 13 May 1888. Earlier partial measures and freedom suits belong to the longer abolition process.
dateNote.zh: 第3353号法律于1888年5月13日签署；此前局部措施与自由诉讼属于更长期废奴过程。

title.en: New Zealand: women win the parliamentary vote
title.zh: 新西兰：女性取得国会选举投票权

summary.en: On 19 September 1893, a new Electoral Act gave women the right to vote in New Zealand parliamentary elections. The change followed years of campaigning and large petitions, including those organised by Kate Sheppard and other suffragists. It made New Zealand the first self-governing country to grant that parliamentary voting right to women. The event illustrates how organised participation can change electoral rules; it did not, by itself, complete the wider struggle for political equality.
summary.zh: 1893年9月19日，新的选举法赋予新西兰女性参加国会选举的投票权。此前，凯特·谢泼德等参政权倡导者进行了多年活动，并组织大规模请愿。新西兰由此成为首个赋予女性这一国会投票权的自治国家。这一事件展现了组织参与如何改变选举制度，但不表示更广泛的政治平等已经全部实现。

dateNote.en: Single-year event; law signed 19 September 1893. The marker indicates the legislative centre, not every place where campaigning occurred.
dateNote.zh: 单一年份事件：1893年9月19日签署法律。标记表示立法中心，并非所有运动发生地点。

title.en: Adwa: Ethiopia defeats an invading army
title.zh: 阿杜瓦：埃塞俄比亚击退入侵

summary.en: Ethiopian forces defeated the invading Italian army at Adwa in 1896. The victory challenged European assumptions that colonial conquest in Africa was inevitable and protected Ethiopia’s independence at a moment when much of the continent was being partitioned. Its later memory travelled well beyond Ethiopia and became important to anti-colonial political imagination. The battle did not remove every regional inequality or prevent later Italian aggression. It nevertheless offers a decisive example of African military and diplomatic agency. Studying the event alongside colonial expansion makes resistance part of the main historical narrative rather than an exception added at the end.
summary.zh: 1896年，埃塞俄比亚军队在阿杜瓦击败入侵的意大利军队。在非洲大部遭瓜分之际，这场胜利维护独立，也挑战殖民征服不可避免的观念。其记忆传播至埃塞俄比亚之外，影响反殖民政治想象。胜利并未消除所有地区不平等，也未阻止后来意大利再度侵略，但它鲜明体现非洲军事与外交主动性，使抵抗成为殖民史的核心部分。

dateNote.en: The battle occurred on 1 March 1896. The marker represents the Adwa battlefield region.
dateNote.zh: 战役发生于1896年3月1日；标记代表阿杜瓦战场区域。

sources.title: Ethiopia: three millennia of legend and history
sources.evidenceNote: The battle occurred on 1 March 1896. The marker represents the Adwa battlefield region.

title.en: Filipino independence meets a new colonial war
title.zh: 菲律宾独立遭遇新的殖民战争

summary.en: After Spain’s defeat in 1898, the United States claimed the Philippines through a treaty negotiated without accepting Filipino independence. Fighting broke out between American forces and Filipino nationalists led by Emilio Aguinaldo, who had sought self-government rather than a replacement colonial ruler. The war involved conventional fighting and guerrilla resistance, and civilian communities suffered violence, hunger and disease. U.S. military victory established another colonial administration, while resistance persisted beyond the conventional endpoint. The episode reveals how the language of liberation could accompany imperial expansion and how Filipino political aspirations remained central to the conflict.
summary.zh: 西班牙于1898年战败后，美国通过未承认菲律宾独立的条约主张统治权。美军与阿奎纳多领导的民族主义者交战，菲律宾人追求自治，而非更换殖民统治者。战争包括正规作战与游击抵抗，平民遭受暴力、饥饿和疾病。美国胜利带来另一殖民政府，抵抗却超出通常战争终点继续存在。这段历史揭示解放语言与帝国扩张可以并存，也强调菲律宾自身政治目标。

dateNote.en: 1899–1902 is the conventional war interval; fighting began on 4 February 1899, and armed resistance continued after the U.S. declared the war over.
dateNote.zh: 1899—1902年为常用分期，战斗始于1899年2月4日；美国宣布结束后，武装抵抗仍继续。

sources.title: The Philippine-American War, 1899–1902
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of State, Office of the Historian
sources.evidenceNote: 1899–1902 is the conventional war interval; fighting began on 4 February 1899, and armed resistance continued after the U.S. declared the war over.

title.en: 1901: six colonies form the Commonwealth
title.zh: 1901：六个殖民地组成澳大利亚联邦

location.label: Centennial Park, Sydney, inauguration reference point

summary.en: Six British colonies joined in the Commonwealth of Australia after years of negotiation, constitutional drafting and referendums. Federation addressed practical disputes over trade, transport and defence while creating a national parliament alongside state governments. The constitution drew on both British and American models. The new political community was nevertheless unequal: First Nations peoples faced exclusions embedded in the founding arrangements, and national unity did not mean shared access to political power. Federation is therefore both a milestone in institutional cooperation and an invitation to ask who participated in nation-building and whose authority and rights were disregarded.
summary.zh: 经历多年谈判、制宪和公投后，六个英国殖民地组成澳大利亚联邦。联邦解决贸易、交通与防务协调问题，在州政府之外建立全国议会，制度结合英国和美国模式。但新政治共同体并不平等，原住民面临建国安排中的排斥，全国统一也不意味着平等掌权。联邦既是制度合作的里程碑，也提出谁参与建国、谁的权威与权利被忽视的问题。

dateNote.en: The Commonwealth was inaugurated on 1 January 1901; later constitutional and citizenship changes are distinct developments.
dateNote.zh: 联邦于1901年1月1日成立；其后的宪制与公民权变化属于不同阶段。

sources.title: Federation
sources.evidenceNote: The Commonwealth was inaugurated on 1 January 1901; later constitutional and citizenship changes are distinct developments.

sources.title: Indigenous referendum
sources.evidenceNote: The Commonwealth was inaugurated on 1 January 1901; later constitutional and citizenship changes are distinct developments.

title.en: Mexico: revolution over power, land and labor
title.zh: 墨西哥：权力、土地与劳动的革命

summary.en: Opposition to Porfirio Díaz’s long rule developed into revolution, but removing him did not unite the country behind one program. Francisco Madero sought political change, while Emiliano Zapata demanded the return of land and other leaders mobilized different regional interests. Coups, assassinations and civil war followed. The Constitution of 1917 expressed ambitious commitments concerning labor, communal land and national control of subsoil resources, although implementing them took much longer. The revolution also drew in the United States and moved people across the border. Its history separates constitutional promises from the contested work of turning them into lived conditions.
summary.zh: 反对迪亚斯长期统治的力量发展为革命，但推翻他并未使全国接受同一纲领。马德罗追求政治改革，萨帕塔要求归还土地，其他领袖动员不同地方利益，随后出现政变、暗杀与内战。1917年宪法提出劳动权、社群土地和地下资源国家控制等目标，但落实历时更久。美国也卷入其中，人口跨境流动。革命史必须区分宪法承诺与把承诺变为现实的复杂斗争。

dateNote.en: 1910–1920 is a conventional revolutionary interval; the 1917 constitution did not end all fighting or complete social reform.
dateNote.zh: 1910—1920年为常用革命分期；1917年宪法并未结束全部战斗或完成社会改革。

sources.title: The Mexican Revolution and the United States: overview
sources.evidenceNote: 1910–1920 is a conventional revolutionary interval; the 1917 constitution did not end all fighting or complete social reform.

sources.title: The End of the Revolution and its Consequences
sources.evidenceNote: 1910–1920 is a conventional revolutionary interval; the 1917 constitution did not end all fighting or complete social reform.

title.en: 1911–1912: from empire to republic

summary.en: The Wuchang uprising opened a revolutionary crisis in which provinces withdrew their allegiance from the Qing court. Overseas Chinese networks, reform campaigns and military politics had helped create the conditions for change. Sun Yat-sen became provisional president, and negotiations with Yuan Shikai accompanied the emperor’s abdication. Ending the dynasty did not immediately create a stable unified republic. The new political order faced regional military power and disagreements about reform. This turning point is best read as the beginning of a prolonged struggle over citizenship, government and national authority rather than a single completed transition.
summary.zh: 武昌起义引发革命危机，各省陆续脱离清廷。海外华人网络、改革运动和军队政治共同构成变化背景。孙中山出任临时大总统，与袁世凯的协商伴随皇帝退位。王朝结束并未立即带来稳定统一的共和国，地方军事势力与改革分歧仍然存在。这是关于公民身份、政府制度和国家权威的长期斗争的重要转折。

dateNote.en: October 1911 uprising through February 1912 abdication; the pin marks Wuchang, not every revolutionary centre.
dateNote.zh: 从1911年10月起义至1912年2月退位；武昌仅代表其中一处革命中心。

sources.title: The Chinese Revolution of 1911
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of State, Office of the Historian
sources.evidenceNote: October 1911 uprising through February 1912 abdication; the pin marks Wuchang, not every revolutionary centre.

title.en: The First World War: an imperial and global conflict
title.zh: 第一次世界大战：帝国与全球冲突

summary.en: The First World War drew soldiers, workers and resources from many continents into a conflict between rival alliances. Industrial warfare transformed killing on land, at sea and in the air, while governments mobilized civilian economies and imperial populations. Fighting extended well beyond the western European trenches, including Africa and the Middle East. Russia’s revolutions changed the alliance system before the war ended. The aftermath weakened or destroyed several empires and created new disputes over borders and national claims. Sarajevo marks the crisis that helped trigger war, while the entry’s global scope exceeds any single battlefield.
summary.zh: 第一次世界大战把多洲士兵、劳工和资源卷入敌对联盟之间的冲突。工业化战争改变陆海空杀伤方式，政府动员民间经济与殖民地人口。战斗远超西欧战壕，也遍及非洲和中东。俄国革命在战争结束前改变联盟格局。战后多个帝国衰弱或瓦解，新边界与民族诉求又引发争端。萨拉热窝仅标记引发战争危机的地点，并非全球战争的全部空间。

dateNote.en: 1914–1918 covers the main war; armistices did not immediately end violence or settle all postwar borders.
dateNote.zh: 1914—1918年指主要战争；停战并未立即终结暴力或确定所有战后边界。

sources.title: First World War
sources.evidenceNote: 1914–1918 covers the main war; armistices did not immediately end violence or settle all postwar borders.

title.en: 1917: two revolutions in Russia
title.zh: 1917：俄国的两场革命

summary.en: War, shortages and political discontent helped bring down the Russian monarchy. A provisional government attempted to govern while continuing the war, but it faced competition from workers’ and soldiers’ councils and other political movements. Later in the year the Bolsheviks seized power, opening another phase of revolutionary transformation and civil conflict. These were distinct upheavals with different participants and goals. The overthrow of the tsar did not automatically establish a stable democratic system, nor was Bolshevik victory inevitable from the outset. Petrograd was a central arena, but the revolution affected the empire’s many peoples in different ways.
summary.zh: 战争、物资短缺与政治不满共同促使俄国君主制垮台。临时政府继续参战，同时面对工兵苏维埃和其他政治力量的竞争。年内布尔什维克夺取政权，开启新的革命改造与内战阶段。两次变动的参与者和目标并不相同；推翻沙皇没有自动建立稳定民主，布尔什维克胜利也非最初注定。彼得格勒是核心舞台，帝国各民族的经历却各不相同。

dateNote.en: The February and October Revolutions are named using Russia’s then Julian calendar; they occurred in March and November in the Gregorian calendar.
dateNote.zh: “二月”和“十月”革命沿用当时俄国儒略历名称，公历分别在3月与11月。

sources.title: The Russian Revolution (1917)
sources.evidenceNote: The February and October Revolutions are named using Russia’s then Julian calendar; they occurred in March and November in the Gregorian calendar.

title.en: Samoa: the Mau and the path to independence
title.zh: 萨摩亚：马乌运动与独立之路

summary.en: The Mau movement organized resistance to New Zealand’s administration through public meetings, newspapers and widespread noncooperation. Samoans refused taxes and official institutions while asserting their right to govern their own affairs. Colonial repression did not extinguish these demands. Recognition of the Mau as a legitimate political organization in 1936 was an important change, but self-government emerged slowly. After the Second World War, international decolonization and United Nations pressure joined Samoan political efforts in the path toward independence. The history restores Pacific Islanders as political organizers whose decisions shaped the end of colonial rule.
summary.zh: 马乌运动通过集会、报纸和广泛不合作反抗新西兰管治。萨摩亚人拒缴税款、抵制官方机构，主张自己治理事务。殖民镇压没有消除这些诉求。1936年马乌获承认为合法政治组织，但自治进展仍缓慢。二战后，全球去殖民化与联合国压力同萨摩亚人的政治努力共同推动独立。这段历史呈现太平洋岛民作为组织者与决策者的主体地位。

dateNote.en: 1926 marks organizing meetings that preceded the Mau’s formal organization in 1927; Western Samoa became independent on 1 January 1962.
dateNote.zh: 1926年指马乌正式成立前的组织集会，1927年形成组织；西萨摩亚于1962年1月1日独立。

sources.title: The rise of the Mau movement
sources.publisher: Manatū Taonga — Ministry for Culture and Heritage

sources.title: Towards independence
sources.publisher: Manatū Taonga — Ministry for Culture and Heritage

title.en: 1930: salt becomes a challenge to empire
title.zh: 1930：食盐成为挑战帝国的行动

summary.en: Gandhi’s march to the coast turned a tax on an everyday necessity into a public challenge to British colonial authority. Making salt without permission dramatized the argument that an unjust law could be resisted through disciplined civil disobedience. Meetings, newspapers and participation along the route extended the action’s audience far beyond the original marchers. The broader campaign included boycotts and further demonstrations, facing arrests and police violence. It did not immediately deliver independence, but it changed political participation and international attention. The episode illustrates the work of organization behind a memorable symbolic act.
summary.zh: 甘地向海岸进发，把日常必需品的税收转变为对英国殖民权威的公开挑战。未经许可取盐，以行动表达对不公法律进行有纪律公民不服从的主张。沿途集会、报刊与参与者，使影响远超最初队伍。更广运动包含抵制与后续示威，并遭逮捕和警察暴力。它未立即带来独立，却改变政治参与和国际关注，显示著名象征行动背后持续组织的重要性。

dateNote.en: The march began on 12 March 1930 and culminated in breaking the salt law at Dandi in April; the wider civil-disobedience campaign continued.
dateNote.zh: 长征始于1930年3月12日，4月在丹地以违反盐法达到高潮；更广公民不服从运动随后继续。

sources.title: Salt Satyagraha and Dandi March
sources.publisher: Bombay Sarvodaya Mandal / Gandhi Research Foundation
sources.evidenceNote: The march began on 12 March 1930 and culminated in breaking the salt law at Dandi in April; the wider civil-disobedience campaign continued.

sources.title: The Indian Independence Struggle (1930–1931)
sources.publisher: International Center on Nonviolent Conflict, research by Lester Kurtz

title.en: The Holocaust: persecution and genocide
title.zh: 大屠杀：迫害与种族灭绝

location.label: Berlin, centre of Nazi state power

summary.en: The Holocaust was the systematic persecution and murder of six million European Jews by Nazi Germany and its allies and collaborators. Antisemitism shaped the regime from its rise to power, and exclusion and dispossession escalated into mass murder during the war. Jews resisted, sought escape and struggled to survive under increasingly lethal conditions. Nazi authorities also persecuted and killed other groups, whose experiences require attention without erasing the specifically anti-Jewish genocide. The history connects ideology with institutions, occupation, participation and choices. Berlin represents state power; victims’ communities, ghettos, killing sites and survival routes extended across Europe.
summary.zh: 纳粹德国及其盟友和合作者系统迫害并杀害六百万欧洲犹太人。反犹主义从政权建立之初便居核心地位，排斥与掠夺在战争中升级为大规模屠杀。犹太人在日益致命的环境中抵抗、逃亡并努力求生。纳粹也迫害和杀害其他群体，应关注各自经历，同时保留反犹种族灭绝的特定性质。柏林代表国家权力，受害社区、隔都、杀戮地点与求生路线则遍布欧洲。

dateNote.en: 1933–1945 follows the museum’s Holocaust chronology; systematic mass killing intensified during World War II.
dateNote.zh: 1933—1945年采用美国大屠杀纪念馆分期；系统性大规模杀戮在二战期间加剧。

sources.title: Introduction to the Holocaust
sources.evidenceNote: 1933–1945 follows the museum’s Holocaust chronology; systematic mass killing intensified during World War II.

title.en: The Second World War: conquest and global resistance
title.zh: 第二次世界大战：征服与全球抵抗

summary.en: Nazi Germany’s invasion of Poland began the European war, while Japan had already expanded its war in China. The conflict joined campaigns across Europe, Africa, Asia and the Pacific. Occupation brought mass displacement, forced labor and atrocities; Nazi conquest also created conditions for the escalating genocide of Europe’s Jews. Allied victory depended on many societies and fronts, including enormous Soviet and Chinese sacrifices. Germany surrendered in May 1945, and Japan’s formal surrender followed in September. The war destroyed lives and cities on an immense scale and reshaped the political conditions from which the postwar world emerged.
summary.zh: 纳粹德国入侵波兰开启欧洲战争，日本此前已在中国扩大战争。欧洲、非洲、亚洲与太平洋战事相互连接。占领带来大规模流离失所、强迫劳动与暴行，纳粹征服也推动针对欧洲犹太人的种族灭绝升级。盟军胜利依赖多个社会与战场，包括苏联和中国的巨大牺牲。德国于1945年5月投降，日本于9月正式投降；战争摧毁无数生命与城市，重塑战后世界。

dateNote.en: 1939–1945 is the conventional global-war interval anchored in Europe; Japan’s full-scale war in China began in 1937, with aggression in Manchuria in 1931.
dateNote.zh: 1939—1945年采用以欧洲开战为起点的常用分期；日本于1937年全面侵华，1931年已侵占中国东北。

sources.title: World War II: In Depth
sources.evidenceNote: 1939–1945 is the conventional global-war interval anchored in Europe; Japan’s full-scale war in China began in 1937, with aggression in Manchuria in 1931.

title.en: Indonesia: proclamation, revolution and diplomacy
title.zh: 印度尼西亚：宣言、革命与外交

summary.en: Indonesian nationalists proclaimed independence as Japanese wartime control collapsed. Dutch efforts to restore colonial authority then produced years of armed struggle and negotiation. The republic’s supporters worked through military resistance, political organization and international diplomacy, while foreign governments and the United Nations became involved. An agreement in 1949 led to the transfer of sovereignty to a federal Indonesian state. Independence was thus both a declaration and a process whose institutional form continued to change. Jakarta marks the proclamation’s political centre; the varied experiences of people across the archipelago cannot be reduced to one city or one ceremony.
summary.zh: 日本战时控制崩溃之际，印尼民族主义者宣布独立，荷兰试图恢复殖民统治，引发多年武装斗争与谈判。共和国支持者结合军事抵抗、政治组织及国际外交，外国政府与联合国也介入。1949年协议促成向联邦形式的印尼国家移交主权。独立既是宣言，也是制度继续变化的过程；雅加达标记政治中心，群岛各地经历无法压缩为一座城市或一次仪式。

dateNote.en: Independence was proclaimed on 17 August 1945; the negotiated transfer of sovereignty occurred on 27 December 1949.
dateNote.zh: 1945年8月17日宣布独立；经谈判达成的主权移交发生于1949年12月27日。

sources.title: Indonesian independence
sources.evidenceNote: Independence was proclaimed on 17 August 1945; the negotiated transfer of sovereignty occurred on 27 December 1949.

title.en: San Francisco: signing the UN Charter
title.zh: 旧金山：签署《联合国宪章》

summary.en: Delegates met in San Francisco to prepare the founding Charter of the United Nations. The Charter was signed on 26 June 1945 and entered into force on 24 October that year. Its creation offers a specific place and date for studying an institution with a global reach. The map marker identifies the signing city; the organisation’s later activity and the decisions of its members cannot be reduced to that one location or founding moment.
summary.zh: 代表们在旧金山筹备联合国的创立文件。《联合国宪章》于1945年6月26日签署，同年10月24日生效。这为研究一个全球性机构提供了具体地点与时间。地图标记表示签署城市，而该机构后来的活动以及成员国的决策，不能被缩减为这一地点或创立时刻。

dateNote.en: Single-year event: signature on 26 June and entry into force on 24 October 1945.
dateNote.zh: 单一年份事件：1945年6月26日签署，10月24日生效。

sources.title: Charter of the United Nations: treaty record
sources.evidenceNote: Official treaty record identifies San Francisco, 26 June 1945 and entry into force on 24 October 1945.

sources.title: Charter of the United Nations research guide
sources.evidenceNote: Guide identifies San Francisco conference, 25 April–26 June 1945, as the meeting to draft the Charter.

title.en: 1947: independence and Partition
title.zh: 1947年：独立与印巴分治

location.label: New Delhi; one representative centre of a subcontinental event

summary.en: In August 1947, British rule ended and India and Pakistan became independent states. Independence was accompanied by Partition, population movement and communal violence. The event therefore contains several connected histories: political self-government, the drawing of borders, and the experiences of families forced to move. New Delhi is only a representative marker here. The effects crossed many regions, including places now in India, Pakistan and Bangladesh, and cannot be represented by a single point.
summary.zh: 1947年8月，英国统治结束，印度和巴基斯坦成为独立国家。独立伴随着分治、人口迁移和族群暴力。因此，这一事件同时包含政治自主、边界划分以及被迫离家者的经历。新德里在此只是代表性标记；影响遍及多个地区，包括今天的印度、巴基斯坦和孟加拉国，无法由一个点完整表示。

dateNote.en: Single-year event; independence and Partition in August 1947. No present-day boundary is projected backward as a historical map.
dateNote.zh: 单一年份事件：1947年8月的独立与分治。不把今日边界倒置为当时的历史地图。

sources.title: Independence and Partition, 1947
sources.evidenceNote: Museum account describes independence, August 1947 partition, mass migration, violence and geographically separated Pakistan.

title.en: 1949: a new government in Beijing
title.zh: 1949：北京宣布成立新政府

summary.en: Mao Zedong proclaimed the People’s Republic of China in Beijing after Communist victories in the civil war. The Nationalist government retreated to Taiwan, and the political division continued beyond the proclamation. Years of war, mobilization and competing programs of social change shaped the outcome. International recognition and alliances became part of the emerging Cold War. This entry marks a change of government and political order, not the beginning of Chinese society or a resolution of every territorial question. Comparing it with 1911 highlights how ending one regime and consolidating another can be separate historical processes.
summary.zh: 毛泽东在共产党取得内战优势后，于北京宣布中华人民共和国成立。国民党政府退至台湾，政治分裂并未随宣告而结束。长期战争、社会动员及不同社会改革方案共同塑造结果，国际承认与联盟也卷入冷战。本条目记录政权和政治秩序的转折，不将其视为中国社会的起点，也不暗示所有领土问题已获解决。

dateNote.en: The event year is 1949; the proclamation occurred on 1 October. The civil war and cross-strait division cannot be reduced to this single date.
dateNote.zh: 事件年份为1949年，宣告日期为10月1日；内战及海峡两岸分治不能压缩为单一日期。

sources.title: The Chinese Revolution of 1949
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of State, Office of the Historian
sources.evidenceNote: The event year is 1949; the proclamation occurred on 1 October. The civil war and cross-strait division cannot be reduced to this single date.

title.en: Coal, steel and the beginnings of European integration
title.zh: 煤钢合作与欧洲一体化的开端

summary.en: Six western European countries pursued integration by placing coal and steel within a shared institutional framework. These industries were central to both reconstruction and the capacity to wage war. The initiative developed into wider economic cooperation through the Treaties of Rome, which established the European Economic Community and Euratom. It was a gradual project built through treaties and institutions, not the immediate creation of today’s European Union. Its membership also represented only part of a continent divided by the Cold War. The episode shows how governments used economic coordination to pursue political stability while retaining national interests.
summary.zh: 六个西欧国家将煤钢产业纳入共同制度，以推动一体化。这些行业既关系战后重建，也关系战争能力。随后《罗马条约》建立欧洲经济共同体与欧洲原子能共同体，扩大经济合作。这是通过条约和机构逐步形成的过程，并非当代欧盟立即出现。成员也只占冷战分裂大陆的一部分；各国在保留自身利益的同时，以经济协调追求政治稳定。

dateNote.en: The coal and steel treaty was signed in 1951 and entered into force in 1952; the 1957 Rome treaties took effect in 1958.
dateNote.zh: 煤钢条约于1951年签署、1952年生效；1957年《罗马条约》于1958年生效。

sources.title: History of the European Union 1945–59
sources.evidenceNote: The coal and steel treaty was signed in 1951 and entered into force in 1952; the 1957 Rome treaties took effect in 1958.

title.en: Algeria: a long war for independence
title.zh: 阿尔及利亚：漫长的独立战争

summary.en: The Algerian independence struggle challenged French colonial rule through armed conflict, political organization and international diplomacy. The war affected civilians deeply and reshaped politics in both Algeria and France. Negotiations and a referendum led to independence in 1962, but liberation did not settle all disputes about the future state. The case shows why decolonization should be studied as a process involving competing groups, violence and institution-building rather than a simple transfer ceremony. Diplomatic records also require critical reading: they preserve what foreign officials believed and sought to influence, not a neutral account of every Algerian experience.
summary.zh: 阿尔及利亚通过武装冲突、政治组织与国际外交反抗法国殖民统治。战争深刻影响平民，也改变阿法两国政治。协商和公投带来1962年独立，但解放并未解决未来国家的全部分歧。去殖民化不是简单交接仪式，而涉及不同群体、暴力与制度建设。外交档案也需批判阅读：它们记录外国官员的认识与目标，并非所有阿尔及利亚人的中立经历。

dateNote.en: 1954–1962 covers the independence war; France recognized independence on 3 July, and Algeria commemorates it on 5 July.
dateNote.zh: 1954—1962年指独立战争；法国于7月3日承认独立，阿尔及利亚以7月5日纪念。

sources.title: Algeria — Countries
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of State, Office of the Historian
sources.evidenceNote: 1954–1962 covers the independence war; France recognized independence on 3 July, and Algeria commemorates it on 5 July.

sources.title: Foreign Relations of the United States, 1969–1976, Volume E–5, Part 2, Document 27
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of State, Office of the Historian
sources.evidenceNote: 1954–1962 covers the independence war; France recognized independence on 3 July, and Algeria commemorates it on 5 July.

title.en: 1954: Điện Biên Phủ and the end of French colonial war
title.zh: 1954：奠边府与法国殖民战争的终结

summary.en: The fall of the French garrison at Điện Biên Phủ dealt a decisive blow to France’s attempt to retain control in Indochina. Viet Minh military success intersected with negotiations about the region’s future and the growing involvement of Cold War powers. The United States had supported France but was unwilling to undertake the proposed intervention that might have rescued the garrison. French withdrawal did not bring a durable peace to Vietnam; division and further foreign involvement followed. The battle is therefore a turning point in decolonization and also a link between one colonial war and the conflicts that came afterward.
summary.zh: 奠边府法国驻军陷落，沉重打击法国维持印度支那统治的企图。越盟军事胜利与地区未来谈判、冷战强权介入相互交织。美国支持法国，却没有实施可能援救驻军的直接干预。法国退出并未给越南带来持久和平，分裂和进一步外国介入随后发生。奠边府既是去殖民化转折，也连接殖民战争与后续冲突。

dateNote.en: The French garrison fell on 7 May 1954; the later Geneva settlement and subsequent Vietnam wars are distinct stages.
dateNote.zh: 法国驻军于1954年5月7日陷落；随后的日内瓦安排及后续越南战争属于不同阶段。

sources.title: Dien Bien Phu and the Fall of French Indochina, 1954
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of State, Office of the Historian
sources.evidenceNote: The French garrison fell on 7 May 1954; the later Geneva settlement and subsequent Vietnam wars are distinct stages.

title.en: Civil rights: organizing against racial exclusion
title.zh: 民权运动：组织起来反对种族排斥

summary.en: African American communities and their allies challenged segregation through litigation, boycotts, marches, freedom rides and civil disobedience. National attention grew as journalists documented both protest and violent resistance to change. Court decisions and legislation, including Brown v. Board of Education, the Civil Rights Act and the Voting Rights Act, dismantled important legal structures of exclusion. These outcomes depended on sustained organizing, not only speeches by famous leaders. The movement also inspired other struggles for equality. Its achievements altered law and public life, while activists continued to confront discrimination that legal reform alone could not remove.
summary.zh: 非裔美国人及盟友通过诉讼、抵制、游行、自由乘车和公民不服从挑战隔离制度。媒体记录抗争及阻挠改革的暴力，推动全国关注。布朗案判决、民权法和投票权法拆除重要的法律排斥结构。这些成果依赖持续组织，而不只是著名领袖的演讲，也启发其他平等运动。法律与公共生活虽被改变，单靠立法无法消除的歧视仍需要继续斗争。

dateNote.en: 1954–1965 is a selected milestone interval from Brown to the Voting Rights Act; organizing began earlier and continued afterward.
dateNote.zh: 1954—1965年选取从布朗案至投票权法的里程碑阶段；组织活动更早开始，此后也继续。

sources.title: The Civil Rights Era
sources.evidenceNote: 1954–1965 is a selected milestone interval from Brown to the Voting Rights Act; organizing began earlier and continued afterward.

title.en: Bandung: Asian–African cooperation
title.zh: 万隆：亚非合作

summary.en: Twenty-nine Asian and African countries took part in the Bandung Conference from 18 to 24 April 1955. The gathering discussed peace, cooperation and freedom from colonialism and imperialism. Its records include documents, photographs and films preserved as the Asian–African Conference Archives. Bandung gives learners a way to examine international history from an Asian and African meeting place, rather than treating world diplomacy as something that happened only in European or North American capitals.
summary.zh: 1955年4月18日至24日，29个亚非国家参加万隆会议，讨论和平、合作以及摆脱殖民主义和帝国主义等议题。会议留下的文件、照片与影片组成亚非会议档案。万隆使我们能够从亚非国家的会场观察国际历史，而不是只围绕欧洲或北美的首都理解世界外交。

dateNote.en: Single-year event; 18–24 April 1955. The countries represented had different political systems and circumstances.
dateNote.zh: 单一年份事件：1955年4月18—24日；与会国家的政治制度和处境并不相同。

sources.title: Asian-African Conference Archives
sources.evidenceNote: UNESCO’s archive description gives conference dates, Bandung, 29 participating countries and stated aims.

title.en: Ghana: independence and African diplomacy
title.zh: 加纳：独立与非洲外交

summary.en: Ghana became independent on 6 March 1957. Its new foreign ministry and diplomatic service were part of the institutions needed to conduct relations with other states. Kwame Nkrumah connected foreign policy with a vision of African unity, and an African Affairs Secretariat became one expression of that aim. The entry focuses on independence and institution-building; it should not be used to claim that Ghana was the first independent African country.
summary.zh: 加纳于1957年3月6日独立。新的外交部和外交机构，是开展国家间关系所需制度的一部分。夸梅·恩克鲁玛把外交政策与非洲团结的愿景联系起来，非洲事务秘书处体现了这一方向。本条目聚焦独立与机构建设，并不宣称加纳是非洲第一个独立国家。

dateNote.en: Single-year independence milestone: 6 March 1957; subsequent diplomatic institutions developed over time.
dateNote.zh: 独立里程碑为1957年3月6日；后续外交机构是在不同时间逐步发展的。

sources.title: Brief history of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
sources.evidenceNote: Ministry history gives 6 March 1957 independence, ministry formation, Nkrumah’s African-unity emphasis and the African Affairs Secretariat.

title.en: 1959: Batista falls in Cuba
title.zh: 1959：古巴巴蒂斯塔政权垮台

summary.en: Fulgencio Batista fled Cuba as his government’s position deteriorated and Fidel Castro’s revolutionary forces gained military victories. A provisional government headed by Manuel Urrutia was announced, opening a period in which Cuba’s political future was still contested. A contemporary United States memorandum recommended recognizing that government and expected friendly relations, a revealing contrast with the antagonism that developed later. Reading the document at its own moment helps avoid treating subsequent Cold War alignments as predetermined. The overthrow created an opportunity for profound change, while questions about leadership, political participation and relations with foreign powers remained unsettled.
summary.zh: 巴蒂斯塔政府局势恶化、卡斯特罗领导的革命军取得军事胜利后，巴蒂斯塔逃离古巴。乌鲁蒂亚领导的临时政府成立，国家未来仍充满争议。当时一份美国备忘录建议承认新政府，并预期友好关系，这与后来敌对形成鲜明差异。把档案放回当时情境，可避免把后续冷战阵营视为注定。旧政权垮台提供深刻变革机会，但领导权、政治参与和对外关系仍未确定。

dateNote.en: Batista fled on 1 January 1959; this entry focuses on the revolutionary victory, not the full history of Castro’s later government.
dateNote.zh: 巴蒂斯塔于1959年1月1日出逃；本条目聚焦革命获胜，并非卡斯特罗后来全部统治史。

sources.title: Memorandum recommending recognition of Cuba’s provisional government, January 1959
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of State, Foreign Relations of the United States
sources.evidenceNote: Batista fled on 1 January 1959; this entry focuses on the revolutionary victory, not the full history of Castro’s later government.

title.en: Congo: independence amid international pressure
title.zh: 刚果：国际压力下的独立

summary.en: Congo gained independence from Belgium in June 1960, but an army mutiny, foreign intervention and provincial secession quickly created a national crisis. Patrice Lumumba, Joseph Kasavubu and other Congolese actors pursued competing political aims, while Belgium, the United Nations and Cold War powers intervened. Lumumba’s murder and Mobutu’s eventual seizure of power marked the severity of the struggle. This history connects colonial institutions with the pressures facing a newly independent state. It also warns against describing African politics only as a superpower contest: Congolese choices and conflicts remained central even when external powers constrained them.
summary.zh: 刚果于1960年6月脱离比利时独立，随后军队哗变、外国干预和省份分离迅速造成危机。卢蒙巴、卡萨武布等刚果政治人物追求不同目标，比利时、联合国及冷战强权也卷入其中。卢蒙巴遇害与蒙博托最终夺权显示斗争的严酷。殖民制度遗产与新国家压力紧密相连；同时，刚果政治不能只写成超级大国博弈，本地选择与冲突同样重要。

dateNote.en: 30 June 1960 independence through Mobutu’s November 1965 coup defines this selected crisis interval.
dateNote.zh: 本条目从1960年6月30日独立延至1965年11月蒙博托政变。

sources.title: The Congo, Decolonization, and the Cold War, 1960–1965
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of State, Office of the Historian
sources.evidenceNote: 30 June 1960 independence through Mobutu’s November 1965 coup defines this selected crisis interval.

title.en: 1963: organizing African unity
title.zh: 1963：组织非洲团结

summary.en: Thirty-two independent African states met in Addis Ababa and established the Organization of African Unity. The new organization expressed Pan-African aspirations and a shared commitment to ending colonial rule, while also bringing together governments with different political systems and priorities. Its formation shows that newly independent countries were building continental institutions, not merely choosing sides in the Cold War. Cooperation had to address tensions between collective action and national sovereignty. The OAU later gave way to the African Union, but this founding moment remains a useful starting point for tracing African-led diplomatic agendas.
summary.zh: 三十二个独立非洲国家在亚的斯亚贝巴建立非洲统一组织，表达泛非主义愿望与结束殖民统治的共同目标，同时汇聚制度和重点不同的政府。这说明新独立国家在建设洲际机构，并非只是选择冷战阵营。合作需要处理集体行动与国家主权之间的张力。非统后来被非盟取代，但1963年的成立仍是理解非洲主导外交议程的重要起点。

dateNote.en: The OAU was founded on 25 May 1963; this event entry does not treat all later African Union history as occurring in that year.
dateNote.zh: 非统于1963年5月25日成立；此事件不将后来非盟历史压缩到该年。

sources.title: The Pan-Africanist Movement and the road to liberation
sources.evidenceNote: The OAU was founded on 25 May 1963; this event entry does not treat all later African Union history as occurring in that year.

title.en: 1967: Indigenous campaigning changes the constitution
title.zh: 1967：原住民运动推动修宪

summary.en: Years of organizing by Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander activists and their allies helped produce overwhelming support for constitutional change. The referendum removed discriminatory provisions concerning population counts and the Commonwealth’s power to make laws for Aboriginal people. Campaigners treated the vote as a demand for practical action against inequality, not an endpoint. It did not first grant citizenship or voting rights, which had separate histories. Understanding those distinctions makes the achievement clearer: sustained grassroots work altered the constitutional framework, while the struggle over how government should use its powers continued after the ballots were counted.
summary.zh: 原住民、托雷斯海峡岛民活动者及盟友多年组织宣传，最终赢得压倒性修宪支持。公投删除人口统计及联邦为原住民立法权方面的歧视性条款。参与者把投票视为要求实际改善不平等，而不是斗争终点。公投并非首次授予公民身份或投票权，两者另有历史。其具体成就在于基层运动改变宪制框架，政府应如何行使权力的争论则继续存在。

dateNote.en: The referendum was held on 27 May 1967; constitutional amendments formally took effect on 10 August. It was not a citizenship or voting-rights referendum.
dateNote.zh: 公投举行于1967年5月27日，修宪于8月10日正式生效；它并非授予公民身份或投票权的公投。

sources.title: Indigenous referendum
sources.evidenceNote: The referendum was held on 27 May 1967; constitutional amendments formally took effect on 10 August. It was not a citizenship or voting-rights referendum.

sources.title: 1967 Indigenous referendum: rights and freedoms
sources.evidenceNote: The referendum was held on 27 May 1967; constitutional amendments formally took effect on 10 August. It was not a citizenship or voting-rights referendum.

title.en: Apollo 11: from Earth to the Moon
title.zh: 阿波罗11号：从地球到月球

location.label: Kennedy Space Center; Earth launch location

summary.en: Apollo 11 launched from Cape Kennedy on 16 July 1969 with Neil Armstrong, Buzz Aldrin and Michael Collins. Armstrong and Aldrin reached the lunar surface while Collins remained in lunar orbit. The mission combined landing and return objectives with scientific observations, experiments and sample collection. This Earth map places the event at its launch site, not at the landing location on the Moon; it offers a starting point for following a journey beyond the map.
summary.zh: 1969年7月16日，阿波罗11号载着尼尔·阿姆斯特朗、巴兹·奥尔德林和迈克尔·柯林斯从肯尼迪角发射。阿姆斯特朗与奥尔德林到达月面，柯林斯留在绕月轨道。任务把登月和返回地球与观测、实验、样本采集结合起来。这张地球地图标示的是发射地点，而不是月球上的着陆点。

dateNote.en: Single-year mission; launch 16 July, lunar landing 20 July 1969. Coordinates are the Earth launch site.
dateNote.zh: 单一年份任务：1969年7月16日发射，7月20日登月；坐标为地球发射地点。

sources.title: Apollo 11 Mission Overview
sources.evidenceNote: NASA mission account provides crew, launch and landing chronology, lunar orbit roles, experiments and sample objectives.

title.en: 1971: Bangladesh emerges through liberation war
title.zh: 1971：孟加拉国在解放战争中诞生

summary.en: The Awami League’s electoral victory raised expectations that East Pakistan’s political demands would shape the state’s future. The failure to transfer power and the Pakistani military’s March crackdown transformed the crisis into a war of liberation marked by mass atrocities and displacement. Bengali resistance organized through the Mukti Bahini and a provisional government, while refugees crossed into India. Indian military intervention joined the final campaign, ending with the surrender of Pakistani forces in Dhaka. Bangladesh’s emergence was a regional and international event, but also the outcome of local organizing and civilian sacrifice that national borders alone cannot show.
summary.zh: 人民联盟选举胜利，使东巴基斯坦社会期待其政治诉求得到体现。权力未能移交，巴基斯坦军方3月镇压把危机转为解放战争，伴随大规模暴行和流离失所。孟加拉抵抗通过解放军与临时政府组织起来，难民进入印度。印度军事干预参与最终战役，巴军在达卡投降。孟加拉国诞生既是地区与国际事件，也源于地方组织和民众牺牲，无法仅用国界变化呈现。

dateNote.en: The war unfolded in 1971, from the March crackdown and independence declaration to the surrender in Dhaka on 16 December.
dateNote.zh: 战争展开于1971年，从3月镇压与独立宣言至12月16日达卡投降。

sources.title: Our Museum: overview of the Liberation War
sources.evidenceNote: The war unfolded in 1971, from the March crackdown and independence declaration to the surrender in Dhaka on 16 December.

title.en: Cambodia under the Khmer Rouge
title.zh: 红色高棉统治下的柬埔寨

summary.en: The Khmer Rouge attempted to remake Cambodia into an agrarian society through coercion, forced labor and extreme political control. Mass executions, persecution, hunger and the destruction of ordinary social life caused immense suffering and death. The regime’s ideological promises cannot be separated from the institutions and choices that imposed these conditions on people. Evidence preserved by Cambodian documentation projects and museums helps recover victims’ experiences and identify responsibility. The fall of the regime in Phnom Penh did not end Cambodia’s conflict or its survivors’ losses. This entry marks the years of national rule, within a longer history of war and recovery.
summary.zh: 红色高棉通过强制、强迫劳动和严密政治控制，企图把柬埔寨重塑为农业社会。大规模处决、迫害、饥饿与日常社会生活的破坏造成巨大苦难。意识形态承诺不能脱离实施压迫的制度和具体选择。柬埔寨文献机构与博物馆保存证据，重建受害者经历并确认责任。金边政权倒台没有结束全部冲突或幸存者损失；本条目聚焦全国统治时期，并置于更长期战争与恢复之中。

dateNote.en: 17 April 1975–7 January 1979 marks Khmer Rouge rule from the capture to the loss of Phnom Penh; the movement continued afterward.
dateNote.zh: 1975年4月17日至1979年1月7日指从占领到失去金边的统治时期，红色高棉其后仍存在。

sources.title: Cambodia 1975–1979
sources.evidenceNote: 17 April 1975–7 January 1979 marks Khmer Rouge rule from the capture to the loss of Phnom Penh; the movement continued afterward.

title.en: 1989: the Berlin Wall opens
title.zh: 1989：柏林墙开放

summary.en: The opening of the Berlin Wall became a defining image of the upheavals that transformed Eastern Europe in 1989. Demonstrations, opposition movements and changes in Soviet policy weakened governments that had restricted political participation and movement. The border opening was part of this broader process, not its only cause. Different countries followed different paths, and the collapse of communist rule did not resolve every social or economic dispute. Berlin’s division had embodied the Cold War in a single city; its opening made a new European political order imaginable while leaving the work of reunification and institutional change ahead.
summary.zh: 柏林墙开放成为1989年东欧剧变的标志。示威、反对运动和苏联政策变化，削弱了限制政治参与与人员流动的政府。边界开放属于更广过程，并非唯一原因。各国路径不同，共产党统治结束也未解决所有社会经济争议。柏林分裂曾把冷战具象为一座城市；开放使新的欧洲秩序成为可能，但统一与制度转型仍待完成。

dateNote.en: Border crossings opened on 9 November 1989; German reunification followed in 1990 and the Soviet Union dissolved in 1991.
dateNote.zh: 边境通道于1989年11月9日开放；德国于1990年统一，苏联于1991年解体。

sources.title: The Fall of Communism in Eastern Europe, 1989
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of State, Office of the Historian
sources.evidenceNote: Border crossings opened on 9 November 1989; German reunification followed in 1990 and the Soviet Union dissolved in 1991.

title.en: CERN: the World Wide Web begins
title.zh: 欧洲核子研究中心：万维网的起点

summary.en: Tim Berners-Lee developed the World Wide Web at CERN in 1989 to support information sharing among researchers. The first website explained the Web project itself. In 1993, CERN released Web software into the public domain and later used an open licence. The sequence connects a research community’s practical need with choices about sharing a technical system. The Web is a particular information system; its invention is not the beginning of the Internet.
summary.zh: 蒂姆·伯纳斯-李于1989年在欧洲核子研究中心开发万维网，以满足研究人员共享信息的需要。第一个网站介绍的正是万维网项目。1993年，中心把相关软件置于公共领域，之后又采用开放许可。这段历史把研究社区的实际需求与技术共享方式联系起来。万维网是一种信息系统，它的诞生并不等于互联网的起源。

dateNote.en: Selected development window, 1989–1993: invention to the public-domain release. The Web continued developing afterward.
dateNote.zh: 选取1989—1993年，即诞生至公共领域发布的阶段；此后万维网继续发展。

sources.title: The birth of the Web
sources.evidenceNote: CERN gives invention in 1989, research information-sharing purpose, first website and 30 April 1993 public-domain release.

title.en: South Africa: a democratic election
title.zh: 南非：民主选举

summary.en: South Africa’s 1994 election allowed adults to vote regardless of race, after a history of exclusion under apartheid. The government commemorates 27 April as the central date of the democratic election, and Nelson Mandela was inaugurated on 10 May. The transition changed political representation and opened a new constitutional period. The marker stands for a nationwide event; it does not imply that voting occurred only in Pretoria or that every consequence of apartheid ended in one year.
summary.zh: 1994年南非选举使成年人能够不分种族参加投票，改变了种族隔离制度下的政治排斥。南非政府以4月27日纪念这一民主选举，纳尔逊·曼德拉于5月10日就职。这一转变改变了政治代表制度，并开启新的宪政阶段。标记代表全国性事件，不表示只有比勒陀利亚投票，也不表示种族隔离的所有后果在一年内消失。

dateNote.en: Single-year transition; 27 April 1994 is the commemorated election date, followed by inauguration on 10 May.
dateNote.zh: 单一年份转型：1994年4月27日为纪念的选举日期，5月10日举行总统就职。

sources.title: Milestones of 20 Years of Freedom
sources.evidenceNote: Government chronology records 27 April election, adult voting regardless of race and 10 May inauguration.

title.en: 1922: the Soviet Union is established
title.zh: 1922年：苏联成立

summary.en: The first Congress of Soviets of the USSR adopted a declaration and agreement establishing the Soviet Union on 30 December 1922. The new union was a distinct political formation following revolution and civil war, rather than beginning automatically in 1917. Its founding documents defined a union of Soviet republics. When reading maps, distinguish the Russian Empire, the revolutionary governments, and the USSR: their names, institutions, and territories were not interchangeable.
summary.zh: 1922年12月30日，苏联第一次苏维埃代表大会通过成立苏联的宣言和条约。这个新的政治联合体形成于革命和内战之后，不能直接把其成立时间记为1917年。成立文件规定了苏维埃共和国的联盟。阅读历史地图时，应区分俄罗斯帝国、革命时期的各个政权和苏联；它们的名称、制度与疆域不能相互替代。

dateNote.en: Founding congress: 30 December 1922. This record marks establishment, not the full 1922–1991 lifespan or an unchanging territorial outline.
dateNote.zh: 成立大会：1922年12月30日。本条目标记成立事件，不代表1922—1991年的整个存续时期，也不表示疆域始终不变。

sources.title: Formation of the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics
sources.evidenceNote: Library description of founding congress records; declaration and agreement adopted on 30 December 1922.

title.en: 1990: Germany reunifies
title.zh: 1990年：德国统一

location.label: Berlin, Reichstag; representative reunification ceremony marker

summary.en: German reunification took effect on 3 October 1990 under the Unification Treaty. The five re-established eastern states joined the Federal Republic, and Berlin became the capital of the united country. The opening of the Berlin Wall in November 1989 had been an earlier turning point; it did not itself create a unified state. Comparing these dates shows why a map should distinguish an opening border from a completed constitutional change.
summary.zh: 1990年10月3日，《统一条约》生效，德国实现统一。重新建立的五个东部州加入德意志联邦共和国，柏林成为统一后德国的首都。1989年11月柏林墙开放是此前的重要转折，但这一事件本身并未建立统一国家。比较两个日期，可以理解地图为何应区分边界开放与完成宪制变更。

dateNote.en: Effective date: 3 October 1990. An annual map of 1990 must identify whether it represents the period before or after this date.
dateNote.zh: 生效日期：1990年10月3日。1990年的年度地图应说明它描绘的是这一日期之前还是之后。

sources.title: 3. Oktober 1990: Die Einheit ist Wirklichkeit
sources.evidenceNote: Treaty effective at midnight on 3 October 1990; five eastern states and Berlin; capital status.

sources.title: Vertrag über die Herstellung der Einheit Deutschlands
sources.publisher: Federal Ministry of Justice / Federal Office of Justice
sources.evidenceNote: Primary treaty text, Article 1, accession effective 3 October 1990.

title.en: 1991: the Soviet Union dissolves
title.zh: 1991年：苏联解体

location.label: Moscow; representative marker for a process across multiple republics

summary.en: The Soviet Union broke apart through republican independence decisions and agreements during 1991. In December, Russia, Ukraine and Belarus established the Commonwealth of Independent States; Mikhail Gorbachev resigned on 25 December, and the Soviet legislature formally ended the union on 26 December. Russia continued the USSR’s UN membership, while the other republics followed distinct political paths. A map after 1991 must show the new states rather than carry the Soviet silhouette forward.
summary.zh: 1991年，各共和国的独立决定与一系列协议推动了苏联解体。12月，俄罗斯、乌克兰和白俄罗斯建立独立国家联合体；戈尔巴乔夫于12月25日辞职，苏联立法机构于26日正式结束联盟。俄罗斯延续苏联在联合国的席位，其他共和国则走上不同政治道路。1991年之后的地图必须呈现新的国家，不能继续沿用苏联的轮廓。

dateNote.en: Process during 1991; final institutional steps on 25–26 December. Individual republics have different independence and recognition dates.
dateNote.zh: 解体过程发生于1991年；最后的制度性步骤在12月25—26日完成。各共和国的独立与获承认日期并不相同。

sources.title: The Collapse of the Soviet Union
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of State, Office of the Historian
sources.evidenceNote: Independence movements, December CIS agreement, and Gorbachev resignation on 25 December 1991.

sources.title: Dissolution of the USSR
sources.evidenceNote: Council of the Republics formally ended the union on 26 December 1991.

sources.title: Russian Federation: UN membership history
sources.evidenceNote: 24 December 1991 letter on continuation of Soviet UN membership by the Russian Federation.

title.en: 1991–2006: Yugoslavia and its successor states
title.zh: 1991—2006年：南斯拉夫及其继承国家

summary.en: The breakup of socialist Yugoslavia involved several independence processes and devastating wars, including mass crimes prosecuted by the ICTY. Slovenia, Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, and Macedonia emerged as separate states; Serbia and Montenegro formed a different Federal Republic of Yugoslavia in 1992. That state became the union of Serbia and Montenegro in 2003, which ended in 2006. The repeated name “Yugoslavia” therefore describes different territorial and constitutional entities at different dates.
summary.zh: 社会主义南斯拉夫的解体包含多个独立进程与破坏性战争，其中的大规模罪行由前南斯拉夫问题国际刑事法庭审理。斯洛文尼亚、克罗地亚、波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那以及马其顿成为独立国家；塞尔维亚和黑山于1992年另组南斯拉夫联盟共和国。该国于2003年改为塞尔维亚和黑山国家联盟，并于2006年结束。因此，不同时期的“南斯拉夫”名称对应不同疆域和宪制实体。

dateNote.en: Selected constitutional transitions in 1991–2006, not one uninterrupted war. “Macedonia” is the period name; “North Macedonia” was adopted later. Kosovo’s later status is outside this record.
dateNote.zh: 选取1991—2006年的宪制转变，并非表示战争在此期间从未中断。“马其顿”为当时名称，后来改称“北马其顿”。科索沃后来的地位不在本条目范围内。

sources.title: Yugoslavia and Successor States
sources.evidenceNote: Successor-state admission history and Serbia/Montenegro separation in 2006.

sources.title: What is the former Yugoslavia?
sources.publisher: International Criminal Tribunal for the former Yugoslavia
sources.evidenceNote: Different Yugoslav entities; 1992 federation, 2003 state union, 2006 separation.

sources.title: About the ICTY
sources.publisher: International Criminal Tribunal for the former Yugoslavia
sources.evidenceNote: Tribunal mandate and mass-crime prosecutions arising from the Balkan conflicts of the 1990s.

title.en: 1993: Czech and Slovak states separate
title.zh: 1993年：捷克与斯洛伐克分立

location.label: Prague; representative marker, paired with Bratislava

summary.en: Czechoslovakia ceased to exist at the end of 31 December 1992. The Czech Republic and Slovakia began as separate successor states on 1 January 1993 and were admitted to the United Nations later that month. This constitutional separation differed from Germany’s reunification and the wars accompanying Yugoslavia’s breakup. A map labeled 1993 should distinguish the two states. The later short name “Czechia” is a naming question, separate from the state’s establishment.
summary.zh: 捷克斯洛伐克于1992年12月31日结束时停止存在。捷克共和国和斯洛伐克于1993年1月1日成为两个继承国家，并在同月加入联合国。这一宪制分立与德国统一、以及伴随南斯拉夫解体的战争有不同路径。标记为1993年的地图因此应区分两国。后来采用的简称“Czechia”涉及名称，与建国时间是两个问题。

dateNote.en: Separation effective 1 January 1993; both admitted to the UN on 19 January 1993. Czechoslovakia’s final day was 31 December 1992.
dateNote.zh: 国家分立于1993年1月1日生效；两国于1月19日加入联合国。捷克斯洛伐克的最后一天是1992年12月31日。

sources.title: Czechoslovakia and Successor States: Czechia, Slovakia
sources.evidenceNote: Final day 31 December 1992; successor states and UN admission on 19 January 1993; later Czechia short name.

title.en: 1993: Eritrea’s referendum and independence
title.zh: 1993年：厄立特里亚公投与独立

summary.en: After a long independence struggle, a 1991 agreement recognized Eritreans’ right to determine their political future through an internationally supervised referendum. The 1993 vote was observed by a United Nations mission, and Eritrea joined the UN on 28 May. Military control, a referendum, diplomatic recognition, and UN membership were separate stages. Distinguishing those stages explains why a map of Ethiopia before and after this transition cannot use the same political outline.
summary.zh: 经历漫长独立斗争后，1991年的协议承认厄立特里亚人民通过国际监督公投决定政治未来的权利。联合国观察团监督了1993年的投票，厄立特里亚于5月28日加入联合国。军事控制、公投、外交承认和联合国会员资格是不同阶段。区分这些步骤，有助于理解为何转型前后的埃塞俄比亚不能沿用同一个政治轮廓。

dateNote.en: Referendum in April 1993 and UN admission on 28 May 1993. The 1991 military transition and the 1993 international process are distinct.
dateNote.zh: 1993年4月举行公投，5月28日加入联合国。1991年的军事转变与1993年的国际程序是不同阶段。

sources.title: The United Nations and the Independence of Eritrea
sources.evidenceNote: 1991 agreement, referendum and UNOVER electoral mission.

sources.title: Admission of Eritrea to membership in the United Nations
sources.evidenceNote: Primary resolution adopted on 28 May 1993 admitting Eritrea.

title.en: 2002: Timor-Leste restores independence
title.zh: 2002年：东帝汶恢复独立

summary.en: Timor-Leste became independent on 20 May 2002 after a UN-administered transition. The 1999 popular consultation and the violence that followed had preceded the United Nations Transitional Administration in East Timor. The 2002 transfer of authority marked a different stage from both the 1975 declaration and the 1999 vote. Timorese institutions describe 20 May as the restoration of independence. The Dili marker represents a national transition, not a change confined to the capital.
summary.zh: 经历联合国管理的过渡期后，东帝汶于2002年5月20日独立。1999年的全民投票及其后的暴力事件，先于联合国东帝汶过渡行政当局的建立。2002年的权力移交既不同于1975年的独立宣告，也不同于1999年的投票。东帝汶官方将5月20日称为恢复独立日。帝力标记代表全国性转变，不表示变化仅发生于首都。

dateNote.en: Restoration of independence on 20 May 2002; the 1999 consultation and 1975 declaration are distinct earlier events.
dateNote.zh: 2002年5月20日恢复独立；1999年全民投票和1975年独立宣告是不同的先前事件。

sources.title: United Nations Transitional Administration in East Timor
sources.evidenceNote: Independence on 20 May 2002 and replacement of UNTAET by UNMISET.

sources.title: History
sources.evidenceNote: 1975 declaration, 1999 consultation, 2002 constitution and Restoration of Independence Day.

title.en: 2011: South Sudan becomes independent
title.zh: 2011年：南苏丹独立

summary.en: South Sudan separated from Sudan on 9 July 2011 following an internationally monitored referendum in January. The vote formed part of the peace process established by the 2005 Comprehensive Peace Agreement. South Sudan joined the United Nations on 14 July. Independence changed the international political map, but should not be read as proof that all border questions or political conflicts were settled. A map of 2011 needs a date within the year to show this change accurately.
summary.zh: 南苏丹在1月举行国际监督的公投后，于2011年7月9日从苏丹独立。公投属于2005年《全面和平协议》建立的和平进程。南苏丹于7月14日加入联合国。独立改变了国际政治地图，却不等于所有边界问题或政治冲突都已解决。2011年的地图必须说明年内具体日期，才能准确呈现这一变化。

dateNote.en: Independence on 9 July 2011; UN admission on 14 July 2011. A map of 1 January precedes independence; a year-end map follows it.
dateNote.zh: 2011年7月9日独立，7月14日加入联合国。2011年1月1日的地图早于独立，年末地图则晚于独立。

sources.title: South Sudan: UN membership history
sources.evidenceNote: Secession on 9 July 2011 following January referendum; UN membership on 14 July.

sources.title: Referendum in Southern Sudan
sources.evidenceNote: Referendum and 2005–2011 peace process leading to independence.

title.en: 1980: Zimbabwe gains recognized independence
title.zh: 1980年：津巴布韦获得独立

location.label: Salisbury, now Harare; representative independence marker

summary.en: Zimbabwe attained independence on 18 April 1980 after years of armed conflict and a negotiated transition from minority rule. This date differs from the unilateral declaration issued by Rhodesia’s white-minority government in 1965, which the United States did not recognize. The capital was still named Salisbury at independence and was renamed Harare later. Comparing names, recognition, and political representation helps explain why a simple color change cannot tell the whole story of decolonization.
summary.zh: 经过多年武装冲突以及结束少数族裔统治的谈判过渡，津巴布韦于1980年4月18日独立。这个日期不同于罗得西亚白人少数政府在1965年作出的单方面独立宣告，美国未承认后者。独立时首都仍称索尔兹伯里，后来改名哈拉雷。比较名称、外交承认与政治代表制度，可以看出地图上的颜色改变无法涵盖非殖民化的全部历史。

dateNote.en: Independence on 18 April 1980. “Harare” is the current locator for the city then called Salisbury, not its 1980 name.
dateNote.zh: 1980年4月18日独立。“哈拉雷”为今日地名；当时城市称索尔兹伯里。

sources.title: Zimbabwe: history of recognition and diplomatic relations
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of State, Office of the Historian
sources.evidenceNote: Independence on 18 April 1980; Salisbury/current Harare; 1965 UDI not recognized by the US.

sources.title: Zimbabwe country profile
sources.evidenceNote: Independence in 1980 following conflict between minority government and black-majority insurgents.

title.en: 1990: Namibia becomes independent
title.zh: 1990年：纳米比亚独立

summary.en: Namibia became independent on 21 March 1990 following UN-supervised elections in 1989 and the adoption of a constitution. The United Nations Transition Assistance Group monitored the electoral process and the transition from South African administration. Independence was the outcome of a long struggle and international negotiations rather than a single isolated ceremony. A map after this transition should identify Namibia separately from South Africa while allowing readers to investigate the earlier colonial and mandate histories.
summary.zh: 1989年举行联合国监督的选举并制定宪法后，纳米比亚于1990年3月21日独立。联合国过渡时期援助团监督了选举及结束南非管辖的过渡进程。独立是长期斗争与国际谈判的成果，而非孤立的一次仪式。此后的地图应将纳米比亚与南非分开，同时让读者进一步了解此前的殖民和委任统治历史。

dateNote.en: Independence on 21 March 1990; constituent assembly election on 7–11 November 1989. These dates distinguish preparation from sovereignty.
dateNote.zh: 1990年3月21日独立；制宪议会选举于1989年11月7—11日举行。两个日期区分独立的准备过程与主权转变。

sources.title: UNTAG: background
sources.evidenceNote: 1989 elections, constitution, independence on 21 March 1990.

sources.title: The UN’s role in Namibian Independence
sources.evidenceNote: UN resolution 435 and UNTAG role in transition and independence.

title.en: 1976: Vietnam’s formal state reunification
title.zh: 1976年：越南正式统一国家体制

summary.en: On 2 July 1976, the Democratic Republic of Viet-Nam and the Republic of South Viet-Nam formally united as the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam. The constitutional change followed the military end of the war in 1975. Using one date for both processes hides an important distinction between control on the ground and the institutions of the united state. The Hanoi marker identifies the national political decision, while the consequences involved people across the country.
summary.zh: 1976年7月2日，越南民主共和国与越南南方共和国正式统一为越南社会主义共和国。这一国家体制变更发生在1975年战争军事结束之后。把两个过程都记作同一天，会掩盖地面控制与统一国家制度之间的重要区别。河内标记代表全国性的政治决定，其影响涉及全国各地人民。

dateNote.en: Formal state union on 2 July 1976, distinct from the military events of 30 April 1975.
dateNote.zh: 1976年7月2日正式统一国家体制，不同于1975年4月30日的军事事件。

sources.title: Democratic Republic of Viet-Nam: UN authority record
sources.evidenceNote: Explicit union of northern and southern states on 2 July 1976.

sources.title: History of Viet Nam
sources.evidenceNote: Socialist Republic of Viet Nam established on 2 July 1976 with territory covering north and south.

title.en: 1990: two Yemeni states unite
title.zh: 1990年：也门两国统一

summary.en: The Yemen Arab Republic and the People’s Democratic Republic of Yemen merged on 22 May 1990 to form the Republic of Yemen. They had previously held separate memberships in the United Nations, dating from 1947 and 1967. The unified state continued their international relationships and treaty obligations. This record concerns the 1990 constitutional union; it does not describe later military control or imply that subsequent political conflict disappeared.
summary.zh: 阿拉伯也门共和国与也门民主人民共和国于1990年5月22日合并为也门共和国。此前，两国分别自1947年和1967年起拥有联合国会员资格。统一后的国家延续了它们的国际关系与条约义务。本条目讨论1990年的国家统一，不用于描绘后来的军事控制，也不意味着此后的政治冲突已经消失。

dateNote.en: Union effective 22 May 1990. Earlier state boundaries and later zones of control require differently dated maps.
dateNote.zh: 统一于1990年5月22日生效。此前的国家边界与后来的控制区需要使用不同日期的地图。

sources.title: Yemen: UN membership history
sources.evidenceNote: Two UN members merged on 22 May 1990.

sources.title: Historical information: Yemen
sources.evidenceNote: Treaty continuity and unification on 22 May 1990.

title.en: 1997: Hong Kong becomes a Special Administrative Region
title.zh: 1997年：香港特别行政区成立

location.label: Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre; representative handover marker

summary.en: On 1 July 1997, British administration of Hong Kong ended and the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People’s Republic of China was established. The Basic Law, adopted in 1990, came into effect on the same day. The change followed the 1984 Sino-British Joint Declaration. Hong Kong remained a distinctive administrative unit within China, so changing the sovereignty label should not erase its separate institutional history or be confused with the creation of an independent state.
summary.zh: 1997年7月1日，英国对香港的管治结束，中华人民共和国香港特别行政区成立。1990年通过的《基本法》于同日生效。这一变化承接1984年的《中英联合声明》。香港成为中国内部具有特殊制度的行政区域，因此主权标签的变化不应抹去其独特制度历史，也不能被误读为建立独立国家。

dateNote.en: Handover and Basic Law effective 1 July 1997; the 1984 Joint Declaration and 1990 adoption of the Basic Law are earlier milestones.
dateNote.zh: 1997年7月1日进行交接且《基本法》生效；1984年联合声明与1990年基本法通过是此前的重要节点。

sources.title: Basic Law: Preamble
sources.evidenceNote: 1984 Joint Declaration and sovereignty resumption on 1 July 1997.

title.en: 1999: Macao becomes a Special Administrative Region
title.zh: 1999年：澳门特别行政区成立

summary.en: Macao’s administration transferred from Portugal to China on 20 December 1999, when the Macao Special Administrative Region and its Basic Law took effect. The change followed the 1987 Sino-Portuguese Joint Declaration and the 1993 adoption of the Basic Law. Macao became a special administrative region within China. Comparing its transition with Hong Kong’s shows both a related institutional framework and different colonial histories, negotiated agreements, and effective dates.
summary.zh: 1999年12月20日，澳门由葡萄牙管治转为中国管治，澳门特别行政区成立，《基本法》生效。这一变化承接1987年的《中葡联合声明》与1993年通过的《基本法》。澳门成为中国内部的特别行政区。将其与香港交接比较，可以看到相关的制度框架，也能辨别两地不同的殖民历史、谈判协议与生效日期。

dateNote.en: Handover and Basic Law effective 20 December 1999; the 1987 declaration and 1993 law adoption preceded implementation.
dateNote.zh: 1999年12月20日进行交接且《基本法》生效；1987年联合声明和1993年基本法通过早于正式实施。

sources.title: Thirty years of Basic Law
sources.evidenceNote: Handover on 20 December 1999 and Basic Law implementation.

sources.title: Basic Law of the Macao Special Administrative Region
