title.en: 1993: the European Union takes shape
title.zh: 1993年：欧洲联盟成立

location.label: Maastricht; treaty-signing city, representative institutional marker

summary.en: The Treaty on European Union, signed at Maastricht in 1992, entered into force on 1 November 1993. It established the European Union, extended cooperation beyond the earlier European Communities, and set a framework for economic and monetary union. The EU was an organization of member states rather than a replacement country. An atlas should show integration through institutional or network layers without painting all members as one sovereign state.
summary.zh: 1992年在马斯特里赫特签署的《欧洲联盟条约》于1993年11月1日生效。它建立欧洲联盟，将合作扩展至此前欧洲共同体的范围之外，并为经济与货币联盟设立框架。欧盟是成员国组成的组织，而非取代成员国的新国家。地图集应通过制度或网络图层展示一体化，不应把所有成员国直接涂为一个主权国家。

dateNote.en: Treaty signed 7 February 1992; entered into force 1 November 1993. This entry marks the EU’s establishment, not the first European Community.
dateNote.zh: 条约于1992年2月7日签署，1993年11月1日生效。本条目标记欧盟成立，不是最早欧洲共同体的成立。

sources.title: Maastricht Treaty
sources.evidenceNote: Signature on 7 February 1992; entry into force on 1 November 1993; new EU structure.

sources.title: The Maastricht and Amsterdam Treaties
sources.evidenceNote: Institutional structure and economic/monetary union under Maastricht.

title.en: 2002: the African Union is launched
title.zh: 2002年：非洲联盟正式启动

summary.en: African leaders launched the African Union in Durban in July 2002, succeeding the Organization of African Unity. The new organization built on the OAU’s work against colonialism and apartheid while emphasizing cooperation, integration, development, and peace. The transition involved earlier decisions and treaty-making as well as the inaugural summit. Continental organization should be read alongside the histories of individual states; it did not merge them into one country.
summary.zh: 2002年7月，非洲领导人在德班正式启动非洲联盟，取代非洲统一组织。新组织承接非统组织反殖民主义和反种族隔离的工作，并强调合作、一体化、发展与和平。这一转变包括此前的决议、条约制定以及成立峰会。大陆组织的历史应与各国历史一同阅读；它并未将成员国合并为一个国家。

dateNote.en: Official launch in Durban on 9 July 2002; the predecessor’s decision to build the new union was made in September 1999.
dateNote.zh: 2002年7月9日在德班正式启动；前身组织于1999年9月作出建立新联盟的决定。

sources.title: About the African Union
sources.evidenceNote: Durban launch in July 2002; predecessor OAU and 1999 decision; goals.

sources.title: Address at the Launching of the African Union
sources.evidenceNote: Contemporary launch address dated 9 July 2002, Durban.

title.en: 2015–2016: the Paris climate agreement

location.label: Le Bourget, Paris; COP21 conference marker

summary.en: Governments adopted the Paris Agreement at COP21 on 12 December 2015, and the treaty entered into force on 4 November 2016. It created a framework for national climate commitments and successive rounds of reporting and increased ambition, with a shared temperature goal. Adoption and entry into force were different steps. The agreement illustrates how states can organize around a planetary problem without redrawing political borders; promises, implementation, and measured outcomes remain separate questions.
summary.zh: 各国政府于2015年12月12日在巴黎气候大会通过《巴黎协定》，条约于2016年11月4日生效。协定建立国家气候承诺、报告和逐步提高目标的框架，并规定共同温控目标。通过与生效是不同步骤。它展示了国家如何围绕全球问题开展合作而无需重画国界；承诺、实施与实测成果仍是不同的问题。

dateNote.en: Adopted 12 December 2015; entered into force 4 November 2016. This record describes the founding steps, not current party status or compliance.
dateNote.zh: 2015年12月12日通过，2016年11月4日生效。本条目描述成立步骤，不表示各国当前的缔约身份或履约情况。

title.en: 2003: the Human Genome Project reaches its goal
title.zh: 2003年：人类基因组计划完成目标

location.label: Bethesda, Maryland; NHGRI representative project marker

summary.en: An international consortium announced completion of the Human Genome Project in April 2003. Its public reference sequence covered about 92 percent of the human genome, greatly improving the earlier draft and giving researchers a shared resource. “Complete” referred to the project’s goals, not a gapless account of every person’s DNA. Later research filled remaining sequence gaps and addressed the limited diversity of the initial reference. The Bethesda marker represents one coordinating institution in an international effort.
summary.zh: 国际合作团队于2003年4月宣布人类基因组计划完成。公开参考序列覆盖了约92%的人类基因组，大幅改进先前草图，并为研究者提供共同资源。“完成”指完成计划目标，并非无缺口地描述每个人的全部DNA。后续研究继续补齐序列缺口，并回应最初参考序列多样性有限的问题。贝塞斯达标记代表国际合作中的一个协调机构。

dateNote.en: Completion announced 14 April 2003. About 92 percent coverage in 2003 must not be confused with later gapless sequencing milestones.
dateNote.zh: 2003年4月14日宣布完成。2003年约92%的覆盖率不能与后来的无缺口测序成果混为一谈。

title.en: 1999: Panama takes full control of the canal
title.zh: 1999年：巴拿马全面接管运河

location.label: Miraflores, Panama Canal; representative waterway marker

summary.en: At noon on 31 December 1999, Panama assumed full responsibility for operating and administering the Panama Canal and the surrounding transferred areas. The handover completed the timetable set by the 1977 Torrijos–Carter treaties. Control of a major transport route therefore changed through a long negotiated process. The event links sovereignty, labor, engineering, and global shipping, and should be distinguished from the canal’s earlier construction and opening.
summary.zh: 1999年12月31日中午，巴拿马全面接管巴拿马运河及相关移交区域的运营和管理。交接完成了1977年《托里霍斯—卡特条约》规定的时间表。这个重要运输通道的控制权因此通过长期谈判进程发生改变。该事件连接主权、劳动、工程与全球航运，也应与更早的运河修建和通航区分开来。

dateNote.en: Full transfer at noon on 31 December 1999; treaty agreement in 1977. A map earlier in 1999 precedes completion of the handover.
dateNote.zh: 1999年12月31日中午全面移交；相关条约于1977年达成。1999年较早日期的地图先于交接完成。

title.en: 1991: the Treaty of Asunción creates MERCOSUR’s framework
title.zh: 1991年：《亚松森条约》建立南方共同市场框架

summary.en: Argentina, Brazil, Paraguay, and Uruguay signed the Treaty of Asunción on 26 March 1991, laying the foundations for MERCOSUR, the Southern Common Market. The treaty proposed closer economic coordination and a common market. A signed plan and a fully realized market are different things; the agreement provided a framework for subsequent institutions and negotiation. On a map, this is a network of cooperating states rather than the creation of a new sovereign territory.
summary.zh: 阿根廷、巴西、巴拉圭与乌拉圭于1991年3月26日签署《亚松森条约》，为南方共同市场奠定基础。条约提出加强经济协调并建立共同市场。签署的计划与完全实现的市场并不相同；协定为此后的制度建设与谈判提供框架。地图上，这应表现为国家间的合作网络，而不是新主权领土的诞生。

dateNote.en: Treaty signed 26 March 1991 and entered into force 29 November 1991. Scope here is the four founding states, not later membership.
dateNote.zh: 条约于1991年3月26日签署、11月29日生效。此处讨论四个创始成员国，不表示后来的成员范围。

title.en: 2001: a peace framework for Bougainville
title.zh: 2001年：布干维尔和平框架

summary.en: The government of Papua New Guinea and Bougainville leaders signed the Bougainville Peace Agreement at Arawa on 30 August 2001. Its three central elements were autonomy, a future referendum on political status, and weapons disposal. These provisions addressed different parts of a peace process rather than immediately establishing an independent state. Studying the agreement helps distinguish autonomy within a country from sovereignty, and the signing of a settlement from its implementation.
summary.zh: 2001年8月30日，巴布亚新几内亚政府与布干维尔领导人在阿拉瓦签署《布干维尔和平协议》。协议的三项核心内容是自治、未来政治地位公投与武器处置。这些规定处理和平进程中的不同问题，并未立即建立独立国家。研究协议有助于区分一国内部自治与主权，以及签署解决方案与具体实施。

dateNote.en: Signed 30 August 2001. This record describes the agreement, not the result of a later referendum or a current independence status.
dateNote.zh: 2001年8月30日签署。本条目描述协议，不表示后来的公投结果或当前独立地位。

title.en: 1985–1986: a nuclear-free zone in the South Pacific
title.zh: 1985—1986年：南太平洋无核区

location.label: Rarotonga, Cook Islands; representative treaty marker

summary.en: The South Pacific Nuclear Free Zone Treaty opened for signature at Rarotonga on 6 August 1985 and entered into force on 11 December 1986. It established commitments concerning nuclear explosive devices in a defined regional zone. Pacific governments used a regional treaty to address security and environmental concerns beyond the borders of any one island state. A treaty zone is a legal and cooperative layer; its outline should not be mistaken for a single country.
summary.zh: 《南太平洋无核区条约》于1985年8月6日在拉罗汤加开放签署，并于1986年12月11日生效。条约就划定区域内的核爆炸装置作出承诺。太平洋各国政府通过区域条约处理超越单个岛国边界的安全与环境关切。条约区域属于法律与合作图层，其轮廓不应被误认为一个国家。

dateNote.en: Opened for signature 6 August 1985; entered into force 11 December 1986. Membership and protocol participation are not identical to the geographic zone.
dateNote.zh: 1985年8月6日开放签署，1986年12月11日生效。成员身份及议定书参与情况与地理区域范围并非同一概念。

title.en: 1965: Singapore becomes a sovereign state
title.zh: 1965年：新加坡成为主权国家

summary.en: Singapore became an independent state on 9 August 1965 after separation from Malaysia. The transition required an agreement, changes to Malaysia’s constitution, and a proclamation of Singapore’s independence, read over radio that morning. The proclamation made the change in sovereignty explicit. This episode shows that decolonization and state formation could involve several stages: self-government, federation, separation, and new national institutions did not all occur at once.
summary.zh: 新加坡于1965年8月9日脱离马来西亚，成为独立国家。转变涉及分离协议、马来西亚宪法修改以及当天早晨经电台宣读的新加坡独立宣言。宣言明确了主权变化。这一案例说明，非殖民化与国家形成可以经历多个阶段：自治、联邦、分离和新国家制度并非在同一时刻出现。

dateNote.en: Independence proclaimed 9 August 1965. This record does not date earlier self-government or the formation of Malaysia.
dateNote.zh: 1965年8月9日宣布独立。本条目不用于标记此前自治或马来西亚成立的时间。

title.en: 2007: the UN adopts the Indigenous rights declaration
title.zh: 2007年：联合国通过《土著人民权利宣言》

location.label: United Nations Headquarters, New York; adoption marker

summary.en: The UN General Assembly adopted the Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples on 13 September 2007 after years of negotiation and Indigenous advocacy. The declaration addresses collective and individual rights, cultural identity, and peoples’ ability to shape their own development. Its adoption created an international standard, not automatic implementation in every country. The New York marker locates the vote, while the people and communities concerned live across the world.
summary.zh: 经过多年谈判与原住民倡议，联合国大会于2007年9月13日通过《土著人民权利宣言》。宣言涉及集体与个人权利、文化认同，以及各族群自主决定发展道路的能力。通过宣言建立了国际标准，并不意味着各国立即自动落实。纽约标记定位投票地点，而相关人民与社区分布于世界各地。

dateNote.en: General Assembly adoption on 13 September 2007. The event date is not the start of Indigenous peoples’ histories or the date all rights became effective.
dateNote.zh: 联合国大会于2007年9月13日通过宣言。这一事件不是原住民历史的起点，也不是所有权利同时实现的日期。

title.en: 2022: Webb opens a new infrared view
title.zh: 2022年：韦布开启新的红外视野

location.label: Goddard Space Flight Center, Greenbelt; public image-release event marker

summary.en: NASA, the European Space Agency, and the Canadian Space Agency released the first full set of James Webb Space Telescope science images and spectra on 12 July 2022. The observations included distant galaxies, star-forming regions, and an exoplanet’s atmosphere. Infrared instruments made features visible that ordinary optical images could miss. The Greenbelt marker identifies the public release event and a coordinating institution, not the telescope’s location in space or the sole source of an international collaboration.
summary.zh: 2022年7月12日，美国国家航空航天局、欧洲航天局与加拿大航天局发布詹姆斯·韦布空间望远镜首批完整科学图像与光谱。观测包括遥远星系、恒星形成区和一颗系外行星的大气。红外仪器使普通可见光图像难以显示的特征变得可见。格林贝尔特标记定位公开发布活动与一个协调机构，并非望远镜在太空中的位置，也不代表国际合作仅来自一地。

dateNote.en: Full initial set released 12 July 2022; one image was previewed on 11 July. This record concerns publication, not the 2021 launch.
dateNote.zh: 首批完整数据于2022年7月12日发布，其中一张图像已于7月11日预先公布。本条目讨论发布事件，不是2021年的发射。

title.en: 2023: Chandrayaan-3 lands on the Moon
title.zh: 2023年：月船三号登月

location.label: Sriharikota; Earth launch-site marker for a lunar mission

summary.en: India’s Chandrayaan-3 mission launched from Sriharikota on 14 July 2023. Its Vikram lander touched down on 23 August and deployed the Pragyan rover to study the lunar surface. The landing was in the Moon’s southern high latitudes, approximately 69 degrees south, rather than at the geographic south pole itself. The Earth marker locates the launch site. The mission connects engineering, scientific instruments, and new contributions to international lunar research.
summary.zh: 印度月船三号任务于2023年7月14日从斯里赫里戈达发射。“维克拉姆”着陆器于8月23日着陆，并释放“普拉吉安”月球车研究月面。着陆点位于月球南部高纬地区、约南纬69度，而非地理南极点本身。地球地图上的标记定位发射场。任务连接工程、科学仪器以及对国际月球研究的新贡献。

dateNote.en: Launch on 14 July 2023; landing on 23 August 2023. The map coordinate is Earth’s launch site, not a lunar coordinate.
dateNote.zh: 2023年7月14日发射，8月23日着陆。地图坐标是地球上的发射场，不是月面坐标。

title.en: Kerma: a Nubian kingdom on the Nile
title.zh: 克尔玛：尼罗河上的努比亚王国

summary.en: Kerma grew into a powerful Nubian centre south of Egypt, beside routes through the Nile valley. Its mud-brick religious monuments, fortified town and large burial grounds reveal an indigenous political tradition with its own architecture and material culture. Fine Kerma pottery also reached Egyptian communities, making objects evidence of contact across political frontiers. Egyptian conquest in the fifteenth century BCE changed the region's ruling institutions. Kerma helps explain the Nile as a landscape containing several interacting societies, rather than a corridor belonging to one enduring state.
summary.zh: 克尔玛位于埃及以南的尼罗河通道旁，逐渐成为强大的努比亚中心。大型土坯宗教建筑、设防城市与墓地，展现了拥有自身建筑和物质文化的本地政治传统。精美的克尔玛陶器也进入埃及社会，为跨越政治边界的交往提供实物证据。公元前15世纪的埃及征服改变了当地统治结构。克尔玛让我们看到，尼罗河流域包含多个相互联系的社会，并非始终属于同一个国家。

dateNote.en: Approximately 2500–1500 BCE is a rounded archaeological span. The mission's phase table places Early Kerma around 2450 BCE and Egyptian conquest around 1480 BCE; other site descriptions use slightly different approximate endpoints.
dateNote.zh: 约公元前2500—1500年是取整后的考古时段。考古队分期表将早期克尔玛起点置于约前2450年、埃及征服置于约前1480年；不同遗址介绍采用略有差异的近似年代。

en: The capital stood near the Nile's Third Cataract, a strategic position for movement along the valley.
Kerma ceramics found at Abydos document connections with Egypt without proving that Egypt ruled Kerma throughout this period.
zh: 都城靠近尼罗河第三瀑布，处于河谷交通的重要位置。
阿拜多斯出土的克尔玛陶器说明它与埃及存在联系，不能据此认定埃及在整个时期统治克尔玛。

title.en: 1869: the Suez Canal opens
title.zh: 1869年：苏伊士运河开通

location.label: Port Said; northern entrance and opening celebrations

summary.en: The Suez Canal opened a sea passage between the Mediterranean and Red Sea, shortening voyages between Europe and the Indian Ocean. Its construction depended heavily on Egyptian labour and took a decade. Ships could now avoid sailing around southern Africa, changing the commercial importance of ports, coal supplies and shipping routes. The canal also made Egypt's position central to competing imperial interests. Its opening is a useful reminder that a narrow piece of infrastructure can reorganize connections across several continents without changing the locations of those continents.
summary.zh: 苏伊士运河把地中海与红海连接起来，缩短了欧洲与印度洋之间的海程。工程历时十年，大量依靠埃及劳动者。船舶得以避开绕行非洲南端的航线，港口、煤炭补给站与航运网络的重要性随之改变。运河也使埃及成为帝国利益竞争的重要地点。这一工程说明，狭窄的人工水道能够重新组织跨洲联系，地理位置本身却没有改变。

dateNote.en: The inauguration took place on 17 November 1869. This entry dates the opening, not earlier canal proposals or later changes in ownership and control.
dateNote.zh: 正式开通典礼于1869年11月17日举行。此处记录开通事件，不将此前规划或此后所有权、控制权变化并入同一年。

en: The canal joins two seas across Egypt; it is an artificial passage rather than a natural strait.
Construction began in 1859 and the canal was inaugurated in November 1869.
zh: 运河横穿埃及连接两片海域，是人工水道而非天然海峡。
工程于1859年开始，1869年11月举行开通典礼。

title.en: 1960: Nigeria becomes independent
title.zh: 1960年：尼日利亚独立

summary.en: Nigeria became independent from Britain as a federation on 1 October 1960. The new state brought together regions with distinct political institutions, languages and economic priorities under a federal parliamentary system. Its admission to the United Nations followed within a week, giving it a formal role in international diplomacy. Independence and becoming a republic were separate steps: the monarchy remained part of the constitutional arrangement until 1963. Reading these dates separately helps explain why a change in sovereignty need not immediately replace every institution or resolve disagreements within a new country.
summary.zh: 1960年10月1日，尼日利亚以联邦形式脱离英国统治而独立。不同政治制度、语言和经济诉求的地区被纳入联邦议会体制。不到一周后，尼日利亚加入联合国，正式参与国际外交。独立与改为共和国是两个不同步骤：君主制安排一直延续到1963年。分别理解这些日期，有助于认识到主权变更并不意味着所有制度立即更替，也不会自动消除国内分歧。

dateNote.en: Independence: 1 October 1960; UN admission: 7 October 1960. Republic status began in 1963. Lagos, rather than the later capital Abuja, anchors the 1960 event.
dateNote.zh: 独立日期为1960年10月1日，加入联合国为10月7日；1963年改为共和国。1960年的事件以当时首都拉各斯定位，而非后来的阿布贾。

en: Nigeria entered the UN six days after independence.
The 1960 federation and the 1963 republic are distinct constitutional milestones.
zh: 尼日利亚在独立六天后加入联合国。
1960年的联邦独立与1963年的共和国成立，是不同的宪制节点。

title.en: 1963: Kenya becomes independent
title.zh: 1963年：肯尼亚独立

summary.en: Kenya's independence on 12 December 1963 followed a transition that included elections and internal self-government earlier that year. Jomo Kenyatta became the independent country's prime minister, and Kenya joined the United Nations four days later. The legal end of British responsibility for government did not itself convert Kenya into a republic: that followed in December 1964. The sequence connects national liberation to the practical building of institutions, representation and diplomatic relations. It also makes a map's date meaningful: colonial status, self-government, independence and republican government describe different political arrangements.
summary.zh: 肯尼亚于1963年12月12日独立，此前同年已举行选举并取得内部自治。乔莫·肯雅塔成为独立国家的总理，肯尼亚四天后加入联合国。英国在法律上结束对当地政府的责任，并不等于肯尼亚同时成为共和国；共和制于1964年12月建立。这一过程把民族解放与制度建设、政治代表和外交关系联系起来，也提示我们区分殖民地、自治、独立及共和制等不同政治状态。

dateNote.en: Independence took effect on 12 December 1963 under the Kenya Independence Act. The republic was inaugurated on 12 December 1964.
dateNote.zh: 《肯尼亚独立法》规定独立于1963年12月12日生效；共和国于1964年12月12日成立。

en: Internal self-government in June 1963 preceded independence in December.
The UN admitted Kenya on 16 December 1963.
zh: 1963年6月的内部自治早于12月的独立。
联合国于1963年12月16日接纳肯尼亚。

title.en: 1964: Tanganyika and Zanzibar unite
title.zh: 1964年：坦噶尼喀与桑给巴尔联合

location.label: Dar es Salaam; representative mainland seat of the union

summary.en: Tanganyika and Zanzibar joined on 26 April 1964 to form one United Republic. Their separate memberships at the United Nations were continued as a single membership, giving documentary evidence of the constitutional change. The new country's name became Tanzania later that year. This was a union of two recently independent states, rather than the first independence of either territory. Comparing the mainland and island histories shows why state formation can involve joining political communities as well as separating them, and why a country name alone cannot describe the full sequence.
summary.zh: 1964年4月26日，坦噶尼喀与桑给巴尔联合成立一个联合共和国。两国原有的联合国会员身份合并为一个，为这一宪制变化留下了明确记录。新国家在同年稍后采用“坦桑尼亚”名称。这是两个刚获得独立的国家联合，而不是两地第一次独立。把大陆与岛屿的历史放在一起，可以看到国家形成既可能通过分离，也可能通过联合，单凭国名无法还原完整过程。

dateNote.en: Union: 26 April 1964. The UN records a later 1964 notification of the name United Republic of Tanzania; the entry does not backdate that name to either territory's earlier independence.
dateNote.zh: 联合发生于1964年4月26日。联合国记录了同年稍后关于“坦桑尼亚联合共和国”国名的通知；此处不把这一名称追溯到两地各自较早的独立时点。

en: Tanganyika and Zanzibar were separate UN members before the union.
The union date and the later adoption of the name Tanzania are separate events within 1964.
zh: 联合之前，坦噶尼喀与桑给巴尔分别拥有联合国会员身份。
联合日期与采用“坦桑尼亚”国名，是1964年内的两个不同节点。

sources.title: United Republic of Tanzania: member-state history
sources.evidenceNote: Ratification on 26 April, single UN membership and later name notification.

sources.title: History at the United Nations
sources.publisher: Permanent Mission of Tanzania to the United Nations
sources.evidenceNote: Tanganyika and Zanzibar's separate memberships and the union's diplomatic continuity.

title.en: Ur III: governing through clay records
title.zh: 乌尔第三王朝：泥板上的治理

location.label: Ur; representative royal centre of the Ur III state

summary.en: The Third Dynasty of Ur ruled a state whose administration left an unusually rich record in clay. Tablets tracked deliveries, labour and the distribution of food, while royal foundation objects presented kings as builders and protectors of temples. A surviving tablet from Umma lists beer, bread, oil and onions for messengers, bringing the everyday work of government into view. These documents let us compare official royal claims with routine accounting. They reveal organized institutions and unequal access to resources, without allowing one royal capital to stand for every community in southern Mesopotamia.
summary.zh: 乌尔第三王朝的行政活动留下了大量泥板记录，记载物资交付、劳役和食物分配；王室奠基物则把国王塑造为神庙的建造者与保护者。一块来自乌玛的泥板列出给信使配发的啤酒、面包、油和洋葱，使日常治理工作变得具体可见。把王室宣言与普通账目比较，可以研究制度运作和资源分配差异，但不能把一个王都等同于美索不达米亚南部所有社区。

dateNote.en: 2112–2004 BCE follows a conventional ancient Near Eastern chronology; absolute dates are approximate. The cited messenger-ration tablet is dated by its museum to about 2028 BCE and comes from Umma, not Ur.
dateNote.zh: 公元前2112—2004年采用常见的古代近东年代体系，绝对年代仍为近似值。所引信使配给泥板由博物馆定年为约前2028年，出土地为乌玛而非乌尔。

en: Royal foundation figures and administrative tablets preserve different kinds of evidence about authority.
A ration tablet identifies a regnal year, month and day as well as the goods supplied to messengers.
zh: 王室奠基像与行政泥板，保存了关于权力的不同类型证据。
一块配给泥板既记录信使领取的物资，也标明国王在位纪年、月份和日期。

sources.title: Cuneiform tablet: rations for messengers
sources.evidenceNote: Primary administrative object from Umma, approximately 2028 BCE, recording specified rations.

sources.title: Foundation figure of Ur-Namma
sources.evidenceNote: Primary royal foundation object and the conventional reign dates of Ur-Namma.

sources.title: Cuneiform tablet: receipt of metals
sources.evidenceNote: Collection record supplies the conventional 2112–2004 BCE Ur III period.

title.en: 626–539 BCE: Babylon's imperial revival
title.zh: 公元前626—539年：巴比伦帝国复兴

summary.en: Babylon became the centre of a new imperial dynasty after the weakening of Assyrian power. Under Nebuchadnezzar II, major building projects reshaped the city and royal inscriptions celebrated temple restoration and fortification. The empire also ruled through warfare and deportation, making its celebrated capital part of a wider history of coercion. Cyrus of Persia took Babylon in 539 BCE. Distinguishing this Neo-Babylonian state from Hammurabi's much earlier kingdom prevents a familiar city name from being mistaken for one continuous empire across more than a millennium.
summary.zh: 亚述权力衰落后，巴比伦成为新帝国王朝的中心。尼布甲尼撒二世时期，大规模工程重塑城市，王室铭文颂扬神庙修复与城防建设。帝国统治也伴随战争和人口迁徙，因此著名都城的繁荣需要放在更广泛的强制统治历史中理解。公元前539年，波斯的居鲁士攻取巴比伦。将新巴比伦国家与更早的汉谟拉比王国区分开来，可避免把同一城名误读为延续千余年的单一帝国。

dateNote.en: 626–539 BCE is the conventional Neo-Babylonian dynastic span used by UNESCO. It does not date Babylon's first settlement or imply that the empire held the same territory throughout.
dateNote.zh: 公元前626—539年是联合国教科文组织采用的新巴比伦王朝常见时段，并非城市最早建立的年代，也不意味着其疆域始终不变。

en: Babylon's older urban history substantially predates the Neo-Babylonian dynasty.
Royal building inscriptions describe what rulers wanted remembered; they are not neutral accounts of every subject's experience.
zh: 巴比伦的城市历史远早于新巴比伦王朝。
王室建筑铭文反映统治者希望被记住的事迹，并非所有臣民经历的中立记录。

sources.title: Babylon World Heritage property
sources.evidenceNote: Dynastic dates and the city’s Neo-Babylonian architectural and political significance.

sources.title: Nebuchadnezzar II East India House inscription
sources.evidenceNote: Primary royal building inscription preserved in an academic cuneiform database.

sources.title: Babylonia under the Achaemenids
sources.evidenceNote: Nabopolassar's accession, conquest and deportation under Nebuchadnezzar, and the Persian conquest of 539 BCE.

title.en: 762: Baghdad becomes an Abbasid capital
title.zh: 762年：巴格达成为阿拔斯都城

location.label: Baghdad; city-level reference, not an exact reconstruction of the Round City

summary.en: The Abbasid caliph al-Mansur founded Baghdad as a new capital in 762. Its planned circular centre made royal and administrative authority visible, while its location in Iraq reflected a shift in the caliphate's political focus from Syria. Baghdad later became a major centre of commerce, scholarship and book production. Very little of the original Abbasid city survives, so written descriptions and comparison with sites such as Samarra matter greatly. The foundation connects city planning to imperial government while showing why an attractive modern reconstruction is not the same as an excavated plan.
summary.zh: 阿拔斯哈里发曼苏尔于762年建立巴格达作为新都。规划中的圆形中心把王室与行政权威表现于城市空间，其伊拉克区位也反映哈里发国政治重心从叙利亚东移。巴格达后来成为商业、学术和书籍制作的重要中心。然而最初的阿拔斯城市遗存极少，研究需要依靠文字记载并与萨迈拉等遗址比较。这一案例把城市规划与帝国治理联系起来，也提醒我们区分现代复原图与考古实测平面。

dateNote.en: 762 is the foundation year of al-Mansur's capital. The point identifies Baghdad at city scale and does not claim a precise boundary for the largely lost Round City.
dateNote.zh: 762年指曼苏尔营建都城。点位仅在城市尺度上表示巴格达，不声称精确还原大部分已消失的圆城边界。

en: The Abbasid political centre moved eastward from Syria to Iraq.
Samarra's surviving remains are important comparative evidence because little early Abbasid Baghdad survives.
zh: 阿拔斯时期的政治中心由叙利亚向伊拉克东移。
早期阿拔斯巴格达遗存稀少，因此萨迈拉遗址具有重要比较价值。

sources.title: The Art of the Abbasid Period (750–1258)
sources.evidenceNote: Baghdad's 762 foundation, eastward political shift, urban form and limits of surviving architectural evidence.

sources.title: Al-Mansur
sources.evidenceNote: Institutional authority record identifies the Abbasid ruler and his foundation of Baghdad.

title.en: 1258: the Mongols take Baghdad
title.zh: 1258年：蒙古军攻陷巴格达

summary.en: Hülegü's Mongol army captured and sacked Baghdad in 1258, ending Abbasid rule from the city and killing the caliph al-Musta'sim. The destruction was a major rupture in political and urban life, but it did not end scholarship or artistic production throughout the Islamic world. Surviving Abbasids later held a largely ceremonial position in Mamluk Egypt, while Ilkhanid rulers developed their own centres of patronage. Following these different successors makes the event more intelligible than treating it as the sudden disappearance of an entire civilization.
summary.zh: 1258年，旭烈兀率领的蒙古军攻陷并劫掠巴格达，杀死哈里发穆斯台绥木，终结阿拔斯家族在该城的统治。这是政治与城市生活的重大断裂，但并不意味着整个伊斯兰世界的学术和艺术活动从此停止。幸存的阿拔斯后裔后来在马穆鲁克埃及保有主要属礼仪性的地位，伊儿汗统治者也发展了自己的文化赞助中心。追踪不同继承路径，比把事件描述为整种文明突然消失更有解释力。

dateNote.en: 1258 dates the capture and sack. This record ends Abbasid government in Baghdad, not every later institution using an Abbasid title; casualty totals are deliberately not estimated.
dateNote.zh: 1258年指攻陷与劫掠事件。此处终结的是巴格达的阿拔斯统治，而非所有后来沿用阿拔斯称号的制度；不采用难以确定的死亡人数。

en: The death of a capital's ruling dynasty did not erase all the intellectual networks associated with it.
Mamluk Egypt and Ilkhanid Iran provide two different contexts for studying the aftermath.
zh: 都城统治王朝的覆灭，并未抹去与之相关的全部知识网络。
马穆鲁克埃及与伊儿汗伊朗，为研究事件后果提供了不同背景。

sources.title: Hülegü
sources.evidenceNote: Authority record connects Hülegü with the capture of Baghdad in 1258.

sources.title: The Art of the Abbasid Period (750–1258)
sources.evidenceNote: End of Baghdad's Abbasid rule and nominal Abbasid continuation in Mamluk Egypt.

sources.title: The Art of the Ilkhanid Period (1256–1353)
sources.evidenceNote: Ilkhanid political succession and subsequent artistic patronage.

title.en: 1922–1923: from Ottoman sultanate to Turkish republic
title.zh: 1922—1923年：从奥斯曼苏丹制到土耳其共和国

location.label: Ankara; Grand National Assembly and new capital

summary.en: The Grand National Assembly abolished the Ottoman sultanate in November 1922 and proclaimed the Republic of Turkey in October 1923. Ankara became the capital shortly before the republican proclamation, shifting the institutional centre away from Istanbul. These were separate decisions made during the reconstruction of political authority after the First World War and the war in Anatolia. Tracking them prevents the Ottoman Empire from being carried indefinitely into a modern map. It also distinguishes a dynasty's end, a capital's relocation and the creation of a republican constitution as different kinds of change.
summary.zh: 土耳其大国民议会于1922年11月废除奥斯曼苏丹制，并于1923年10月宣布成立土耳其共和国。共和国宣布前不久，安卡拉成为首都，国家制度中心由伊斯坦布尔转移。这些不同决定发生于第一次世界大战与安纳托利亚战争之后的政治重建过程中。分别追踪这些节点，可避免把奥斯曼帝国无限延续到现代地图，也能区分王朝终结、迁都和确立共和政体等不同变化。

dateNote.en: Sultanate abolished: 1 November 1922; Ankara designated capital: 13 October 1923; republic proclaimed: 29 October 1923. These dates do not represent a single simultaneous transformation.
dateNote.zh: 苏丹制废除于1922年11月1日，安卡拉定都于1923年10月13日，共和国宣布于10月29日；三者并非同时发生。

en: The Ottoman sultanate ended before the republic was proclaimed.
Ankara became the capital sixteen days before the proclamation of the republic.
zh: 奥斯曼苏丹制先于共和国宣布而终结。
安卡拉在共和国宣布前十六天成为首都。

sources.title: History of the Turkish Grand National Assembly
sources.evidenceNote: The assembly's institutional history and the 29 October 1923 proclamation.

sources.title: Museum of the War of Independence
sources.evidenceNote: Documents the separate 1922 abolition, 1923 capital decision and republican proclamation.

title.en: 1906–1907: Iran's constitution and first parliament
title.zh: 1906—1907年：伊朗宪法与首届议会

summary.en: Iran's Constitutional Revolution brought a representative assembly into the Qajar monarchy and made the limits of royal power a subject of public political struggle. A decree in August 1906 authorized an assembly; a constitution followed in December, with a supplementary law in 1907. Merchants, clerics and other reformers participated, but they disagreed over sovereignty, religion and representation. The constitutional text therefore records a contested attempt to reorganize government, not the instant achievement of stable democracy. Its aftermath included a royal assault on parliament and renewed constitutional resistance.
summary.zh: 伊朗立宪革命把代议机构引入卡扎尔王朝，限制王权成为公开的政治斗争议题。1906年8月颁布设立议会的命令，12月制定宪法，1907年又通过补充法。商人、宗教人士与其他改革者共同参与，却在主权、宗教和代表权问题上存在分歧。因此，宪法文本记录的是一次充满争议的政府重组尝试，而非稳定民主的瞬间实现。此后还发生了王室攻击议会及立宪派重新抗争。

dateNote.en: This entry focuses on the 1906 constitution and 1907 supplement within the wider movement usually dated 1905–1911. It does not imply uninterrupted parliamentary rule after 1906.
dateNote.zh: 此处聚焦1906年宪法与1907年补充法；更广泛的革命通常定为1905—1911年。条目不表示1906年后议会始终连续运作。

en: The first Majles was an assembly within a monarchy, not a declaration of a republic.
The constitution and its supplementary law were adopted in different years.
zh: 首届议会是在君主制内建立，并非宣布成立共和国。
宪法与宪法补充法分别在不同年份通过。

sources.title: First Iranian Parliament, 1906
sources.evidenceNote: Contemporary photograph and institutional catalog context for the first assembly and August 1906 decree.

sources.title: Constitutional Revolution iii: the constitution
sources.evidenceNote: December 1906 constitution, October 1907 supplementary law and competing constitutional ideas.

sources.title: Constitutional Revolution i: an historical outline

title.en: 1648: negotiating the Peace of Westphalia
title.zh: 1648年：谈判缔结威斯特伐利亚和约

location.label: Münster; one of the two principal negotiating cities, with Osnabrück

summary.en: Treaties negotiated at Münster and Osnabrück ended the Thirty Years' War's central conflicts and revised political and religious arrangements in the Holy Roman Empire. The settlement confirmed rights of imperial estates, recognized Reformed Christianity alongside Catholicism and Lutheranism, and redistributed territories. Those estates still belonged to an imperial structure, with limits on their external alliances. The documents therefore illuminate negotiated, overlapping authority rather than the sudden invention of today's nation-state system. Studying their clauses is more informative than assuming the word sovereignty meant exactly the same thing everywhere after 1648.
summary.zh: 在明斯特与奥斯纳布吕克谈判的和约，结束了三十年战争的主要冲突，并调整神圣罗马帝国的政治与宗教安排。协议确认帝国等级的权利，在天主教和路德宗之外承认改革宗，并重新分配部分领土。但各等级仍属于帝国制度，其对外结盟受到限制。因此，条文展现的是协商形成、相互重叠的权力，而不是今日民族国家体系突然诞生。阅读具体条款，比假定1648年后各地“主权”含义完全一致更有帮助。

dateNote.en: The principal imperial treaties were signed on 24 October 1648 in the Gregorian calendar, also rendered 14 October under the Julian calendar. The map point represents Münster, not every negotiating venue.
dateNote.zh: 主要帝国和约于格里高利历1648年10月24日签署；采用儒略历的记载为10月14日。点位表示明斯特，而非所有谈判地点。

en: Two principal treaties were negotiated in different cities: Münster and Osnabrück.
The imperial estates' right to foreign alliances remained qualified by obligations to the Empire.
zh: 两份主要条约分别在明斯特和奥斯纳布吕克谈判。
帝国等级的对外结盟权，仍受到对帝国义务的限制。

sources.title: Peace Treaties of Westphalia, October 14/24, 1648
sources.publisher: German Historical Institute / German History in Documents and Images
sources.evidenceNote: Primary treaty excerpts with scholarly introduction on imperial institutions, religion and limited alliance rights.

sources.title: Münster and Osnabrück: sites of the Peace of Westphalia
sources.evidenceNote: Identifies the two treaty cities and the 1648 diplomatic settlement.

title.en: 1814–1815: redrawing Europe at Vienna
title.zh: 1814—1815年：维也纳会议重绘欧洲

summary.en: After Napoleon's first defeat, European powers met in Vienna to negotiate a political settlement. The Final Act reorganized territories and recognized arrangements including the German Confederation; questions concerning Poland and Saxony exposed competing dynastic and strategic interests. The agreement was signed before the Battle of Waterloo, so the settlement cannot simply be described as a reaction to that battle. Vienna shows how treaties combine legal claims, military leverage and compromise. Its boundaries need to be read alongside the interests of people living in the territories assigned by diplomats.
summary.zh: 拿破仑首次战败后，欧洲列强在维也纳会商政治安排。《最后议定书》重新划分领土，并确认德意志邦联等制度；波兰与萨克森问题凸显不同王朝和战略利益的竞争。议定书在滑铁卢战役之前已经签署，因此不能简单说成是该战役的结果。维也纳会议显示条约如何结合法律主张、军事力量与妥协；阅读外交官划定的边界时，还应考虑被划入这些领土的人们。

dateNote.en: Congress negotiations span 1814–1815. The Final Act was signed on 9 June 1815; Waterloo followed on 18 June.
dateNote.zh: 会议谈判跨越1814—1815年；《最后议定书》签署于1815年6月9日，滑铁卢战役随后发生于6月18日。

en: The congress created a German Confederation rather than a single unified German nation-state.
The Final Act predates Waterloo by nine days.
zh: 会议建立的是德意志邦联，而非单一统一的德国民族国家。
《最后议定书》比滑铁卢战役早九天。

sources.title: Acte du Congrès de Vienne, 9 June 1815
sources.evidenceNote: Digitized primary edition of the Final Act.

sources.title: Acte final du Congrès de Vienne
sources.evidenceNote: Primary treaty transcription, including territorial provisions and the German Confederation.

sources.title: Congress of Vienna, 1814–1815
sources.publisher: Library of Congress; UK Foreign Office historical handbook

title.en: 1861: the Kingdom of Italy is proclaimed
title.zh: 1861年：意大利王国宣布成立

location.label: Turin; first capital of the Kingdom of Italy

summary.en: The proclamation of the Kingdom of Italy placed much of the peninsula under Victor Emmanuel II of the House of Savoy. It followed wars, diplomacy, popular mobilization and Garibaldi's southern campaign, combining movements whose goals had not always agreed. Turin was the new kingdom's first capital. Venetia and Rome were not yet part of it: their incorporation followed in 1866 and 1870. The founding date therefore marks an important stage of unification, rather than the instant appearance of every later Italian border or a common political experience across all regions.
summary.zh: 意大利王国宣布成立后，半岛大部分地区由萨伏依王朝的维托里奥·埃马努埃莱二世统治。统一结合了战争、外交、民众动员与加里波第的南方远征，参与者的目标并不始终一致。新王国首都是都灵，威尼托与罗马此时尚未纳入，分别于1866和1870年加入。因此，1861年是统一的重要阶段，而不是此后所有意大利边界或各地共同政治经验瞬间形成的日期。

dateNote.en: The kingdom was proclaimed on 17 March 1861. Later territorial and capital changes are mentioned as context, not backdated to 1861.
dateNote.zh: 王国于1861年3月17日宣布成立。后来的领土与首都变化仅用于说明背景，不追溯到1861年。

en: Turin, not Rome, was the capital at the kingdom's foundation.
Venetia joined in 1866 and Rome in 1870, making unification a sequence rather than a single map change.
zh: 王国建立时首都是都灵，而非罗马。
威尼托于1866年、罗马于1870年并入，统一是一个连续过程。

sources.title: 17 March 1861: Victor Emmanuel II, first king of Italy
sources.publisher: Historical Archive of the Presidency of the Italian Republic
sources.evidenceNote: Proclamation in Turin and the subsequent territorial stages.

sources.title: Italy: summary of relations
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of State, Office of the Historian

title.en: 1918: Poland returns to Europe's political map
title.zh: 1918年：波兰重返欧洲政治地图

location.label: Warsaw; representative centre of the restored state

summary.en: The collapse of the empires that had partitioned Poland created an opening for a restored Polish state in 1918. On 11 November Józef Piłsudski received military authority from the Regency Council, a date later chosen for national commemoration. Building the state required bringing together territories with different legal, administrative and monetary systems. Wars and negotiations over borders continued after that date. Poland's restoration demonstrates why the birth of a government and the stabilization of its territory must be shown separately, especially when reading maps of the First World War's aftermath.
summary.zh: 瓜分波兰的帝国在1918年崩溃，为波兰恢复国家地位创造了条件。11月11日，毕苏斯基从摄政委员会接掌军事权力，这一日期后来成为国家纪念日。国家建设需要整合采用不同法律、行政和货币制度的地区；边界战争与谈判则在此后继续。波兰复国说明，建立政府与疆域逐渐稳定需要分别呈现，尤其是在阅读第一次世界大战结束后的地图时。

dateNote.en: 11 November 1918 is the commemorative milestone, not a claim that all borders were fixed that day. The official statistical history describes frontier struggles continuing in 1918–1922.
dateNote.zh: 1918年11月11日是纪念节点，不表示全部边界在当天确定。官方统计历史介绍指出，边界斗争持续于1918—1922年。

en: The restored state integrated territories previously governed by three partitioning powers.
A map labelled simply '1918 Poland' needs an observation date and an explanation of unsettled borders.
zh: 恢复的国家整合了此前由三个瓜分国统治的地区。
标为“1918年波兰”的地图，需要注明观察日期并说明当时未定的边界。

sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Poland
sources.evidenceNote: The 11 November 1918 commemorative milestone.

sources.title: National Independence Day: historical statistical context
sources.evidenceNote: The integration of partitioned territories and the 1918–1922 period of border struggles.

title.en: 1769: Watt patents a separate condenser
title.zh: 1769年：瓦特为分离式冷凝器取得专利

location.label: Glasgow; representative site of Watt's early experimental work

summary.en: James Watt improved an existing steam-engine tradition by condensing steam in a separate chamber, reducing the repeated heating and cooling of the engine cylinder. His 1769 patent protected this principle. The invention's significance lies in efficiency and practical engineering, not in the claim that Watt created the first steam engine. Turning an idea into reliable industrial equipment also required skilled makers, financing and further development. Linking the patent to later factories, mines and transport helps explain industrialization as a network of technical and social changes rather than one inventor's isolated breakthrough.
summary.zh: 詹姆斯·瓦特在已有蒸汽机技术上改进，把蒸汽冷凝移到独立腔室，减少气缸反复加热与冷却造成的浪费。1769年专利保护了这一原理。其重要性在于效率与工程实践，而不是瓦特“发明第一台蒸汽机”。把构想变成可靠工业设备，还需要熟练工匠、资金和后续开发。将专利与矿山、工厂及交通联系起来，可把工业化理解为技术和社会变化的网络。

dateNote.en: The patent was granted on 5 January 1769. Glasgow is a representative location for Watt's early work; the patent year is not the date of the first steam engine or of every later commercial application.
dateNote.zh: 专利授予于1769年1月5日。格拉斯哥代表瓦特早期研究地点；这一年份不是第一台蒸汽机出现或所有后来商业应用的日期。

en: Separating condensation helped keep the working cylinder hot.
A patent documents a protected technical claim; commercial adoption can require many further years.
zh: 把冷凝过程分离，有助于使工作气缸保持高温。
专利记录受保护的技术主张；商业推广仍可能需要多年。

sources.title: James Watt and the separate condenser
sources.evidenceNote: Curatorial account of the 5 January 1769 patent, experimental problem and condenser principle.

sources.title: James Watt: collection authority record
sources.evidenceNote: Explains Watt's improvement of earlier engines and the separate condensation chamber.

title.en: 1757: Plassey and the Company's political power
title.zh: 1757年：普拉西战役与公司的政治权力

summary.en: At Plassey, the East India Company's army defeated Bengal's nawab Siraj-ud-Daulah. The outcome depended on political collusion as well as fighting: Mir Jafar, one of the nawab's commanders, had agreed with Company representatives and influential bankers to replace him. Indian soldiers formed a large part of the Company's force. The victory greatly increased the Company's leverage in Bengal, but it did not place all India under British rule in one day. Plassey reveals how a trading corporation became a territorial power through local alliances, military force and access to wealth.
summary.zh: 普拉西战役中，东印度公司军队击败孟加拉纳瓦布西拉杰·乌德·达乌拉。结果不仅取决于战斗，还与政治合谋有关：纳瓦布的将领米尔·贾法尔已与公司代表及有影响力的银行家达成取代他的安排。公司军队本身也包含大量印度士兵。胜利大幅增强公司在孟加拉的影响力，却没有使整个印度在一天内归于英国。该事件展示贸易公司如何通过地方联盟、武力和财富取得领土权力。

dateNote.en: The battle took place on 23 June 1757. This is a battlefield event, not the beginning of uniform British sovereignty over the entire subcontinent.
dateNote.zh: 战役发生于1757年6月23日。这是一次战场事件，不代表英国对整个次大陆的统一主权从当天开始。

en: The Company's army included Indian sepoys alongside European troops.
Mir Jafar's prior agreement to replace the nawab makes political alliance essential to explaining the result.
zh: 公司军队包括印度兵及欧洲军人。
米尔·贾法尔事先同意取代纳瓦布，政治联盟是解释战果的重要因素。

sources.title: Battle of Plassey
sources.evidenceNote: Battle date, army composition, banking interests, Mir Jafar's agreement and consequences in Bengal.

sources.title: Plan of the Battle of Plassey, 1757
sources.evidenceNote: Contemporary battle-plan object; a military perspective to read alongside the political context.

title.en: 1858: Company government gives way to Crown rule
title.zh: 1858年：印度由公司统治转为王室统治

summary.en: After the rebellion of 1857, the British government transferred responsibility for governing its Indian possessions from the East India Company to the Crown. Queen Victoria's proclamation was publicly read at Allahabad on 1 November 1858. It announced a new relationship with princes and subjects, including promises concerning religion and treaties. Those promises must be distinguished from how colonial government actually operated. The change replaced the governing authority rather than making India independent, and princely states continued to have a different relationship to British power from directly administered provinces.
summary.zh: 1857年起义之后，英国政府把其在印度属地的治理责任从东印度公司转交王室。1858年11月1日，维多利亚女王的公告在阿拉哈巴德公开宣读，宣布与王公及臣民的新关系，并作出有关宗教与条约的承诺。阅读公告时需要区分官方承诺与殖民治理实践。此次变化更换的是统治机构，并非印度独立；土邦与英国权力的关系，也不同于由英国直接管理的省份。

dateNote.en: 1858 dates the transfer to Crown government; the public proclamation was read on 1 November at Allahabad. The event should not be confused with the later 1876 imperial title or 1947 independence.
dateNote.zh: 1858年指转为王室政府统治，公告于11月1日在阿拉哈巴德宣读；不能与1876年的皇帝称号或1947年独立混淆。

en: A Secretary of State for India in Britain replaced the Company's governing machinery.
The proclamation's promises are primary evidence of official policy, not proof that those promises were fulfilled.
zh: 英国设立印度事务大臣，取代公司的统治机构。
公告中的承诺是官方政策的一手证据，并不证明承诺已被落实。

sources.title: Government of the Raj, 1858–1914
sources.evidenceNote: Institutional transfer to Crown rule and the Secretary of State for India.

sources.title: Queen Victoria's proclamation, published at Allahabad
sources.evidenceNote: Primary proclamation and its publication on 1 November 1858.

sources.title: Queen Victoria's proclamation to the princes, chiefs and peoples of India
sources.evidenceNote: Contemporary visual record of the proclamation ceremony.

title.en: 1949–1950: India adopts a republican constitution
title.zh: 1949—1950年：印度制定共和宪法

summary.en: India's Constituent Assembly adopted a constitution on 26 November 1949; most provisions came into force on 26 January 1950, establishing the republic. The text organized a union of states, guaranteed fundamental rights and based parliamentary and state-assembly elections on adult suffrage. This was another major transformation after independence and partition in 1947, not a second date for the same event. Reading the original articles reveals how constitutional authors linked representation, citizenship and government. Their legal commitments offer a standard against which implementation can be examined, rather than proof that inequalities immediately disappeared.
summary.zh: 印度制宪会议于1949年11月26日通过宪法，大部分条款于1950年1月26日生效，共和国由此建立。宪法组织了联邦各邦，规定基本权利，并以成年公民选举权为人民院和邦议会选举的基础。这是1947年独立与分治之后的另一重大转型，而不是同一事件的第二个日期。阅读原始条文，可以理解制宪者如何联系代表权、公民身份与治理；法律承诺则提供衡量实践的标准，并不意味着不平等立即消失。

dateNote.en: Adoption: 26 November 1949; general commencement: 26 January 1950. Article 394 brought specified provisions into force earlier, so 'the entire constitution began on one day' would be imprecise.
dateNote.zh: 通过日期为1949年11月26日，主要生效日期为1950年1月26日。第394条规定部分条款先行生效，因此不能笼统地说整部宪法在同一天开始施行。

en: Original Article 326 established adult suffrage at age twenty-one, subject to specified legal disqualifications.
Article 3 provided a process for altering the areas, boundaries or names of states within the union.
zh: 原始第326条规定年满二十一岁的成年公民选举权，并列明法定例外。
第3条规定了调整联邦内部各邦面积、边界或名称的程序。

sources.publisher: Government of India, Gazette of India
sources.evidenceNote: Primary promulgated constitutional text.

title.en: 1948: Ceylon becomes an independent dominion
title.zh: 1948年：锡兰以自治领形式独立

location.label: Colombo; representative capital of independent Ceylon

summary.en: Ceylon became independent from Britain on 4 February 1948 under a dominion constitution. Parliamentary government operated with the British monarch still formally head of state, showing that independence did not always begin with a republic. The constitutional process had included elections in 1947 and the formation of a local government before the transfer of sovereignty. The island's later republican name, Sri Lanka, belongs to a different constitutional moment. Comparing Ceylon with India and Burma shows several institutional paths out of British rule, even when the transitions occurred within a few years of one another.
summary.zh: 1948年2月4日，锡兰根据自治领宪制脱离英国统治而独立。议会政府运作时，英国君主仍是形式上的国家元首，说明独立并不总以共和国开始。主权转移之前，1947年已经举行选举并组建本地政府。后来共和国采用的“斯里兰卡”名称属于另一宪制阶段。把锡兰与印度、缅甸比较，可以看到时间相近的去殖民化也可能采用不同制度路径。

dateNote.en: Independence: 4 February 1948. The historical state name here is Ceylon; republican status and the name Sri Lanka followed in 1972.
dateNote.zh: 独立日期为1948年2月4日，当时国名为锡兰；共和制与斯里兰卡国名属于1972年的变化。

en: The 1948 settlement made Ceylon independent while retaining the monarchy.
Independent dominion, republic and national name are separate features that can change on different dates.
zh: 1948年的安排使锡兰独立，同时保留君主制。
独立自治领、共和国及国名是不同要素，可以在不同日期发生变化。

title.en: 2008: Nepal's assembly ends the monarchy
title.zh: 2008年：尼泊尔制宪会议终结君主制

summary.en: At its first meeting on 28 May 2008, Nepal's elected Constituent Assembly implemented the decision to establish a federal democratic republic and end the monarchy. The vote was part of a peace and constitutional transition, rather than a routine succession from one king to another. Declaring a republic settled one central institutional question, while drafting a durable constitutional order remained a separate task. Nepal illustrates how a country's political system can change dramatically without becoming a different point on the map, and why constitutional transitions deserve attention alongside territorial boundaries.
summary.zh: 2008年5月28日，尼泊尔经选举产生的制宪会议首次开会，落实建立联邦民主共和国、终结君主制的决定。这是和平与宪制转型的一部分，而不是国王之间的普通继承。宣布共和解决了一项核心制度问题，制定持久的宪法秩序则仍是另一项任务。尼泊尔说明，一个国家即使在地图上位置未变，其政治制度也可能发生深刻变化，因而研究地图时也应关注宪制转型。

dateNote.en: The Constituent Assembly acted on 28 May 2008. This event is the republican decision, not the completion date of Nepal's later constitution.
dateNote.zh: 制宪会议于2008年5月28日作出决定。此处记录共和制决定，并非尼泊尔后来宪法完成的日期。

en: The assembly's vote to implement the republic was 560 to 4, as reported by UNMIN.
A declaration of the form of state and the completion of a constitution need not happen together.
zh: 联合国尼泊尔特派团记录，共和制决定的表决结果为560票对4票。
确定国家政体与完成宪法，并不必然同时发生。

title.en: 1868: the Meiji Restoration and a program of change
title.zh: 1868年：明治维新与改革纲领

location.label: Kyoto; imperial court and the 1868 Charter Oath

summary.en: The overthrow of Tokugawa government brought a new coalition to power in the emperor's name. The Charter Oath, issued in April 1868, announced deliberation, reform of established practices and the pursuit of knowledge from abroad. These promises linked institutional change to the strengthening of imperial government; they did not create parliamentary democracy immediately. Later constitutional debates drew on the oath in different ways. Beginning with this document makes it possible to investigate how leaders justified transformation and how readers interpreted its broad language, rather than treating modernization as an automatic or uniform process.
summary.zh: 德川政权被推翻后，一个新政治联盟以天皇名义掌权。1868年4月公布的《五条誓文》宣布推进讨论、改革旧习并向世界求取知识。这些承诺把制度变化与加强皇权联系起来，并未立即建立议会民主。后来不同政治力量又以不同方式引用誓文参与宪政争论。从这份文件出发，可以研究领导人如何论证改革、读者如何理解宽泛的措辞，而不把现代化视为自动且一致的过程。

dateNote.en: 1868 marks the restoration and the April Charter Oath. It does not compress the subsequent civil war, abolition of domains or 1889 constitution into one year.
dateNote.zh: 1868年指维新及4月公布的《五条誓文》，不把随后的内战、废藩置县或1889年宪法压缩到同一年。

en: The Charter Oath was issued in the emperor's name by the leaders of the new government.
Its call to seek knowledge abroad linked learning with the project of strengthening imperial rule.
zh: 《五条誓文》由新政府领导者以天皇名义公布。
向世界求取知识的号召，与加强天皇统治的目标相联系。

sources.evidenceNote: Primary translation and scholarly introduction to the oath's authorship, timing and clauses.

title.en: 1945–1948: occupation zones become rival Korean states
title.zh: 1945—1948年：占领区演变为两个朝鲜半岛国家

location.label: Seoul; representative southern political centre, not the whole dividing line

summary.en: Japan's defeat ended its colonial rule in Korea, but the peninsula was divided into Soviet and American occupation zones at the 38th parallel. The line initially organized military responsibility for receiving Japan's surrender. Efforts to agree on a unified political settlement failed, and separate governments were established in 1948: the Republic of Korea in the south and the Democratic People's Republic of Korea in the north. The sequence shows how a temporary military arrangement could harden into political division. The 1945 parallel must also be distinguished from the military demarcation line negotiated after the Korean War.
summary.zh: 日本战败结束了其对朝鲜半岛的殖民统治，但半岛沿北纬三十八度线划分为苏联与美国占领区。这条线最初用于安排接受日军投降的军事责任。统一政治安排未能实现，1948年南方成立大韩民国，北方成立朝鲜民主主义人民共和国。这一过程说明，临时军事安排可能逐渐固化为政治分裂。1945年的三十八度线也必须与朝鲜战争后谈判确定的军事分界线区分。

dateNote.en: The record spans occupation in 1945 and the establishment of separate governments in 1948. It does not depict the 1953 armistice line as if it already existed in 1945.
dateNote.zh: 条目涵盖1945年占领区划分至1948年两个政府建立，不把1953年停战分界线提前用于1945年。

en: The 38th parallel began as an occupation boundary, not an ancient frontier between two Korean nations.
The north and south established separate states in 1948, before the war began in 1950.
zh: 三十八度线最初是占领分界，不是两个朝鲜民族国家之间的古老国界。
南北两个国家建立于1948年，早于1950年战争爆发。

title.en: 1950–1953: war and armistice in Korea
title.zh: 1950—1953年：朝鲜战争与停战

summary.en: North Korean forces invaded South Korea on 25 June 1950, beginning a war that drew in a U.S.-led United Nations Command and later Chinese forces. Front lines moved dramatically before negotiations produced the armistice of July 1953. The agreement suspended hostilities, established a military demarcation line and created a demilitarized buffer zone. It was a military settlement pending a political peace, not a peace treaty that resolved every dispute. Reading its accompanying maps matters: the resulting line followed the negotiated military situation rather than simply restoring the straight 38th parallel.
summary.zh: 1950年6月25日，朝鲜军队进攻韩国，战争随后卷入美国领导的联合国军及后来参战的中国军队。战线多次大幅移动，谈判最终促成1953年7月停战协定。协定停止敌对行动，设立军事分界线与非军事缓冲区。它是等待政治和平解决的军事安排，而非解决所有争议的和平条约。阅读附图十分重要：分界线依据谈判后的军事态势划定，并非简单恢复笔直的三十八度线。

dateNote.en: War began on 25 June 1950; the armistice was signed on 27 July 1953 and the ceasefire took effect that evening. The finite entry covers these events, not a claim about the conflict's legal status in every later year.
dateNote.zh: 战争始于1950年6月25日；停战协定于1953年7月27日签署，并于当晚实施停火。有限时段仅指这些事件，不对之后每一年的冲突法律状态作统一断言。

en: The agreement required each side to withdraw two kilometres from the military demarcation line.
The signatories represented military commands; the document anticipated a later peaceful political settlement.
zh: 协定要求双方各自从军事分界线后撤两公里。
签署方代表军事指挥机构；文件预期此后达成和平政治解决。

sources.evidenceNote: Primary agreement: preamble, demarcation maps, two-kilometre withdrawals and ceasefire provisions.

sources.publisher: U.S. Department of State, Office of the Historian

title.en: 1895: the Treaty of Shimonoseki changes East Asia
title.zh: 1895年：《马关条约》改变东亚格局

summary.en: The treaty ending the Sino-Japanese War required Qing China to recognize Korea's independence, cede Taiwan and the Penghu Islands to Japan, and pay a large indemnity. It initially also ceded the Liaodong Peninsula, but intervention by Russia, France and Germany led Japan to relinquish that acquisition. The sequence changed regional power and exposed the difference between a signed treaty's first terms and the settlement ultimately implemented. The treaty's recognition of Korean independence must not be confused with Japan's later annexation of Korea, and its signature did not end resistance to Japanese control in Taiwan.
summary.zh: 结束甲午战争的《马关条约》要求清朝承认朝鲜独立，将台湾与澎湖割让日本，并支付巨额赔款。最初条款还包括辽东半岛，但俄罗斯、法国与德国干涉后，日本放弃这一所得。事件改变了东亚权力格局，也显示最初签署条款与最后实施安排可能不同。条约承认朝鲜独立，不能与日本后来吞并朝鲜混同；签约也不意味着台湾对日本统治的抵抗立即停止。

dateNote.en: Signed on 17 April 1895. The initial Liaodong cession was reversed through further diplomacy in the same year; this entry does not treat its first territorial clauses as a permanent map.
dateNote.zh: 条约签署于1895年4月17日。辽东割让在同年的后续外交中被撤回，因此不能把最初领土条款直接当作永久地图。

en: The treaty distinguished Korea's status from the cession of Taiwan and Penghu.
Japan's return of Liaodong shows why later agreements must be checked before drawing a treaty-based border.
zh: 条约分别处理朝鲜地位与台湾、澎湖割让，两者性质不同。
日本归还辽东说明，根据条约绘制边界之前，还需核查后续协议。

title.en: 1443–1446: designing a script for Korean
title.zh: 1443—1446年：为朝鲜语设计文字

location.label: Hanseong, now Seoul; Joseon royal court

summary.en: King Sejong's court developed a new writing system for Korean, completed in 1443 and explained in the 1446 Hunminjeongeum. Its commentary described how the letters worked and gave examples, making the design itself part of the surviving evidence. The initial system had twenty-eight letters and addressed the difficulty of writing Korean through Chinese characters and adapted systems. Its creation did not instantly replace existing literary practices. Studying the manuscript and later uses shows how the design of a script can widen possibilities for communication while its social adoption unfolds over a much longer period.
summary.zh: 世宗朝廷设计了新的朝鲜语文字，1443年完成，1446年通过《训民正音》加以说明。解例解释字母原理并提供实例，使文字的设计过程本身成为可研究的证据。最初体系含二十八个字母，回应了使用汉字及其改写方式记录朝鲜语的困难。新文字并未立即取代原有书写实践。比较原始文献与后来的应用，可以看到文字设计如何扩大表达机会，而社会推广则经历更长过程。

dateNote.en: Completion in 1443 and publication in the ninth lunar month of 1446 are distinct milestones. The dates identify the documented design and promulgation, not universal literacy.
dateNote.zh: 1443年完成设计与1446年农历九月刊行，是不同节点；这些日期指有文献支持的创制和公布，并不代表全民识字已经实现。

en: The 1446 Haerye edition includes explanations and examples, not just a list of letters.
The original system had twenty-eight letters; it should not be described as identical in every detail to modern Hangul.
zh: 1446年的《解例本》包含原理说明与用例，而不仅是字母表。
原始体系有二十八个字母，不能说它在所有细节上都等同于现代韩文。

sources.evidenceNote: Manuscript's 1443/1446 chronology, explanations and provenance.

sources.title: Hunminjeongeum: the design of a writing system
sources.evidenceNote: Twenty-eight-letter design, existing transcription practices and later social uses.

title.en: 1967: five states establish ASEAN
title.zh: 1967年：五国建立东盟

summary.en: Representatives of Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore and Thailand signed the Bangkok Declaration to establish the Association of Southeast Asian Nations. The short document proposed cooperation in economic, social, cultural, technical and educational fields, alongside regional peace and stability. It created an association of sovereign states rather than a new country. Its founding membership must be distinguished from the organization's later expansion. Reading the declaration beside the region's independence stories shows governments trying to build common institutions after colonial rule and regional conflict, while retaining separate national authority.
summary.zh: 印度尼西亚、马来西亚、菲律宾、新加坡和泰国代表签署《曼谷宣言》，建立东南亚国家联盟。简短的文件提出经济、社会、文化、技术和教育合作，以及地区和平与稳定目标。它建立的是主权国家的协会，而不是一个新国家；创始成员也应与后来扩大的成员范围区分。把宣言与本地区独立历史并读，可以看到各国政府在殖民统治和地区冲突之后尝试合作，同时保留各自国家权力。

dateNote.en: The Bangkok Declaration was signed on 8 August 1967. This entry describes the five founders, not membership at a later date.
dateNote.zh: 《曼谷宣言》签署于1967年8月8日。此处记录五个创始国，不将后来的成员范围追溯到成立时。

en: Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore and Thailand were the five founding members.
The declaration included cultural and educational cooperation as well as economic and political goals.
zh: 印度尼西亚、马来西亚、菲律宾、新加坡与泰国是五个创始成员。
宣言除经济和政治目标外，也包括文化与教育合作。

sources.evidenceNote: Primary founding declaration with signatories and purposes.

title.en: 1948: Burma becomes an independent republic
title.zh: 1948年：缅甸成为独立共和国

location.label: Rangoon, now Yangon; capital at independence

summary.en: The Union of Burma became independent on 4 January 1948. Unlike several other former British territories, it began as a republic outside the Commonwealth, rather than an independent dominion sharing the British monarch. Independence followed negotiations over the relationship between the central government and different communities and territories. It did not settle all those questions, and armed conflict followed. The founding date therefore identifies a transfer of sovereignty, not a completed national consensus. Rangoon was the capital at this moment; using a later capital would obscure the historical geography of the transition.
summary.zh: 缅甸联邦于1948年1月4日独立。它与一些其他前英国属地不同，直接采用英联邦之外的共和国形式，而非共同奉英国君主为元首的独立自治领。独立之前，各方就中央政府与不同社群、地区的关系进行谈判，但这些问题并未全部解决，随后仍爆发武装冲突。因此，独立日期标志主权转移，而非全国共识已经完成。当时首都为仰光，使用后来的首都定位会掩盖转型的历史地理。

dateNote.en: 4 January 1948 is the appointed day in the Burma Independence Act. This entry uses the contemporary name Burma and the contemporary capital Rangoon.
dateNote.zh: 《缅甸独立法》规定生效日为1948年1月4日；条目采用当时国名及首都仰光定位。

en: The independence act ended British responsibility on a specified date and did not create a dominion.
Negotiating independence and resolving the state's internal political relationships were separate challenges.
zh: 独立法在指定日期结束英国责任，没有建立自治领。
谈判取得独立与解决国家内部政治关系，是不同挑战。

sources.title: Burma Independence Act 1947
sources.evidenceNote: Primary act defines 4 January 1948 and independence outside the King's dominions.

sources.title: Burma: recognition history

title.en: 1957: the Federation of Malaya becomes independent
title.zh: 1957年：马来亚联合邦独立

summary.en: Tunku Abdul Rahman proclaimed the independence of the Federation of Malaya at Stadium Merdeka on 31 August 1957. The ceremony and constitutional documents marked the end of British rule over the federation while establishing its own constitutional government. The historical name matters: this was Malaya, not the larger Malaysia formed in 1963. Singapore's later separation in 1965 was yet another event. Reading the original proclamation alongside those later changes helps prevent a modern country outline from being projected backward onto an earlier political arrangement.
summary.zh: 1957年8月31日，东姑阿都拉曼在吉隆坡独立体育场宣布马来亚联合邦独立。典礼与宪制文件标志英国对联合邦统治的结束及其自身宪政政府的建立。历史名称十分重要：这是马来亚，而不是1963年成立、范围更大的马来西亚；1965年新加坡分离又是另一事件。把独立宣言与后来变化联系起来，有助于避免将现代国家轮廓投射到较早的政治安排上。

dateNote.en: Malayan independence: 31 August 1957. Formation of Malaysia in 1963 and Singapore's independence in 1965 are distinct events and require different map dates.
dateNote.zh: 马来亚独立于1957年8月31日。1963年马来西亚成立及1965年新加坡独立是不同事件，需要分别标注地图日期。

en: The proclamation was read at Stadium Merdeka in Kuala Lumpur.
The Federation of Malaya and the later Federation of Malaysia should not be treated as interchangeable historical names.
zh: 独立宣言在吉隆坡独立体育场宣读。
马来亚联合邦与后来的马来西亚联邦，不应作为可随意互换的历史名称。

sources.title: Proclamation of Independence in Malay-Jawi, 31 August 1957
sources.evidenceNote: Primary proclamation preserved in the national archival catalog.

sources.title: Handing over the constitutional instrument, 31 August 1957
sources.evidenceNote: Contemporary photograph of the constitutional transfer at Stadium Merdeka.

title.en: 1946: the Philippines gains independence from the United States
title.zh: 1946年：菲律宾脱离美国统治而独立

summary.en: The United States recognized the Republic of the Philippines as independent on 4 July 1946, and the two governments signed a Treaty of General Relations in Manila. The treaty formally relinquished U.S. sovereignty while reserving questions concerning agreed military bases. This settlement followed decades of Filipino struggle, American colonial government and devastating wartime occupation. It must be distinguished from the Filipino declaration of independence in 1898. Comparing the proclamation and treaty shows how legal independence and continuing strategic or economic relationships can coexist, without making either the earlier independence movement or the later transfer disappear.
summary.zh: 1946年7月4日，美国承认菲律宾共和国独立，两国政府在马尼拉签署《一般关系条约》。条约正式放弃美国主权，同时保留双方商定军事基地的相关安排。这一结果发生于菲律宾长期抗争、美国殖民统治及破坏严重的战争占领之后，必须与1898年菲律宾宣布独立区分。比较公告与条约，可以理解法律独立如何与持续的战略、经济关系并存，同时保留早期独立运动与后来主权转移各自的意义。

dateNote.en: Independence recognized as of 4 July 1946; treaty signed that day. The treaty's formal ratification and entry into force came later, so signature and legal commencement should not be conflated.
dateNote.zh: 独立自1946年7月4日起获得承认，条约也在当天签署。条约正式批准和生效发生于其后，因此不能混淆签署与条约生效。

en: The treaty names both independence and the relinquishment of American sovereignty.
The 1898 Filipino declaration and the 1946 end of U.S. rule identify different stages of the independence struggle.
zh: 条约同时明确了菲律宾独立与美国放弃主权。
1898年的菲律宾独立宣言与1946年美国统治终结，属于独立斗争的不同阶段。

sources.publisher: Supreme Court of the Philippines E-Library
sources.evidenceNote: Primary treaty, including effective recognition, relinquishment of sovereignty, military-base reservation and signature.

sources.title: Proclamation 2695: Independence of the Philippines
sources.evidenceNote: Primary presidential proclamation recognizing independence on 4 July 1946.

title.en: 1826: Britain links three Straits ports
title.zh: 1826年：英国将三个海峡港口合并管理

location.label: George Town, Penang; representative early administrative centre

summary.en: Penang, Malacca and Singapore were grouped as the Straits Settlements in 1826 under British administration. The grouping linked separate ports along a heavily travelled maritime corridor; it did not turn the whole Malay Peninsula into one directly ruled colony. Archival maps and legal documents reveal how imperial government sought to organize trade, courts and administration across these places. Local communities also continued to use their own authorities and customs in everyday disputes. The port network connects earlier regional maritime histories with the later, distinct political histories of Malaysia and Singapore.
summary.zh: 1826年，槟城、马六甲与新加坡被合并为英国管理的海峡殖民地。这一安排把繁忙海路上的不同港口连接起来，并未使整个马来半岛成为一个直接统治的殖民地。档案地图与法律文件展现帝国如何跨港口组织贸易、法院与行政；地方社群处理日常争端时，也继续依赖自身权威与习惯。该港口网络把较早的区域海洋史，与后来马来西亚、新加坡各自的政治历史联系起来。

dateNote.en: 1826 dates the administrative grouping. The later 1867 transfer to a Crown colony was a separate institutional change; this event does not imply one unchanged colonial arrangement until independence.
dateNote.zh: 1826年指行政合并。1867年改由英国殖民部管理、成为直辖殖民地，是另一制度变化；不能据此认为此后直至独立始终采用同一殖民安排。

en: The three core ports were Penang, Malacca and Singapore.
A shared colonial administration did not make all communities use identical legal practices.
zh: 三个核心港口是槟城、马六甲与新加坡。
共同殖民行政机构并不意味着所有社群采用完全一致的法律实践。

sources.evidenceNote: Archival exhibition on 1826 grouping, the charter and continuing local dispute-resolution practices.

title.en: 1803: the United States purchases France's Louisiana claim
title.zh: 1803年：美国购买法国在路易斯安那的领土主张

location.label: New Orleans; Lower Louisiana transfer ceremony

summary.en: France and the United States agreed to the Louisiana Purchase in April 1803, with a total price of fifteen million dollars. Control of New Orleans and access to the Mississippi were central commercial concerns. The agreement transferred an immense European colonial claim across lands already inhabited and governed by Indigenous peoples; it did not make those societies disappear or document their consent. The transfer ceremony in New Orleans followed in December. Comparing treaty language with Indigenous histories reveals why a diplomatic purchase and effective, legitimate control over every place are different questions.
summary.zh: 1803年4月，法国与美国达成路易斯安那购地协议，总价一千五百万美元。新奥尔良控制权与密西西比河通行，是重要商业关切。协议转移的是覆盖广阔地域的欧洲殖民领土主张，这些土地原本已有原住民居住并治理；协议既没有使这些社会消失，也不证明他们同意。新奥尔良交接仪式在12月举行。把条约与原住民历史比较，可以区分外交购买、实际控制和统治正当性等不同问题。

dateNote.en: Treaty dated 30 April 1803; Lower Louisiana transferred at New Orleans on 20 December 1803. Transfer procedures elsewhere and subsequent boundary negotiations had their own dates.
dateNote.zh: 条约日期为1803年4月30日，下路易斯安那于12月20日在新奥尔良交接；其他地点的交接和此后边界谈判另有各自日期。

en: The purchase comprised treaty and financial arrangements, with a total price of $15 million.
The land was populated by Indigenous communities; the treaty between France and the United States did not represent their consent.
zh: 购地包括领土和财务安排，总价为一千五百万美元。
土地上已有原住民社群，法美之间的条约不代表这些社群的同意。

sources.evidenceNote: Primary treaty and financial documents, date, price and the overlooked impact on Indigenous peoples.

sources.title: Louisiana Territory officially transferred

title.en: 1867: Alaska passes from Russian to U.S. administration
title.zh: 1867年：阿拉斯加由俄国转入美国管理

summary.en: Russia and the United States signed a treaty for Alaska in March 1867, followed by the formal transfer at Sitka in October. The purchase price was 7.2 million dollars, paid through a treasury warrant issued the following year. Alaska Native peoples were not consulted, and the treaty's citizenship provisions explicitly treated Indigenous communities differently from other inhabitants. The episode therefore documents a transfer between imperial governments rather than an agreement by everyone who lived there. Reading the treaty beside Indigenous perspectives makes the political change visible without erasing the region's existing societies.
summary.zh: 俄国与美国于1867年3月签署阿拉斯加条约，10月在锡特卡举行正式交接。价款为七百二十万美元，次年才签发付款凭证。阿拉斯加原住民没有参与协商，条约的公民身份条款也把原住民社群与其他居民区别对待。因此，这是一场帝国政府之间的转让，并非所有当地居民共同同意的协议。把条约与原住民视角并读，可以呈现政治变化而不抹去既有社会。

dateNote.en: Treaty signed: 30 March 1867; formal transfer: 18 October 1867; payment warrant: 1 August 1868. These separate dates explain why an 1868 financial document can record an 1867 acquisition.
dateNote.zh: 条约签署于1867年3月30日，正式交接于10月18日，付款凭证签发于1868年8月1日。区分这些日期，可解释1868年财务文件为何记录1867年的购地。

en: The treaty's Article III differentiated citizenship rights using a discriminatory classification of Native peoples.
Alaska Native consent was not obtained in the transaction between Russia and the United States.
zh: 条约第三条以歧视性的原住民分类区别规定公民权利。
俄美之间的交易没有取得阿拉斯加原住民同意。

title.en: 1869: railroad lines meet at Promontory Summit
title.zh: 1869年：铁路在普罗蒙特里峰连接

location.label: Promontory Summit, Utah; railway junction ceremony

summary.en: The Central Pacific and Union Pacific railroads met at Promontory Summit on 10 May 1869, completing the principal link in the United States' first transcontinental railroad. Chinese workers were essential to the Central Pacific's construction, including difficult mountain and desert sections. Federal subsidies and land grants made the project an instrument of state-backed expansion as well as transport engineering. The routes crossed Indigenous homelands and helped accelerate settler intrusion and dispossession. Following the rails therefore reveals both new connections and unequal consequences, rather than a story of technology acting separately from labour and political power.
summary.zh: 1869年5月10日，中央太平洋铁路与联合太平洋铁路在普罗蒙特里峰接轨，完成美国第一条横贯大陆铁路的主要连接。华工对中央太平洋铁路建设不可或缺，包括艰难的山地与沙漠路段。联邦补贴和土地拨赠，使铁路既是交通工程，也是国家支持扩张的工具。线路穿过原住民家园，并加速移民进入与土地剥夺。沿铁路阅读历史，既能看到新联系，也能理解劳动和政治权力造成的不平等后果。

dateNote.en: The joining ceremony was on 10 May 1869 at Promontory Summit, not Promontory Point. This entry dates the junction, not the later completion of every bridge, connection or coast-to-coast service.
dateNote.zh: 接轨典礼于1869年5月10日在普罗蒙特里峰举行，而非普罗蒙特里角。此处只标记接轨，不把所有后来桥梁、连接线或完整两洋客运服务都定于当天。

en: Chinese labourers formed a crucial workforce for the Central Pacific.
Federal land grants tied railroad construction to settlement and the dispossession of Indigenous peoples.
zh: 华工是中央太平洋铁路的重要劳动力。
联邦土地拨赠使铁路建设与移民拓殖、原住民土地被剥夺相联系。

title.en: 1999: Nunavut becomes a Canadian territory
title.zh: 1999年：努纳武特成为加拿大地区

summary.en: Nunavut was created on 1 April 1999 following decades of Inuit organizing and negotiations over land claims and political institutions. The 1993 land-claims agreement and the Nunavut Act established the basis for a new territory separated from the Northwest Territories. This was a major change in Canada's internal political geography, not the independence of a new country. The public territorial government and Inuit treaty rights are related but distinct institutions. Comparing them shows why an atlas needs to distinguish international borders, internal administrative boundaries and Indigenous rights rather than displaying all political change with the same symbol.
summary.zh: 在因纽特人持续组织并就土地权利、政治制度谈判数十年后，努纳武特于1999年4月1日成立。1993年土地权利协议与《努纳武特法》为从西北地区分设新地区奠定基础。这是加拿大内部政治地理的重大变化，并非一个新国家独立。面向居民的地区政府与因纽特人的条约权利相互关联，但并非同一制度。比较二者可以说明，地图需要区分国际边界、内部行政界线和原住民权利。

dateNote.en: The territory was created on 1 April 1999. The foundational agreement and legislation date to 1993, so negotiation, legal authorization and operation began at different times.
dateNote.zh: 地区正式成立于1999年4月1日，其基础协议与立法则形成于1993年；谈判、法律授权与机构实际运作并非同时开始。

en: Nunavut is a territory within Canada, not a sovereign state.
The 1993 land-claims settlement preceded the territory's creation by several years.
zh: 努纳武特是加拿大内部的地区，而非主权国家。
1993年的土地权利协议早于地区正式成立数年。

title.en: 1701: Indigenous nations and New France negotiate peace
title.zh: 1701年：原住民各族与新法兰西议和

summary.en: Representatives of dozens of Indigenous nations and the governor of New France concluded the Great Peace of Montréal after years of diplomacy. The agreement addressed warfare and relationships among peoples whose networks extended far beyond the French colony's towns. Indigenous delegates acted as political negotiators, not simply as subjects appearing before a European government. Their pictographic marks on the treaty preserve an unusual visual record of participation. The document makes diplomacy visible across a region often reduced on maps to competing colonial colours, while reminding readers that a treaty records negotiated commitments rather than guaranteed harmony forever.
summary.zh: 经过多年外交协商，数十个原住民族群代表与新法兰西总督缔结《蒙特利尔大和平条约》。协议处理战争及不同群体之间的关系，其网络远超法国殖民城市。原住民代表是政治谈判者，并非只是向欧洲政府呈见的臣民。条约上的图像标记保存了独特的参与记录。在常被地图简化为殖民势力色块的地区，这份文件使外交网络重新可见，同时提醒我们，条约记录协商承诺而非永远和谐的保证。

dateNote.en: Signed on 4 August 1701. Institutional accounts count participating nations differently, so the narrative uses 'dozens' rather than presenting a disputed count as exact.
dateNote.zh: 签署日期为1701年8月4日。机构资料对参与族群数量的计算不完全相同，因此叙述采用“数十个”，不将有差异的统计说成精确数字。

en: Indigenous pictographic signatures are part of the surviving treaty evidence.
The negotiating network extended beyond Montréal and the settlements directly controlled by France.
zh: 原住民图像签名是现存条约证据的一部分。
谈判网络超出蒙特利尔及法国直接控制的聚落。

title.en: 1822: Brazil becomes an independent empire
title.zh: 1822年：巴西成为独立帝国

location.label: Ipiranga, São Paulo; representative independence proclamation site

summary.en: Brazil's separation from Portugal produced an empire under Pedro I rather than a republic. The independence milestone of September 1822 was followed by imperial acclamation and a longer process of fighting, institution-building and diplomatic recognition. Portugal recognized the new empire in a treaty signed in 1825. Monarchy, the Braganza dynasty and slavery survived the political break, making independence different from universal emancipation. Comparison with Spanish America's republics and Haiti's revolution shows that ending colonial ties could produce markedly different political and social arrangements.
summary.zh: 巴西脱离葡萄牙后，建立了由佩德罗一世统治的帝国，而非共和国。1822年9月的独立节点之后，还有皇帝拥立、战争、制度建设与外交承认等过程。葡萄牙直到1825年签署条约才承认新帝国。君主制、布拉干萨王朝及奴隶制在政治分离后继续存在，因此独立不同于所有人的解放。与西属美洲共和国及海地革命比较，可以看到摆脱殖民关系可能产生显著不同的政治和社会安排。

dateNote.en: 7 September 1822 is the commemorated independence proclamation; Pedro's imperial acclamation was on 12 October 1822. Portuguese recognition followed on 29 August 1825.
dateNote.zh: 1822年9月7日是纪念的独立宣告日期，佩德罗于10月12日被拥立为皇帝；葡萄牙承认发生于1825年8月29日。

en: Brazil's independence retained a monarchy under the Braganza dynasty.
Slavery continued after independence; its abolition was a separate struggle culminating in 1888.
zh: 巴西独立后保留布拉干萨王朝君主制。
奴隶制在独立后继续存在，废奴是另一场斗争，至1888年才取得法律成果。

sources.evidenceNote: Primary decree identifies the 12 October imperial acclamation.

sources.title: Was Brazil's independence revolutionary or conservative?
sources.evidenceNote: Institutional historical analysis of continuity in monarchy, dynasty and slavery after independence.

title.en: 1819–1831: the union remembered as Gran Colombia
title.zh: 1819—1831年：后称大哥伦比亚的联合国家

location.label: Villa del Rosario, near Cúcuta; 1821 constitutional congress

summary.en: The Republic of Colombia proclaimed at Angostura in 1819 sought to unite territories liberated from Spanish rule. The Cúcuta constitution of 1821 gave the project a centralized republican framework, while conquest and incorporation of territories continued. The later name Gran Colombia distinguishes this state from the smaller Republic of Colombia. Disputes about regional power and central government contributed to its breakup in 1830–1831, producing Venezuela, Ecuador and New Granada. Following the union's formation and dissolution makes clear that the borders of independence-era South America were outcomes of political struggle rather than predetermined national containers.
summary.zh: 1819年在安戈斯图拉宣布成立的哥伦比亚共和国，试图联合从西班牙统治中解放的地区。1821年库库塔宪法为这一计划建立中央集权的共和框架，但军事征服与领土整合仍在继续。后来使用“大哥伦比亚”名称，是为区别于范围较小的哥伦比亚共和国。地方权力与中央政府之间的争议促成1830—1831年的解体，形成委内瑞拉、厄瓜多尔和新格拉纳达。追踪联合与分离，可理解独立时代南美边界如何由政治斗争塑造。

dateNote.en: The union was proclaimed on 17 December 1819 and constitutionally organized in 1821. Secession and replacement of institutions unfolded in 1830–1831; the selected end year includes the final New Granadan transition.
dateNote.zh: 联合国家宣布于1819年12月17日，1821年完成宪制安排。分离与制度更替发生于1830—1831年；条目终年包含最后的新格拉纳达转型。

en: The state's contemporary name was the Republic of Colombia; 'Gran Colombia' is a later distinguishing label.
The 1819 proclamation, 1821 constitution and 1830–1831 dissolution describe different stages.
zh: 当时国名为哥伦比亚共和国，“大哥伦比亚”是后来用于区分的名称。
1819年宣布、1821年宪法与1830—1831年解体，描述不同阶段。

sources.evidenceNote: Angostura proclamation, Cúcuta constitution, political tensions and the dissolution chronology.

sources.publisher: Archivo General de la Nación, Colombia

title.en: 1848: the Treaty of Guadalupe Hidalgo redraws a border
title.zh: 1848年：《瓜达卢佩—伊达尔戈条约》重划边界

location.label: Guadalupe Hidalgo, now part of Mexico City; treaty signing

summary.en: The Treaty of Guadalupe Hidalgo ended the war between Mexico and the United States and transferred a vast area of northern Mexico to U.S. control. Its provisions included a new boundary, financial compensation and promises concerning the property and civil status of Mexicans living in the transferred territory. Those written guarantees did not remove later conflicts over land and citizenship. The treaty's map was also followed by surveying and disputes over its interpretation. This event shows how a border can move across communities, changing the government that claims them without those communities having migrated.
summary.zh: 《瓜达卢佩—伊达尔戈条约》结束墨西哥与美国之间的战争，并将墨西哥北部大片领土转入美国控制。条款规定新边界、赔款，以及被转让地区墨西哥居民的财产与公民身份保障。书面保障并未消除后来土地和身份争议；条约地图之后仍需要实地测量，并产生解释分歧。这一事件说明，边界可以跨过既有社群：居民没有迁居，主张治理他们的国家却发生改变。

dateNote.en: Signed on 2 February 1848. This dates the treaty, while ratification, boundary surveying and the later Gadsden Purchase belong to separate stages.
dateNote.zh: 条约签署于1848年2月2日；批准、边界测量和后来的加兹登购地属于不同阶段。

en: Articles VIII and IX addressed inhabitants' property and political status in the transferred territory.
A treaty boundary still required surveyors to interpret and mark it on the ground.
zh: 第八、九条处理被转让地区居民的财产和政治身份。
条约边界仍需测量人员在实地解释并标定。

sources.evidenceNote: Primary treaty text, including territory, payment and inhabitants' rights.

sources.title: La firma del Tratado de Guadalupe Hidalgo
sources.publisher: Archivo General de la Nación, Mexico
sources.evidenceNote: Mexican archival account of the treaty and its consequences.

sources.title: Monuments, Manifest Destiny, and Mexico

title.en: 1903: Panama separates from Colombia
title.zh: 1903年：巴拿马脱离哥伦比亚

location.label: Panama City; separation and republican government

summary.en: Panama declared independence from Colombia on 3 November 1903 amid intense competition over an interoceanic canal. U.S. support helped prevent Colombia from re-establishing control, and the United States quickly recognized the new republic. A canal treaty signed later that month gave the United States extensive authority in a zone across the isthmus. Independence therefore coincided with a major restriction on Panama's practical control of that zone. Connecting the 1903 settlement to the eventual canal transfer in 1999 reveals why national independence and control over strategic infrastructure can have very different timelines.
summary.zh: 1903年11月3日，在围绕跨洋运河的激烈竞争中，巴拿马宣布脱离哥伦比亚独立。美国支持阻止了哥伦比亚恢复控制，并迅速承认新共和国。同月稍后签署的运河条约，给予美国横跨地峡的一片地区内的广泛权力。因此，独立同时伴随巴拿马对运河区实际控制的重大限制。把1903年安排与1999年运河最终移交联系起来，可以看到国家独立与控制战略基础设施可能遵循不同时间线。

dateNote.en: Declaration: 3 November 1903; U.S. recognition: 6 November; Hay–Bunau-Varilla Treaty signed: 18 November. The treaty entered into force in 1904.
dateNote.zh: 独立宣布于1903年11月3日，美国承认于11月6日，《海约翰—比诺—瓦里亚条约》签署于11月18日，并于1904年生效。

en: The canal treaty's grant of control was much broader than a simple construction contract.
Panama's independence and the 1999 transfer of the canal occurred almost a century apart.
zh: 运河条约授予的控制权远超普通工程合同。
巴拿马独立与1999年运河移交相隔近一个世纪。
