title.en: 1811: Paraguay establishes its own government
title.zh: 1811年：巴拉圭建立自己的政府

location.label: Asunción; independence movement and governing junta

summary.en: The events of 14–15 May 1811 in Asunción broke the Spanish governor's effective control and opened a process of political independence. A congress in June established a governing junta, while leaders also resisted subordination to the revolutionary authorities in Buenos Aires. Independence therefore involved more than one relationship: separation from imperial government did not automatically imply membership in a larger neighbouring republic. Archival letters and assembly records preserve the successive steps. Paraguay's path helps explain why the breakup of Spanish rule produced several political centres rather than one inevitable successor state.
summary.zh: 1811年5月14—15日，亚松森的行动打破西班牙总督的实际控制，开启政治独立过程。6月议会建立执政委员会，领导人同时反对服从布宜诺斯艾利斯的革命当局。因此，独立涉及不止一种关系：摆脱帝国政府并不自动意味着加入邻近的更大共和国。档案书信与会议记录保存了不同步骤。巴拉圭的道路说明，西班牙统治瓦解后出现多个政治中心，而不是必然形成单一继承国家。

dateNote.en: 14–15 May 1811 marks the revolutionary change; the June congress organized the new government. Later declarations and foreign recognition are not collapsed into those May dates.
dateNote.zh: 1811年5月14—15日标志革命性变化，6月议会组织新政府；后来的宣言与外国承认不压缩到5月的日期之内。

en: The May movement and the June governing congress were separate stages.
Paraguayan leaders challenged both Spanish control and claims of authority from Buenos Aires.
zh: 5月行动与6月建政议会是不同阶段。
巴拉圭领导人既挑战西班牙控制，也反对布宜诺斯艾利斯的权力主张。

sources.title: Documentos relativos a la Independencia del Paraguay, 1811
sources.evidenceNote: Primary independence documents catalogued from 15 May 1811.

sources.title: El Congreso del 17 al 20 de junio de 1811
sources.evidenceNote: June assembly, the governing junta and disputes over authority from Buenos Aires.

sources.title: 1811: La Revolución del 14 de mayo
sources.evidenceNote: May revolutionary sequence and its relationship to the longer process of independence.

title.en: 1810: Kamehameha completes the Hawaiian union
title.zh: 1810年：卡美哈梅哈完成夏威夷统一

location.label: Honolulu, Oʻahu; representative political centre in 1810

summary.en: Kamehameha I consolidated the main Hawaiian Islands into a kingdom through years of warfare, alliances and diplomacy. The final step in 1810 came when Kaumualiʻi of Kauaʻi acknowledged his supremacy, rather than through the successful invasion of that island. The kingdom united previously separate centres of chiefly power during a period of growing overseas trade and contact. Distinguishing conquest from negotiated allegiance helps make the process more precise. The resulting monarchy also provides essential context for nineteenth-century diplomacy, the later overthrow and Hawaiian efforts to maintain political and cultural authority.
summary.zh: 卡美哈梅哈一世通过多年战争、联盟与外交，将夏威夷主要岛屿整合为王国。1810年的最后一步，是考艾岛统治者考穆阿利伊承认其宗主地位，而非成功登陆征服该岛。在海外贸易与接触增长的时代，王国联合了原先分立的酋长权力中心。区分征服与协商臣属，可以更准确理解这一过程。此后君主国的存在，也为研究十九世纪外交、后来政变及夏威夷维护政治文化权利的努力提供背景。

dateNote.en: 1810 marks Kauaʻi's acknowledgement of Kamehameha's supremacy and completion of the union, not the beginning of Hawaiian settlement or an unchanged administrative system thereafter.
dateNote.zh: 1810年指考艾岛承认卡美哈梅哈宗主地位、统一完成，并非夏威夷人最初定居或此后行政制度不变的起点。

en: Kauaʻi's entry into the kingdom followed negotiated submission after earlier invasion attempts failed.
A unified Hawaiian kingdom existed before the later U.S. annexation.
zh: 此前进攻未果后，考艾岛通过协商臣服加入王国。
统一的夏威夷王国早于后来的美国吞并。

title.en: 1893: the Hawaiian monarchy is overthrown
title.zh: 1893年：夏威夷君主政权被推翻

location.label: Honolulu; ʻIolani Palace and government district

summary.en: A group backed by U.S. diplomatic and military representatives overthrew Queen Liliʻuokalani's government on 17 January 1893 and established a provisional government. The queen protested and yielded authority under pressure while seeking redress. Native Hawaiian opposition continued, including the 1897 petitions against annexation. The overthrow and U.S. annexation in 1898 were separate stages, and neither should be described as a unanimous choice by Hawaiians. The surviving petitions and the U.S. Congress's later apology provide evidence for studying both the political seizure and the voices that challenged it.
summary.zh: 1893年1月17日，一个获得美国外交与军事代表支持的集团推翻利留卡拉尼女王政府，建立临时政府。女王提出抗议，在压力下让出权力并寻求补救。夏威夷原住民继续反对，包括1897年的反吞并请愿。政变与1898年美国吞并是两个阶段，都不能描述为夏威夷人的一致选择。现存请愿书和美国国会后来的道歉决议，为研究夺权行为及反对声音提供证据。

dateNote.en: Overthrow: 17 January 1893. Annexation legislation followed in 1898; the U.S. apology resolution was enacted in 1993. The record does not turn the later apology into a new change of sovereignty.
dateNote.zh: 政权被推翻于1893年1月17日，吞并立法在1898年，美国道歉决议在1993年。此处不把后来的道歉理解为新的主权变更。

en: The 1897 anti-annexation petitions preserve organized Native Hawaiian opposition.
The 1993 U.S. resolution acknowledged participation by U.S. agents and citizens in the overthrow.
zh: 1897年反吞并请愿保存了夏威夷原住民有组织的反对声音。
1993年美国决议承认美国政府人员与公民参与推翻王国政府。

sources.evidenceNote: Primary 1993 apology resolution: 1893 chronology, U.S. participation and the queen's protest.

sources.title: The 1897 petition against the annexation of Hawaii
sources.evidenceNote: Primary petitions with archival context documenting organized opposition.

sources.title: Women's Hawaiian Patriotic League petition, 1897
sources.evidenceNote: Primary petition in Hawaiian and English, preserving Native Hawaiian political participation.

title.en: 1970: Fiji becomes independent
title.zh: 1970年：斐济独立

summary.en: Fiji became independent from Britain on 10 October 1970, following nearly a century of colonial rule. The independence legislation ended the United Kingdom's responsibility for governing Fiji, while the initial constitutional settlement retained the monarch and dominion status. Independence therefore changed external sovereignty without immediately establishing a republic. Fiji's parliamentary history distinguishes the 1970 transition from later constitutional transformations. Studying these stages alongside other Pacific cases shows that island societies pursued different relationships with former colonial powers and that the same word, independence, could accompany different institutions.
summary.zh: 斐济在近一个世纪殖民统治后，于1970年10月10日脱离英国而独立。独立立法终止英国对斐济治理的责任，最初宪制安排同时保留君主和自治领地位。因此，独立改变了对外主权关系，却没有立即建立共和国。斐济议会史将1970年转型与后来宪制变化区分。与其他太平洋案例比较，可以看到岛屿社会同前殖民宗主国建立不同关系，“独立”也可能对应不同制度。

dateNote.en: The appointed independence day was 10 October 1970. This is distinct from the 1874 cession to Britain and subsequent republican constitutional changes.
dateNote.zh: 指定独立日为1970年10月10日，与1874年割让英国及后来的共和宪制变化相区别。

en: The independence act specified the end of UK governmental responsibility on 10 October 1970.
Fiji's initial independent constitution retained the monarchy.
zh: 独立法明确英国治理责任于1970年10月10日结束。
斐济独立初期的宪制保留君主制。

sources.title: Fiji Independence Act 1970
sources.evidenceNote: Primary statute establishing the appointed day and the end of British responsibility.

sources.title: Our story
sources.publisher: Parliament of the Republic of Fiji

title.en: 1975: Papua New Guinea becomes independent
title.zh: 1975年：巴布亚新几内亚独立

summary.en: Papua New Guinea achieved independence on 16 September 1975 after a period of internal self-government. The new state brought together territories with different colonial legal histories: Papua had been an Australian possession, while New Guinea had been administered under international mandate and trusteeship arrangements. Independence ended Australia's governing authority, but building institutions across highly diverse communities remained a separate undertaking. Connecting the 1975 constitution and legislation with the later Bougainville peace process helps explain why a single national outline can contain multiple political histories and negotiations over the distribution of power.
summary.zh: 巴布亚新几内亚在内部自治阶段之后，于1975年9月16日独立。新国家包含殖民法律经历不同的地区：巴布亚曾是澳大利亚属地，新几内亚则曾在国际委任统治和托管制度下由澳大利亚管理。独立结束澳大利亚的治理权，但在高度多样的社群之间建设制度仍是另一项工作。将1975年宪法和立法与后来布干维尔和平进程联系起来，可以理解单一国家轮廓内部也存在不同政治历史和权力分配谈判。

dateNote.en: Self-government began on 1 December 1973; independence followed on 16 September 1975. The point marks Port Moresby, not the geographic extent of every constituent territory.
dateNote.zh: 内部自治始于1973年12月1日，独立为1975年9月16日。点位标示莫尔兹比港，并不等于所有组成地区的地理范围。

en: Self-government in 1973 and sovereign independence in 1975 were separate stages.
Papua and New Guinea had distinct legal relationships with Australia before independence.
zh: 1973年自治与1975年主权独立属于不同阶段。
独立以前，巴布亚与新几内亚同澳大利亚具有不同法律关系。

title.en: 1976: Hōkūleʻa sails from Hawaiʻi to Tahiti
title.zh: 1976年：霍库莱阿号从夏威夷航向塔希提

location.label: Honolua Bay, Maui; departure point of the 1976 voyage

summary.en: The voyaging canoe Hōkūleʻa sailed from Hawaiʻi to Tahiti under captain Kawika Kapahulehua, guided without modern navigation instruments by Mau Piailug of Satawal in Micronesia. The voyage demonstrated skilled intentional ocean navigation and became a powerful event in Hawaiian cultural renewal. It also depended on knowledge that Micronesian navigators had continued to practise, rather than a tradition that had vanished everywhere. Following the crew's testimony makes the ocean appear as a field of observation, memory and teaching. The journey connects the study of ancient Pacific settlement with living communities and the transmission of expertise.
summary.zh: 远航独木舟霍库莱阿号在船长卡维卡·卡帕胡鲁阿带领下，由来自密克罗尼西亚萨塔瓦尔岛的毛·皮亚卢格运用非现代仪器导航，从夏威夷驶往塔希提。这次航行展示了有计划的远洋航海技能，并成为夏威夷文化复兴的重要事件。它依靠密克罗尼西亚航海者持续实践的知识，而不是一种曾在所有地方消失的传统。船员叙述让海洋呈现为观察、记忆和教学的空间，把古代太平洋迁徙研究与当代社群及技艺传承相连接。

dateNote.en: The outward voyage took place in May–June 1976, departing Honolua Bay on 1 May. The marker is the launch point, not a claim that one pin represents the entire ocean route.
dateNote.zh: 去程发生于1976年5—6月，5月1日从霍诺卢阿湾出发。点位表示出发地，不以单一点代表完整远洋航线。

en: Navigator Mau Piailug came from Satawal in Micronesia, illustrating knowledge exchange within the Pacific.
Observations of stars, waves, winds and other natural signs supported navigation without modern instruments.
zh: 导航者毛·皮亚卢格来自密克罗尼西亚萨塔瓦尔岛，体现太平洋内部知识交流。
星辰、海浪、风与其他自然迹象的观察，支持了不用现代导航仪器的航行。

title.en: 868: a dated printed Diamond Sutra
title.zh: 868年：有明确刊印纪年的《金刚经》

location.label: Mogao caves near Dunhuang: discovery context, not a verified printing workshop · 敦煌莫高窟发现地参照

summary.en: A Diamond Sutra scroll carries a dedication dated 11 May 868, naming Wang Jie as the sponsor of its distribution in honour of his parents. Printed from woodblocks and assembled from seven sheets, the nearly five-metre scroll links Buddhist devotion with the reproduction of texts. It was found in Mogao’s Library Cave near Dunhuang. Its dated dedication makes this surviving object especially valuable evidence for printing history; it does not establish when printing first began.
summary.zh: 一卷《金刚经》的题记明确记载868年5月11日刊印，并记王玠为父母敬造、普施。它以雕版印刷，七张纸相接，长近五米，显示佛教信仰与文本复制之间的联系。卷子发现于敦煌莫高窟藏经洞。明确的刊印题记使这件存世文物成为印刷史的重要证据，但不能据此断定印刷术始于该年。

dateNote.en: 868 dates this surviving edition. The map marks its discovery at Mogao, not an established place of manufacture. “Earliest dated printed book” describes surviving dated evidence, not the first act of printing.
dateNote.zh: 868年是这件存世版本的刊印年。地图标示莫高窟发现地，不代表已核实的印刷作坊。所谓“最早有纪年的印本”针对存世且有纪年的证据，不等于人类第一次印刷。

en: A dated dedication is evidence about one edition, not the origin of a whole technology.
The production of a text, its later preservation and its discovery can occur in different places.
zh: 刊印题记可以为某一版本断代，不能直接说明整项技术的起源。
文本制作、保存与发现可能发生在不同地点。

sources.title: Buddhist Texts: The Diamond Sutra
sources.evidenceNote: Explains the dated dedication, sponsor, Buddhist context and distinction of the surviving printed scroll.

sources.title: Or.8210/P.2 — Diamond Sutra collection record
sources.evidenceNote: Object-level metadata: 868, woodblock ink on paper, dimensions and Dunhuang/Mogao discovery provenance.

title.en: Grand Canal: grain, water and government
title.zh: 大运河：粮食、水路与治理

location.label: Canal region near Yangzhou; representative point for a multi-basin network · 扬州附近运河区域参照

summary.en: In the seventh century, the Sui government brought older waterways into a connected canal system. Transporting grain, troops and supplies tied water engineering to the administration of a large empire. Later governments extended and maintained the network, whose history reaches both before and after the Sui. The canal is therefore best studied as a changing system of channels, rivers and management practices; a single point or completion year cannot represent its whole history.
summary.zh: 七世纪，隋朝将较早的水道连接为运河体系。粮食、军队和物资运输，把水利工程与大范围行政联系起来。后代继续扩展和维护，因此运河的历史既早于隋，也远不止于隋。它是不断变化的人工河道、自然河流与管理实践构成的系统，不能用一个点位或一个“完工年”概括全部发展。

dateNote.en: 601–700 is a seventh-century study window for unification of the network, not a claim of continuous Sui rule or a single construction phase. Yangzhou is a regional orientation point; no exact canal route is drawn.
dateNote.zh: 601—700年是围绕七世纪运河网络整合设置的学习时段，不代表隋朝延续至700年，也不代表单一施工阶段。扬州点位仅供区域定位；此条目不绘制精确运河线。

en: Canal construction connected water management with the movement of grain and other resources.
Later alterations belong to the canal’s history and should not be projected into its earlier form.
zh: 运河建设把水利管理与粮食等资源运输联系起来。
后来的改建同样属于运河史，但不能倒推为早期已有的形态。

sources.title: The Grand Canal
sources.evidenceNote: Supports earlier sections, seventh-century unification under the Sui, grain and military transport, and subsequent extension and maintenance. The century interval is an editorial study window, not a dynasty lifespan.

title.en: Taxila and Sirkap: a city at a cultural crossroads
title.zh: 塔克西拉与锡尔卡普：文化交汇处的城市

location.label: Sirkap, Taxila; representative archaeological city site

summary.en: The settlements of Taxila connected the northwestern subcontinent with routes toward Central and West Asia. At Sirkap, a fortified city laid out around the second century BCE, a principal street organized shops, houses and religious buildings. Excavated coins, jewellery and household objects reveal connections extending beyond the region. Buddhist learning also became an important part of Taxila’s wider history. These remains let us compare street planning, commerce and religious patronage in a changing urban landscape. They do not identify one unchanging population, and a shared object or artistic style does not by itself establish political control.
summary.zh: 塔克西拉的聚落把南亚次大陆西北部与通往中亚、西亚的交通联系起来。约公元前2世纪形成的锡尔卡普是一座设防城市，主街串联店铺、住宅和宗教建筑。出土的钱币、珠宝及生活用品显示了跨地区交往；佛教学习也成为塔克西拉历史的重要组成部分。这些遗存让我们从街道规划、商业与宗教赞助理解城市变化。它们并不代表一个始终不变的人群，共享器物或艺术风格也不能单独证明政治统治。

dateNote.en: Approximately 200 BCE–100 CE frames Sirkap and its urban context, not the full occupation history of the several Taxila settlements. The pin marks Sirkap rather than a university campus.
dateNote.zh: 约公元前200—公元100年用于呈现锡尔卡普及其城市背景，不是塔克西拉各聚落的全部存续年代。点位代表锡尔卡普遗址，并非现代意义的大学校园。

en: Taxila includes several successive settlements, including Bhir Mound, Sirkap and Sirsukh.
Sirkap’s excavated street grid preserves commercial, domestic and religious spaces.
zh: 塔克西拉包含比尔丘、锡尔卡普和锡尔苏克等先后发展的聚落。
锡尔卡普已发掘的街道网格保存了商业、居住和宗教空间。

sources.title: Taxila
sources.evidenceNote: Site sequence, second-century BCE Sirkap, and the broader history of Buddhist learning.

sources.title: Sirkap
sources.evidenceNote: Museum account of the fortified city, street plan and excavated evidence of external contacts.

title.en: Ajanta: painting, patronage and Buddhist stories
title.zh: 阿旃陀：绘画、赞助与佛教故事

location.label: Ajanta caves, Maharashtra; representative cave complex

summary.en: Ajanta’s rock-cut monasteries and worship halls preserve successive experiments in architecture, painting and sculpture. An early group was created in the last centuries BCE; a later flowering, especially in the fifth century, developed under patrons associated with the Vakataka court. Painted scenes of the Buddha and his previous lives joined devotional teaching with richly imagined settings of courtly and everyday life. The complex reveals the work of donors, monks and skilled makers rather than the achievement of a single ruler. Its chronology also shows why an artistic period associated with the Guptas should not automatically be mapped as Gupta political rule.
summary.zh: 阿旃陀的石窟僧院与礼拜堂保存了不同时期的建筑、绘画和雕刻。早期石窟形成于公元前最后几个世纪；后来的繁荣尤其集中于5世纪，与伐迦陀迦王朝宫廷相关的赞助者发挥了作用。佛陀及其前生的故事画，把宗教教诲与宫廷、日常生活的丰富场景结合起来。这座石窟群体现了施主、僧侣和工匠的共同工作，而非某一位君主的单独成就。它也说明，“笈多时期”的艺术分类不能直接等同于笈多王朝的政治版图。

dateNote.en: Rounded span c. 200 BCE–600 CE covers separate early and later building phases; construction was not continuous throughout.
dateNote.zh: 约公元前200—公元600年涵盖彼此分离的早期与晚期营建阶段，并不表示整个时段持续施工。

en: Ajanta combines monasteries with halls used for Buddhist worship.
Fifth-century activity included Vakataka patronage, including the period of King Harisena.
zh: 阿旃陀同时包含僧院与佛教礼拜空间。
5世纪的营建得到伐迦陀迦方面的赞助，包括诃梨先那王时期。

sources.title: Ajanta Caves
sources.evidenceNote: Early second/first-century BCE caves, later fifth/sixth-century work, and the surviving paintings and sculpture.

sources.title: South Asia, 1–500 A.D.
sources.evidenceNote: Timeline identifies fifth-century Ajanta activity with Vakataka patronage and Buddhist narrative painting.

title.en: Sigiriya: a royal landscape shaped by water
title.zh: 锡吉里耶：以水利塑造的王都

location.label: Sigiriya, Sri Lanka; representative palace and garden landscape

summary.en: During Kassapa I’s reign, Sigiriya became a royal centre combining a dramatic rock summit with carefully organized spaces below. Palatial remains, painted surfaces, defensive features and gardens belong to a landscape whose design depended on the movement and storage of water. The site is useful for exploring how royal authority was expressed through engineering as well as monumental height. Its longer history also includes religious uses, so the visible remains cannot all be assigned to one short reign. Reading the gardens, channels and buildings together helps explain a capital as a working environment supported by many kinds of labour.
summary.zh: 迦叶波一世在位期间，锡吉里耶成为王室中心，把高耸的岩顶与山下精心规划的空间结合起来。宫殿遗存、壁画、防御设施和园林共同组成一处依赖蓄水与导水技术的景观。它展示王权如何通过工程和宏伟建筑表达自身。遗址更长的历史也包含宗教用途，因此不能把所有可见遗存都归入这一短暂王朝阶段。将园林、水道与建筑一同观察，能够理解都城也是依靠多种劳动维持的生活和管理环境。

dateNote.en: 477–495 CE follows the reign of Kassapa I and the royal-capital phase. It does not date every structure or the full religious history of the site.
dateNote.zh: 477—495年对应迦叶波一世的在位与王都阶段，并非遗址每座建筑或全部宗教活动的年代。

en: The palace landscape includes water gardens as well as the rock summit.
Sigiriya’s royal phase was one episode in a longer history of occupation and religious use.
zh: 王宫景观不仅包含岩顶，也包括水景园林。
王都阶段只是遗址更长的居住与宗教历史中的一个阶段。

sources.title: Ancient City of Sigiriya
sources.evidenceNote: Dates the capital to Kassapa I, 477–495, and identifies the palace and rock setting.

sources.title: Sigiriya Rock Fortress
sources.evidenceNote: Official heritage account of palace, gardens, engineering and the site’s successive uses.

title.en: Polonnaruwa: irrigation and a twelfth-century capital
title.zh: 波隆纳鲁沃：灌溉与12世纪都城

location.label: Polonnaruwa, Sri Lanka; representative royal and monastic city

summary.en: Under Parakramabahu I, Polonnaruwa developed as a royal and religious centre supported by an extensively managed agricultural landscape. Reservoirs and channels supplied the water on which cultivation and urban life depended. Monumental Buddhist buildings stood within a city that also preserves Hindu temples connected with earlier Chola rule. This layered setting makes Polonnaruwa valuable for studying both political change and the continuation of skills and religious traditions. The twelfth-century court’s building programme was therefore one phase in a longer history. Its surviving works connect the practical organization of water and labour with the public presentation of kingship.
summary.zh: 波罗迦罗摩巴忽一世时期，波隆纳鲁沃依托受到广泛管理的农业景观，发展为王室与宗教中心。水库和渠道为耕作与城市生活供水。宏伟佛教建筑所在的城市，也保存着与较早朱罗统治相关的印度教神庙。这种多层历史使这里成为研究政治变化、工艺延续及宗教传统的重要地点。12世纪宫廷的大规模营建只是其中一个阶段；遗存将水利和劳动力的实际组织，与王权的公开表达联系起来。

dateNote.en: 1153–1186 is the reign of Parakramabahu I, selected for its irrigation and building activity. Polonnaruwa existed before and after this interval.
dateNote.zh: 1153—1186年为波罗迦罗摩巴忽一世在位时期，此处聚焦其水利与营建活动。波隆纳鲁沃在此前与此后都继续存在。

en: The site preserves both Buddhist monuments and Hindu temples.
Water management linked the royal city to surrounding cultivation.
zh: 遗址同时保存佛教建筑与印度教神庙。
水利管理把王都与周边农业联系起来。

sources.title: Ancient City of Polonnaruwa
sources.evidenceNote: Describes the successive capital, Chola monuments and twelfth-century royal and religious landscape.

sources.title: Polonnaruwa
sources.evidenceNote: Dates Parakramabahu’s reign to 1153–1186 and describes irrigation, agriculture and construction.

title.en: Thanjavur: a temple and its working community
title.zh: 坦贾武尔：神庙及其运作社群

location.label: Brihadisvara Temple, Thanjavur; representative temple site

summary.en: Rajaraja I’s Brihadisvara temple at Thanjavur brought together monumental stone construction, devotion to Shiva and detailed records of royal patronage. Its towering sanctuary and painted interiors display the ambitions of Chola builders, while inscriptions record donations, financial arrangements and the organization of the institution. The temple therefore offers evidence about administration and resources as well as religion and art. Later rulers added to and altered the complex, and worship continued across political changes. Following this one building through time reveals how a royal commission could become a lasting social institution with a much longer life than its original patron.
summary.zh: 罗阇罗阇一世在坦贾武尔营建的布里哈迪斯瓦拉神庙，把宏伟石构建筑、湿婆信仰与详尽的王室赞助记录结合起来。高耸的圣殿和内部壁画展现朱罗工匠的营建能力，铭文则记录捐赠、财务安排和机构运作。神庙因此不仅提供宗教与艺术资料，也留下管理和资源分配的证据。后来的统治者继续增建、改造，祭祀也跨越政治变迁延续。一座王室建筑由此发展为寿命远长于其赞助者的社会机构。

dateNote.en: The rounded construction interval 1003–1010 follows UNESCO’s detailed synthesis: likely initiation in 1003–1004 and consecration in 1009–1010. Later additions are outside this interval.
dateNote.zh: 营建时段1003—1010年依据联合国教科文组织详细说明取整：可能于1003—1004年开工，1009—1010年祝圣。后期增建不在此时段内。

en: Inscriptions record endowments and financial arrangements, providing evidence beyond royal imagery.
Thanjavur is distinct from the later Chola temple at Gangaikondacholapuram, completed in 1035.
zh: 铭文记录捐赠与财务安排，使我们能够超越王室形象研究神庙。
坦贾武尔神庙与1035年完成的恒河康达朱罗普拉姆神庙是不同建筑。

sources.title: Great Living Chola Temples
sources.evidenceNote: Detailed synthesis gives initiation in 1003–1004 and consecration in 1009–1010, and separates the three temples.

sources.title: Great Living Chola Temples
sources.evidenceNote: Describes inscriptions, murals, endowments and later building phases; conflicting regnal-year wording is not reproduced.

title.en: Fatehpur Sikri: building an imperial court
title.zh: 法泰赫普尔西克里：帝国宫廷的营建

location.label: Fatehpur Sikri, Uttar Pradesh; representative Mughal court site

summary.en: Akbar developed Fatehpur Sikri as a planned imperial centre near the residence of the Sufi figure Salim Chishti. Palaces, audience spaces, religious buildings and service areas gave physical form to a Mughal court managing a large and diverse realm. Terraces, water supply and drainage mattered alongside the celebrated architecture. The Archaeological Survey of India also connects the site with Akbar’s religious discussions and his pursuit of accommodation among communities. Studying these spaces together shows a capital as a setting for government, skilled production and debate. The court’s later departure did not erase the city’s subsequent religious and architectural significance.
summary.zh: 阿克巴在苏菲人物萨利姆·奇什提居所附近，把法泰赫普尔西克里建设为经过规划的帝国中心。宫殿、觐见空间、宗教建筑与服务区，为治理辽阔而多样的疆域提供了宫廷环境。台地、供水与排水同著名建筑一样重要。印度考古局还把这里与阿克巴组织的宗教讨论及促进社群相处的政策联系起来。综合观察这些空间，可以理解都城如何容纳行政、手工业生产与思想交流。宫廷后来迁走，并未终结这座城市的宗教与建筑意义。

dateNote.en: 1571–1585 frames the main development phase. The Archaeological Survey of India dates the court’s actual move to 1572; building activity and court residence are not identical dates.
dateNote.zh: 1571—1585年概括主要营建阶段。印度考古局将宫廷实际迁入定于1572年；营建起点与驻跸起点并不相同。

en: The planned city combined imperial institutions with a major religious setting.
Its remains include water and drainage systems as well as ceremonial buildings.
zh: 规划城市将帝国机构与重要宗教场所结合起来。
遗存既包含礼仪建筑，也包含供排水设施。

sources.title: Fatehpur Sikri
sources.evidenceNote: Identifies Akbar’s planned capital and its main late-sixteenth-century building period.

sources.title: Fatehpur Sikri
sources.evidenceNote: Dates court residence to 1572–1585 and describes city planning, infrastructure and religious discussions.

title.en: 1734: Jaipur’s observatory measures the sky
title.zh: 1734年：斋浦尔天文台测量天空

location.label: Jantar Mantar, Jaipur; representative observatory site

summary.en: Sawai Jai Singh II’s observatory at Jaipur turned mathematical relationships into large structures of stone and masonry. Completed in 1734, its instruments supported observations of time and the positions of celestial bodies without telescopes. Different forms served different measurements, making the site a useful lesson in how scientific questions shape the design of tools. It also connects astronomy with court patronage and the creation of Jaipur as a new urban centre. The surviving instruments were repaired in later periods, so their present condition should be distinguished from the original project. Monumental size here was part of an observational method, as well as an architectural choice.
summary.zh: 萨瓦伊·杰伊·辛格二世在斋浦尔建立的天文台，把数学关系转化为大型石砌建筑。1734年完成的仪器用于不用望远镜的时间与天体位置观测；不同形制服务于不同测量任务，展示科学问题如何影响工具设计。这一地点也把天文学、宫廷赞助与斋浦尔新城建设联系起来。现存仪器在后世经过修复，因此今天的状态应与最初工程区分。这里的宏大尺度既是建筑选择，也是观测方法的一部分。

dateNote.en: 1734 is the completion year given by Rajasthan Tourism. It is an event marker, not a claim that the observatory operated for only one year.
dateNote.zh: 1734年为拉贾斯坦邦旅游部门给出的完工年份。此处标示完工事件，并非天文台只运作了一年。

en: The instruments make naked-eye astronomical measurements through carefully designed shapes and scales.
Later restoration means the surviving complex also contains a history of conservation.
zh: 仪器通过精心设计的形状和刻度进行肉眼天文测量。
后世修复意味着现存建筑群还包含一段保护工作的历史。

sources.title: The Jantar Mantar, Jaipur
sources.evidenceNote: Describes the early-eighteenth-century ensemble and its naked-eye astronomical instruments.

sources.title: Jantar Mantar Jaipur
sources.publisher: Department of Tourism, Government of Rajasthan
sources.evidenceNote: Specifies completion in 1734, Jai Singh II’s patronage, instrument functions and later restorations.

title.en: 1952: Bengali language protests in Dhaka
title.zh: 1952年：达卡孟加拉语运动

location.label: Dhaka, near Shaheed Minar; representative commemoration site

summary.en: In February 1952, demonstrators in Dhaka demanded recognition of Bangla as a state language in Pakistan. Police killed students during the protests of 21 February, making the struggle over language an enduring focus of collective memory. The event connects questions of official administration with the everyday dignity of speaking, studying and writing in a community’s own language. It belongs to the history of East Pakistan before Bangladesh’s independence, rather than to an already independent Bangladeshi state. Its later commemoration helped inspire International Mother Language Day, connecting a specific South Asian conflict to wider recognition of linguistic diversity.
summary.zh: 1952年2月，达卡示威者要求巴基斯坦承认孟加拉语为国家语言之一。2月21日的抗议中，警方杀害了学生，使语言权利斗争成为持久的集体记忆。这一事件把国家行政安排与人们使用自身语言交流、学习和写作的尊严联系起来。它发生于孟加拉国独立前的东巴基斯坦，不能放入一个当时已经独立的孟加拉国。后来的纪念推动了国际母语日的设立，将南亚的一场具体斗争与全球语言多样性联系起来。

dateNote.en: 1952 marks the protests and killings, particularly 21 February. The wider language movement began earlier; the pin is a later memorial setting in Dhaka.
dateNote.zh: 1952年标示抗议与死伤事件，重点为2月21日。更广泛的语言运动此前已经开始；点位是达卡后来的纪念场所。

en: The demand concerned Bangla’s status as a state language.
The annual observance on 21 February commemorates this struggle and promotes language diversity.
zh: 诉求涉及孟加拉语作为国家语言的地位。
每年2月21日的国际纪念既追忆这场斗争，也倡导语言多样性。

sources.title: Remarks on International Mother Language Day, 21 February 2023
sources.evidenceNote: Retrospective identifies Dhaka, the state-language demand and police killings on 21 February 1952; its loose claim that the movement began that day is not adopted.

sources.title: United in diversity: International Mother Language Day
sources.evidenceNote: Connects commemoration of the 1952 language struggle with UNESCO’s 1999 proclamation of International Mother Language Day.

title.en: Đông Sơn drums: bronze objects across connected regions
title.zh: 东山铜鼓：跨越地区的青铜器物

location.label: Thanh Hóa, northern Vietnam; regional reference for Đông Sơn culture

summary.en: Bronze drums associated with Đông Sơn culture provide material evidence of connections across mainland and island Southeast Asia and southern China. Their decoration includes animals and human activity, while large drums and small models invite different questions about performance, status and burial practices. A clay drum model in the Metropolitan Museum’s collection illustrates how an object’s form could continue in another material and setting. The exact purposes of particular drums remain debated, so their distribution should not be turned into a map of one empire. Comparing casting, decoration and archaeological contexts helps reconstruct exchange without assuming that every community used these objects in the same way.
summary.zh: 与东山文化相关的铜鼓，为东南亚大陆、岛屿地区及中国南方之间的联系提供了实物证据。鼓面装饰包含动物与人的活动；大型铜鼓和小型模型又让我们提出有关演奏、地位及丧葬的不同问题。大都会艺术博物馆收藏的一件陶鼓模型，显示同一种器物形式可以进入不同材质与使用环境。具体铜鼓的用途仍存在讨论，不能把分布范围直接画成一个帝国的疆域。比较铸造、纹饰与出土背景，有助于重建交流，同时尊重各社群使用方式的差异。

dateNote.en: Approximately 500 BCE–300 CE follows the museum’s broad dating of a miniature drum, with a clay model dated 100 BCE–100 CE. These are object horizons, not exact political boundaries or one site’s continuous occupation.
dateNote.zh: 约公元前500—公元300年采用博物馆对一件小型铜鼓的宽泛断代；另一陶鼓模型定年为前100—公元100年。这是器物年代范围，并非政治边界或单一遗址连续居住时间。

en: Drum forms circulated beyond the northern Vietnamese region after which Đông Sơn culture is named.
Miniatures and clay models show that context and material matter when interpreting a drum’s function.
zh: 铜鼓形制的流传超出了东山文化名称所指的越南北部地区。
小型铜鼓与陶制模型说明，解释功能时必须考虑材质和使用背景。

sources.title: Miniature drum with four frogs
sources.evidenceNote: Dates the object 500 BCE–300 CE and discusses regional drum distribution and uncertainty about function.

sources.title: Drum model
sources.evidenceNote: Clay model dated 100 BCE–100 CE supports discussion of drum forms in funerary contexts; unrelated historical chronology in the page is not reused.

title.en: Pyu cities: irrigation, crafts and Buddhist networks
title.zh: 骠国城市：灌溉、手工业与佛教网络

location.label: Sri Ksetra, Myanmar; representative point for three Pyu urban sites

summary.en: Halin, Beikthano and Sri Ksetra preserve the remains of cities that developed within the dry zone of the Ayeyarwady basin. Walls and moats enclosed substantial settlements supported by reservoirs, channels and cultivated land. Craft production and long-distance exchange connected these communities with wider routes, while monasteries and stupas show the growing importance of Buddhism. The evidence concerns several cities with distinct histories, not a single capital occupied unchanged for a millennium. Their landscapes make the link between urban growth and water management visible. They also remind us that the adoption of religious ideas involved local communities, technologies and institutions.
summary.zh: 哈林、毗湿奴城和室利差呾罗保存了伊洛瓦底江流域干旱地区发展起来的古城遗存。城墙与壕沟围绕规模可观的聚落，水库、渠道及农田为其提供支撑。手工业生产和远距离交换将这些社群连接到更广阔的交通网络，寺院与佛塔则显示佛教日益重要。这里呈现的是历史各异的数座城市，而非一座千年不变的都城。其景观清楚显示城市发展与水利的关系，也提醒我们宗教传播需要经过本地社群、技术与制度的转化。

dateNote.en: The approximate regional span 200 BCE–900 CE follows the UNESCO and ICOMOS descriptions of the three Pyu cities. It does not apply identically to every component or monument.
dateNote.zh: 约公元前200—公元900年是联合国教科文组织及国际古迹遗址理事会对三座骠国城市的区域概括，并非每座城市或建筑都具有相同年代。

en: The three sites contain fortifications, religious monuments and water-management features.
ICOMOS identifies manufacture and trade in materials including iron, precious metals and semi-precious stones.
zh: 三处遗址均保存防御、宗教或水利设施的证据。
国际古迹遗址理事会指出铁器、贵金属与半宝石等材料涉及制造及贸易。

sources.title: Pyu Ancient Cities
sources.evidenceNote: Regional chronology and surviving urban, religious and irrigated landscapes.

sources.title: Pyu Ancient Cities: ICOMOS evaluation, 2014
sources.evidenceNote: Evaluation details seasonal water storage, manufacture and trade, while distinguishing evidence from unproven origins of technology.

title.en: Sukhothai: cities and changing Buddhist arts
title.zh: 素可泰：城市与佛教艺术的变化

location.label: Historic Sukhothai, Thailand; representative centre of a linked urban group

summary.en: Sukhothai and its associated towns became important political and artistic centres during the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries. Their monuments reveal local architectural developments alongside wider exchanges in religious ideas and skilled production. The surviving landscape includes Sukhothai, Si Satchanalai and Kamphaeng Phet, so the history extends beyond a single royal enclosure. Museum objects add another scale of evidence: a thirteenth-century bronze Prajnaparamita figure, classified within the Sukhothai period, documents a specific religious image and material tradition. Combining objects with buildings helps us avoid reducing the region’s culture to one ruler, one monument or a uniform artistic formula.
summary.zh: 13至14世纪，素可泰及相关城镇成为重要的政治与艺术中心。遗存既显示本地建筑的发展，也反映宗教观念与制作技术的广泛交流。历史景观包括素可泰、西萨查纳莱和甘烹碧，因此其历史超出一处王宫范围。博物馆器物提供了另一尺度的证据：一件归入素可泰时期的13世纪般若波罗蜜多铜像，保存了具体的宗教形象与材质传统。把器物与建筑结合研究，可以避免将地区文化缩减为一位君主、一座纪念物或单一艺术模式。

dateNote.en: 1201–1400 represents the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries as an approximate cultural focus. It is not an exact start/end claim for the kingdom or the associated towns.
dateNote.zh: 1201—1400年用于表达13至14世纪这一文化研究重点，不是素可泰王国或相关城镇的精确存续边界。

en: The World Heritage group includes three linked historic towns.
A catalogued thirteenth-century bronze Prajnaparamita provides object-level evidence of the period’s religious art.
zh: 世界遗产群包含三座彼此相关的历史城镇。
有明确馆藏记录的13世纪般若波罗蜜多铜像提供了宗教艺术的实物证据。

sources.title: Historic Town of Sukhothai and Associated Historic Towns
sources.evidenceNote: Describes the thirteenth/fourteenth-century cultural and urban ensemble and its associated towns.

sources.title: Standing Prajnaparamita
sources.evidenceNote: Object record dates a Thai bronze Prajnaparamita to the thirteenth century and classifies it as Sukhothai period.

title.en: 1511: the conquest of Melaka’s trading port
title.zh: 1511年：马六甲商港被征服

location.label: Melaka, Malay Peninsula; representative historic port

summary.en: Portuguese forces under Afonso de Albuquerque captured Melaka in 1511, taking a strategic port within an already extensive Asian trading world. Merchants had connected the city with China, the Indonesian islands, India and routes farther west before the conquest. Portuguese fortifications and attempts to control shipping introduced a new armed participant into those networks. Control of this port should not be confused with control of every sea route or neighbouring society. Melaka’s story joins commerce with military force and shows how a change in rulers could reshape the conditions under which diverse merchants moved, bargained and settled.
summary.zh: 1511年，阿方索·德·阿尔布克尔克率领的葡萄牙军队占领马六甲，夺取了一个早已嵌入亚洲贸易体系的战略港口。征服之前，商人已把这里与中国、印度尼西亚群岛、印度及更西方的通道连接起来。葡萄牙设防并试图管制航运，向这些网络加入了新的武装力量。控制一座港口不能等同于控制所有海路或周边社会。马六甲的历史把商业与军事力量联系起来，显示统治者更替如何改变不同商人流动、交易与定居的条件。

dateNote.en: 1511 marks the Portuguese conquest; the National Library Board dates the capture to August. The city’s commercial history predates this event.
dateNote.zh: 1511年标示葡萄牙征服；新加坡国家图书馆将攻占时间具体记为8月。马六甲的商业历史早于这一事件。

en: Melaka was an established multinational trading port before Portuguese rule.
Portuguese control depended on fortified bases and attempts to regulate shipping.
zh: 葡萄牙统治以前，马六甲已是多方商人聚集的贸易港。
葡萄牙势力依靠设防据点，并尝试管制航运。

sources.title: Malacca in the Early European Modern Period
sources.evidenceNote: Historical account of the established trading centre and Portuguese conquest in 1511.

sources.title: Portuguese trade empire in Asia
sources.evidenceNote: Identifies Albuquerque’s August 1511 capture, connected trade regions and the Portuguese system of fortified bases and shipping passes.

title.en: 1619: Jayakarta is destroyed and Batavia established
title.zh: 1619年：雅加达被毁与巴达维亚建立

location.label: Old Jakarta, Java; representative site of Jayakarta and Batavia

summary.en: In 1619, Jan Pieterszoon Coen’s forces destroyed Jayakarta and established Batavia as the Asian headquarters of the Dutch East India Company. The new fortified centre combined warehouses, offices and military power, illustrating how a commercial corporation could also wage war and make treaties. Archival plans help reconstruct the company’s intended city, while museum accounts place it within a workforce and trading system extending far beyond the Netherlands. The founding was therefore a violent political transformation of an existing place. It forms a bridge between Java’s earlier port networks and the much longer history of colonial administration and resistance.
summary.zh: 1619年，扬·彼得斯佐恩·库恩的军队摧毁雅加达，并把新建的巴达维亚设为荷兰东印度公司在亚洲的总部。这座设防中心结合仓库、行政办公室与军事力量，展示商业公司如何同时发动战争和缔结条约。档案地图帮助重建公司的城市规划，博物馆说明则将其置于跨越荷兰之外的劳动力与贸易体系中。因此，所谓“建城”也是对既有地点的一次暴力政治改造。它连接爪哇较早的港口网络与后来漫长的殖民统治及抵抗历史。

dateNote.en: 1619 marks destruction and establishment of the company headquarters. It is not the beginning of human settlement or commerce at Jakarta.
dateNote.zh: 1619年标示城市被毁及公司总部建立，并非今日雅加达地区居住或贸易的起点。

en: The Dutch East India Company possessed powers to wage war and negotiate treaties.
National Archives material links Batavia’s construction directly with the destruction of Jayakarta.
zh: 荷兰东印度公司拥有发动战争和谈判条约的权力。
荷兰国家档案馆材料明确将巴达维亚建设与雅加达毁灭联系起来。

sources.title: Coen builds Fort Batavia, 1619
sources.evidenceNote: Archive-based educational account describes Jayakarta’s destruction and the fort, warehouses and administrative centre.

sources.title: The Dutch East India Company (VOC)
sources.evidenceNote: Explains company political powers, Batavia’s headquarters role from 1619 and the wider composition of its workforce.

title.en: 1819: a treaty for a trading post in Singapore
title.zh: 1819年：在新加坡设立商站的条约

location.label: Singapore River area; representative site of the early trading settlement

summary.en: On 6 February 1819, Stamford Raffles, Sultan Hussein Shah and Temenggong Abdul Rahman signed an agreement allowing the British East India Company to establish a trading post in Singapore. The treaty exchanged commercial access for annual payments and created a new British foothold within an existing Malay political landscape. It did not immediately transfer the island’s full sovereignty: that was the subject of a separate treaty in 1824, negotiated under unequal conditions. Reading the two agreements separately makes colonial expansion easier to understand. It also restores the Malay signatories to a story often told only through the arrival of one British official.
summary.zh: 1819年2月6日，斯坦福·莱佛士、侯赛因沙与天猛公阿都拉曼签署协议，允许英国东印度公司在新加坡设立商站。条约以年度款项换取商业进入权，在既有马来政治环境中建立了英国据点。它并未立即将全岛主权全部转让；那是1824年另一份在不平等条件下谈成的条约内容。分别阅读两份协议，能够更准确理解殖民扩张，也把马来签约者重新纳入经常只围绕一名英国官员展开的历史叙述。

dateNote.en: The event is the treaty of 6 February 1819. The separate full-cession agreement dates to 2 August 1824.
dateNote.zh: 此处事件为1819年2月6日条约；另行全面割让的协议签于1824年8月2日。

en: The 1819 signatories included two Malay rulers and the East India Company’s representative.
The 1819 trading-post permission and the 1824 cession were different agreements.
zh: 1819年签约方包括两位马来统治者与东印度公司的代表。
1819年的商站许可与1824年的割让是不同协议。

sources.title: Copy treaty between Raffles and the Sultan of Johore for a settlement at Singapore
sources.publisher: National Library Board, Singapore / British Library
sources.evidenceNote: Archival catalogue explains the 6 February 1819 treaty, signatories, payments and trading-post rights.

sources.title: Making History — A Treaty Most Unfriendly
sources.publisher: National Archives of Singapore / National Library Board
sources.evidenceNote: Distinguishes the 1819 agreement from the 1824 sovereignty transfer and describes pressure placed on the Malay rulers.

title.en: 1898: Philippine independence is proclaimed at Kawit
title.zh: 1898年：菲律宾在甲米地宣布独立

location.label: Kawit, Cavite; Aguinaldo house, representative proclamation site

summary.en: Philippine independence was proclaimed at Emilio Aguinaldo’s family home in Kawit on 12 June 1898. Ambrosio Rianzares Bautista read the declaration, while the flag and a national march gave the ceremony a public symbolic language. The proclamation asserted the revolutionaries’ claim to political independence from Spain; it did not settle the archipelago’s international status or end foreign intervention. Spain’s subsequent transfer of its claim to the United States was followed by war between Filipino and American forces. Keeping the declaration, later republican institutions and the 1946 independence settlement distinct helps explain the many stages of the struggle for self-government.
summary.zh: 1898年6月12日，菲律宾在甲米地省卡维特镇的阿吉纳尔多家宅宣布独立。安布罗西奥·里安萨雷斯·包蒂斯塔宣读宣言，国旗与民族进行曲赋予仪式鲜明的公共象征。宣告表达革命者脱离西班牙的政治主张，却未解决群岛的国际地位，也未终结外来干预。西班牙后来将其主权主张转交美国，随后爆发菲美战争。将独立宣言、后来的共和国机构以及1946年的独立安排分别呈现，有助于理解自治斗争的多个阶段。

dateNote.en: 12 June 1898 is the declaration at Kawit. It must not be conflated with the later inauguration of the First Republic or the 1946 transfer of sovereignty.
dateNote.zh: 1898年6月12日是卡维特独立宣告日，不能与后来第一共和国的成立或1946年的主权移交混为一谈。

en: Bautista read the declaration at the Aguinaldo family home.
The declaration was followed by continued disputes over sovereignty and the Philippine–American War.
zh: 包蒂斯塔在阿吉纳尔多家宅宣读独立宣言。
宣告之后，主权争端仍持续，并发生菲美战争。

sources.title: Site of the Proclamation of Philippine Independence
sources.publisher: National Historical Commission of the Philippines
sources.evidenceNote: Historical marker documents the date, house, reader, flag and national march; its retrospective title for Aguinaldo is not treated as a June 1898 constitutional date.

sources.title: Manuel Quezon and the Push for Philippine Independence
sources.evidenceNote: Supports the subsequent U.S. acquisition claim, Filipino resistance and continuing struggle for self-government; disputed war-end shorthand in the article is not reused.

title.en: 1932: Siam changes to constitutional monarchy
title.zh: 1932年：暹罗转向君主立宪

location.label: Bangkok, near Ananta Samakhom Throne Hall; representative political centre

summary.en: The People’s Party’s intervention on 24 June 1932 ended Siam’s absolute monarchy and opened a struggle over how a constitutional order would work. An interim charter was signed on 27 June, followed by a permanent constitution on 10 December. The documents and negotiations reveal competing views of royal authority, popular sovereignty and representation. Accounts from the King Prajadhipok and Pridi Banomyong institutes emphasize different participants, making comparison especially useful. The change established a new constitutional framework, but it should not be read as the immediate completion of democratic government. Institutions and the practical distribution of power remained subjects of conflict.
summary.zh: 1932年6月24日，人民党的行动结束了暹罗的君主专制，并开启了关于宪政如何运作的争论。6月27日签署临时宪章，12月10日颁布永久宪法。相关文件与谈判呈现了对王权、人民主权和代表制度的不同理解。巴差提朴国王学院与比里·帕侬荣研究所的叙述强调不同参与者，比较阅读尤其有价值。这场变化确立了新的宪政框架，但不等于民主政府立即全面实现；制度及实际权力分配仍受到争夺。

dateNote.en: 1932 contains three distinct moments: intervention on 24 June, interim charter on 27 June and permanent constitution on 10 December. The country was then called Siam.
dateNote.zh: 1932年包含三个不同节点：6月24日行动、6月27日临时宪章和12月10日永久宪法。当时国名为暹罗。

en: The interim and permanent constitutions were issued on different dates.
The monarchy continued within the new constitutional framework.
zh: 临时宪章与永久宪法颁布于不同日期。
君主制在新的宪政框架内继续存在。

sources.title: Biography of King Rama VII — Granting the Constitution
sources.evidenceNote: Dates the People’s Party action and the permanent constitution; its royal-centred interpretation is balanced with documentary discussion from the Pridi Institute.

sources.title: The first constitution, 27 June 1932
sources.evidenceNote: Thai-language discussion reproduces and cites contemporary records on the interim charter, negotiations, popular sovereignty and 27 June signature.

title.en: Around 1300: village life at Wairau Bar
title.zh: 约1300年：怀劳沙洲的村落生活

location.label: Wairau River mouth, Marlborough; regional reference for Wairau Bar

summary.en: Wairau Bar preserves evidence from an early phase of Polynesian settlement in Aotearoa New Zealand. Radiocarbon dating places material around 1300, while excavated structures, cooking areas and tool manufacture show a substantial village rather than only a burial ground. These traces help explain how people established new communities after ocean voyages and organized work in a new environment. The site also has an ongoing relationship with Rangitāne o Wairau. Research accompanying the return of ancestral remains in 2009 illustrates why archaeological knowledge must be understood together with the authority, concerns and continuing histories of descendant communities.
summary.zh: 怀劳沙洲保存了波利尼西亚人在奥特亚罗瓦新西兰早期定居的证据。放射性碳测年将相关材料置于约1300年；出土建筑、炊事区和工具制造遗存显示这里曾有规模可观的村落，并非仅是墓地。这些痕迹帮助解释远洋航行之后，人们如何建立社群并在新环境中组织劳动。遗址也始终与怀劳朗吉塔内人保持联系。2009年祖先遗骸归还期间开展的研究说明，考古知识应与后裔社群的权威、关切及延续至今的历史共同理解。

dateNote.en: 1300 is an approximate archaeological anchor, not an exact foundation or abandonment year. The regional pin avoids implying a precise location for individual burials.
dateNote.zh: 1300年是近似的考古年代参照，并非精确建村或废弃年份。区域点位不代表个别墓葬的位置。

en: Excavations identify cooking, tool manufacture and structural remains.
The 2009 investigations took place with the involvement of Rangitāne mana whenua during ancestral repatriation.
zh: 发掘识别出炊事、工具制造与建筑遗存。
2009年的调查伴随祖先遗骸归还，在当地朗吉塔内社群参与下开展。

sources.title: Wairau Bar: archaeological site
sources.publisher: Te Ara, Ministry for Culture and Heritage, New Zealand
sources.evidenceNote: Locates the site at the Wairau River mouth and gives radiocarbon dates around 1300 CE.

sources.title: Migration, colonisation and Polynesian settlement of Aotearoa
sources.publisher: University of Otago, Southern Pacific Archaeological Research
sources.evidenceNote: First-party research account describes village evidence and the 2009 Rangitāne-led repatriation context.

title.en: Lapaha: chiefly monuments and Pacific connections
title.zh: 拉帕哈：首领纪念建筑与太平洋联系

location.label: Lapaha, Tongatapu; representative chiefly and ceremonial centre

summary.en: Lapaha became a central place of the Tuʻi Tonga polity, with stone-faced royal tombs, ceremonial spaces and facilities connected with canoe transport. Building these works required coordinated labour and the movement of heavy materials. Scientific analysis adds evidence beyond the monuments: stone tools from Lapaha and the earlier centre at Heketa include imports from other island groups, especially Samoa and Fiji. These objects reveal sustained maritime connections and the importance of valued materials to chiefly power. They establish networks of interaction, not a uniform territorial empire over every island from which an object came. The site also remains part of a living Tongan landscape.
summary.zh: 拉帕哈成为图伊汤加政治体系的重要中心，拥有石砌包面的王室陵墓、仪式空间和与独木舟运输相关的设施。营造这些工程需要组织劳动力并搬运沉重材料。科学分析提供了建筑之外的证据：拉帕哈及其较早中心赫凯塔的石器中，包括来自其他群岛、尤其是萨摩亚和斐济的材料。这些器物显示持续的海上联系，以及珍贵物资对首领权力的意义。它们证明的是交往网络，不能据此把所有材料来源地都画成同一领土帝国。遗址也是延续至今的汤加文化景观。

dateNote.en: 1350–1500 is a selected early Lapaha phase. The 2014 archaeological study places the move from Heketa around 1350–1400; tomb building and use continued much later.
dateNote.zh: 1350—1500年用于聚焦拉帕哈较早阶段。2014年考古研究将中心由赫凯塔迁来的时间置于约1350—1400年；陵墓营建及使用延续到更晚时期。

en: Geochemical sourcing identifies stone tools imported from outside Tonga.
Royal tombs and ceremonial exchange connect maritime movement with chiefly authority.
zh: 地球化学溯源识别出由汤加以外输入的石器材料。
王室陵墓与仪式性交换将海上流动和首领权威联系起来。

sources.title: Stone tools from the ancient Tongan state reveal prehistoric interaction centers in the Central Pacific
sources.publisher: Clark and colleagues, Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, 2014
sources.evidenceNote: Primary archaeological study gives the Heketa-to-Lapaha chronology and geochemical evidence for inter-island stone-tool exchange.

sources.title: Cultural Landscapes of the Pacific, Lapaha section, pp. 97–98
sources.evidenceNote: Describes royal tombs, chiefly ceremonies, harbour landscape and continuing cultural associations; differing traditional foundation chronologies are not presented as exact dates.

title.en: 1835: He Whakaputanga asserts rangatira authority
title.zh: 1835年：《独立宣言》申明毛利首领权威

location.label: Waitangi, Bay of Islands; representative signing place

summary.en: Northern rangatira signed He Whakaputanga at Waitangi on 28 October 1835, asserting their authority and proposing collective arrangements for law, peace and trade. The declaration also sought protection from the British king while rejecting government imposed without the chiefs’ authorization. Its Māori wording and the English version associated with James Busby need to be read with attention to language and political context. Thirty-four chiefs initially signed, with more signatures added later. The document reveals Indigenous diplomatic initiative before the Treaty of Waitangi. It should not be treated as proof that every Māori community had joined one centrally governed modern state.
summary.zh: 1835年10月28日，新西兰北部毛利首领在怀唐伊签署《独立宣言》，申明自身权威，并提出共同处理法律、和平与贸易事务的安排。宣言也寻求英国国王保护，同时拒绝未经首领授权而强加的政府。理解毛利语文本与詹姆斯·巴斯比相关英文版本，需要注意语言和政治背景。最初有34位首领签署，后来继续增加。文件呈现了《怀唐伊条约》之前原住民的外交行动，却不能证明所有毛利社群都已加入一个中央集权的现代国家。

dateNote.en: 28 October 1835 is the initial signing. Additional signatures continued to 1839; this entry marks the declaration rather than a fixed nationwide territorial settlement.
dateNote.zh: 1835年10月28日为最初签署日期，后续签名持续至1839年。此处标示宣言，而不是已经固定的全国领土安排。

en: The declaration located authority with rangatira and their collective gathering.
The archive preserves Māori text and distinct English renderings, making translation part of the historical evidence.
zh: 宣言将权威置于毛利首领及其集体会议。
档案保存毛利语文本与不同英文表述，翻译本身也是历史证据的一部分。

sources.title: He Whakaputanga — Declaration of Independence, 1835
sources.publisher: Manatū Taonga, Ministry for Culture and Heritage, New Zealand
sources.evidenceNote: Presents the original-language transcript, translations, date and signing sequence.

sources.title: The Declaration of the Independence of New Zealand
sources.publisher: Archives New Zealand / Te Rua Mahara o te Kāwanatanga
sources.evidenceNote: Archival presentation supports the declaration’s assertions of rangatira authority and preserves its linguistic and documentary context.

title.en: 1851: gold rushes reshape migration to Australia
title.zh: 1851年：淘金潮改变赴澳迁移

location.label: Ballarat, Victoria; representative goldfield among several colonies

summary.en: The gold rushes beginning in 1851 drew people from many regions into New South Wales and Victoria. New mining settlements, businesses and transport needs expanded rapidly as migrants pursued uncertain returns from difficult work. Chinese arrivals formed an important part of these movements; museum accounts describe both mining techniques and passage financed through brokers and debt. They also faced discrimination from governments and other miners. Gold had been found before 1851, so this date marks the start of major public rushes rather than a first human discovery. The history connects Australian colonial development with wider Pacific mobility and nineteenth-century Chinese migration.
summary.zh: 1851年开始的淘金潮吸引许多地区的人来到新南威尔士和维多利亚。移民从艰苦劳动中追求并不确定的收入，矿区聚落、商业和运输需求迅速扩张。华人是这些迁移的重要组成部分；博物馆资料既介绍采矿技术，也记录通过中介与借贷筹措旅费的方式。他们还遭受政府及其他矿工的歧视。1851年之前已发现过黄金，因此这一年份标示大规模公开淘金潮的开端，而非人类首次发现黄金。它把澳洲殖民地发展与太平洋流动及19世纪华人迁移联系起来。

dateNote.en: 1851–1861 selects the first major decade and a census reference year. Gold rushes continued elsewhere and later; Ballarat is one representative field.
dateNote.zh: 1851—1861年聚焦首个主要十年，并以人口普查年份为参照。其他地区后来仍有淘金潮；巴拉瑞特只是其中一个代表矿区。

en: Major rushes began in both New South Wales and Victoria in 1851.
Chinese migration included passage financed through the credit-ticket system, alongside other arrangements.
zh: 1851年，新南威尔士与维多利亚均出现主要淘金潮。
华人迁移包含赊票或借贷筹资渡海等多种安排。

sources.title: Gold rushes
sources.evidenceNote: Explains earlier finds, the major 1851 rushes, global migration and anti-Chinese discrimination.

sources.title: Chinese gold miners
sources.evidenceNote: Describes 1850s Chinese migration, tools, credit-ticket finance and 1861 goldfield communities.

title.en: 1946–1958: nuclear testing and Marshallese displacement
title.zh: 1946—1958年：核试验与马绍尔人的流离

location.label: Bikini Atoll; representative of testing at Bikini and Enewetak

summary.en: The United States carried out nuclear tests at Bikini and Enewetak between 1946 and 1958, transforming inhabited Pacific landscapes into Cold War testing grounds. Marshallese communities were displaced, and radioactive contamination made the consequences extend far beyond the test dates. Bikini’s displaced residents experienced repeated relocation, including an attempted return followed by another evacuation. The surviving ships and altered environments are therefore evidence of both military experimentation and disrupted lives. Counts need careful geographic scope: 67 tests refers to Bikini and Enewetak together, while 23 were conducted at Bikini. The map pin represents one of the atolls, not the full area of human or environmental impact.
summary.zh: 美国在1946至1958年间于比基尼与埃内韦塔克进行核试验，把有人居住的太平洋景观转变为冷战试验场。马绍尔社群被迫迁移，放射性污染的影响远远超出试验本身的年份。比基尼居民多次搬迁，甚至曾返回后又被撤离。遗留舰船与改变的环境因此既是军事试验的证据，也是生活遭到破坏的见证。统计必须区分地理范围：67次指两个环礁合计，比基尼为23次。地图点只代表其中一处环礁，不涵盖全部人类或环境影响范围。

dateNote.en: 1946–1958 is the testing interval. Displacement, contamination and debates about return continued after 1958; the entry is not an environmental recovery endpoint.
dateNote.zh: 1946—1958年为核试验时段。迁移、污染及返乡问题在1958年后仍持续；结束年份不是环境恢复日期。

en: The total of 67 tests covers Bikini and Enewetak together; Bikini accounted for 23.
Testing required relocation and produced consequences lasting beyond the testing programme.
zh: 67次为比基尼与埃内韦塔克总数，其中比基尼进行23次。
试验造成居民迁移，其后果延续到试验计划结束以后。

sources.title: Marshall Islands
sources.evidenceNote: Gives 67 tests at Bikini and Enewetak during 1946–1958 and recounts repeated Bikini community displacement.

sources.title: Decision 34 COM 8B.20 — Bikini Atoll Nuclear Test Site
sources.evidenceNote: Adopted inscription statement specifies 23 Bikini tests and discusses displacement, irradiation and environmental change; this resolves a scope error in the shorter site introduction.

title.en: 1965: the Cook Islands choose self-government
title.zh: 1965年：库克群岛选择自治

location.label: Avarua, Rarotonga; representative seat of Cook Islands government

summary.en: On 4 August 1965, the Cook Islands entered self-government in free association with New Zealand. The arrangement followed constitutional development through a local legislature and executive, while Cook Islanders retained New Zealand citizenship. It offers an important example of decolonization taking a form different from either continued direct administration or a conventional independence declaration. A later Cook Islands government account emphasizes the choice made by its people and the subsequent evolution of the relationship. The powers and responsibilities described for 1965 should therefore not be assumed to remain unchanged. This event connects island institutions with the wider Pacific history of political self-determination.
summary.zh: 1965年8月4日，库克群岛开始在与新西兰自由联合的关系中实行自治。这一安排经过地方立法及行政机构的宪政发展形成，库克群岛居民仍保留新西兰公民身份。它展示去殖民化可以采取不同于继续直接管治或传统独立宣告的形式。库克群岛政府后来的回顾强调人民的选择及关系的持续演变。因此，1965年的权力和责任安排不能被当作此后始终不变的现状。这一事件将岛屿制度发展与太平洋政治自决的更广泛历史联系起来。

dateNote.en: 4 August 1965 marks self-government in free association. The entry deliberately distinguishes this status from a generic independence label.
dateNote.zh: 1965年8月4日为自由联合下自治的起点。此处将这一具体安排与笼统的“独立”标签区分。

en: Cook Islanders retained New Zealand citizenship when self-government began.
Free association was a chosen constitutional relationship that subsequently evolved.
zh: 自治开始时，库克群岛居民保留新西兰公民身份。
自由联合是一种经过选择并在后来继续演变的宪政关系。

sources.title: Cook Islands achieves self-government
sources.publisher: Manatū Taonga, Ministry for Culture and Heritage, New Zealand
sources.evidenceNote: Gives 4 August 1965, retained citizenship and the legislative and executive arrangements at the transition.

sources.title: Ministerial statement to Parliament, 17 February 2025
sources.publisher: Cook Islands Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Immigration
sources.evidenceNote: Retrospective first-party account identifies the 1965 choice of free association and stresses its later evolution; current diplomatic statistics are not used.

title.en: 1980: Vanuatu becomes an independent republic
title.zh: 1980年：瓦努阿图成为独立共和国

location.label: Port Vila, Efate; representative capital of the new republic

summary.en: Vanuatu became independent on 30 July 1980 after the joint British and French administration known as the New Hebrides. The transition followed ni-Vanuatu movements for self-government and independence that gathered strength in the preceding decades. A new republic adopted parliamentary institutions while retaining a place for discussion of Indigenous custom and chiefly authority. This history makes decolonization visible as political work by island communities, not simply the departure of foreign administrators. The date marks a change of state institutions rather than the beginning of the islands’ history: archaeological and cultural traditions long preceded both the condominium and the republic.
summary.zh: 1980年7月30日，瓦努阿图结束名为“新赫布里底”的英法共同管治，成为独立国家。此前数十年，瓦努阿图人民争取自治与独立的运动不断发展。新共和国建立议会制度，同时为原住民习俗及首领权威保留讨论空间。其历史显示，去殖民化是岛屿社群推动的政治行动，而不只是外国行政人员离开。这个日期标示国家制度转变，并非岛屿历史的开始：当地考古与文化传统远远早于共管体制和共和国。

dateNote.en: 30 July 1980 is the independence date. The constitution was signed in 1979 before the transition; the event year does not replace the archipelago’s earlier histories.
dateNote.zh: 1980年7月30日为独立日，宪法在过渡前的1979年签署。这一年份不能取代群岛更早的历史。

en: The colonial New Hebrides had been jointly administered by Britain and France.
The new republic adopted a parliamentary political system.
zh: 殖民地新赫布里底由英国和法国共同管治。
新共和国采用议会政治制度。

sources.title: About Vanuatu — History
sources.evidenceNote: Describes the Anglo-French condominium, ni-Vanuatu self-government movement and 30 July 1980 transition; unrelated early-European chronology is not adopted.

sources.title: Electoral Systems and Legal Framework
sources.evidenceNote: Supports independence date, parliamentary framework, 1979 constitutional signature and customary advisory institution. Outdated claims about later referendums are excluded.

title.en: 1992: Mabo recognizes continuing Indigenous land rights
title.zh: 1992年：马博判决承认延续的原住民土地权利

location.label: Mer (Murray Island), Torres Strait; land at the centre of the case, not the court venue

summary.en: On 3 June 1992, Australia’s High Court recognized the Meriam people’s traditional rights in the Mabo case. The claim rested on evidence that Mer’s communities possessed laws, customs and enduring relationships with particular land. The judgment rejected the legal assumption that Indigenous land rights could simply be ignored because the territory had been treated as belonging to nobody. It also established the principle that native title could survive where it had not been legally extinguished. The decision was followed by legislation in 1993. Its significance lay in recognizing continuing rights; it did not automatically return every parcel of land or resolve all later claims.
summary.zh: 1992年6月3日，澳大利亚高等法院在马博案中承认梅里亚姆人的传统土地权利。诉讼依据当地社群具有法律、习俗以及与特定土地持续关系的证据。判决否定了以土地被视为“无主”为由忽略原住民权利的法律假定，并确立原住民所有权在未被依法消灭的情况下可以继续存在的原则。1993年随后制定相关立法。其意义在于承认延续的权利，而不是自动归还所有土地，或一次性解决后来的每项主张。

dateNote.en: 3 June 1992 is the High Court decision. The pin marks Mer, whose land was central to the claim; the court delivered judgment in Canberra.
dateNote.zh: 1992年6月3日为高等法院判决日。点位标示诉讼核心土地所在的梅尔岛；法院在堪培拉作出判决。

en: The case was brought by Meriam plaintiffs and supported by evidence of local law and custom.
The Native Title Act followed in 1993; recognition remained subject to legal conditions.
zh: 诉讼由梅里亚姆原告提出，并以本地法律和习俗证据支持。
1993年随后制定《原住民所有权法》；权利承认仍需满足法律条件。

sources.title: The Mabo Case
sources.publisher: Australian Institute of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Studies
sources.evidenceNote: Documents the plaintiffs, Meriam customary rights, 3 June 1992 decision and the condition that title had not been legally extinguished.

sources.title: Mabo decision
sources.evidenceNote: Explains the Mer claim, evidence, High Court decision and following 1993 legislation.

title.en: Nineveh: assembling and organizing written knowledge
title.zh: 尼尼微：汇集与组织书写知识

location.label: Kuyunjik, ancient Nineveh; representative tablet-collection context

summary.en: The tablets associated with Ashurbanipal’s library preserve a substantial body of seventh-century BCE scholarship at Nineveh. Their short scribal notes, called colophons, help researchers trace ownership, source texts and the movement of manuscripts. Recent study shows that the collection incorporated material from earlier generations and different places, including Assyrian as well as Babylonian sources. Medical texts reveal organized efforts to record treatments and knowledge, alongside other scholarly genres. The collection was therefore built through copying, selection and transfer rather than created entirely by one king. Surviving fragments also require careful reconstruction: a fragment count is not a count of complete ancient books.
summary.zh: 与亚述巴尼拔藏书相关的泥版，保存了尼尼微公元前7世纪的大量学术知识。称为跋记的简短书吏说明，帮助研究者追溯所有权、文本来源与抄本流动。新的研究显示，收藏吸纳了不同地点和较早世代的材料，来源既包括巴比伦，也包括亚述。医学文本显示系统记录治疗与知识的努力，并与其他学术类型并存。这一收藏通过抄写、选择和转移形成，并非一位国王独自创造。现存碎片还需谨慎拼合；碎片数量不能等同于完整古代书籍数量。

dateNote.en: 700–601 BCE represents the seventh century as an archaeological and scholarly context. It is not Ashurbanipal’s exact reign or the library’s foundation date.
dateNote.zh: 公元前700—601年表示公元前7世纪这一考古与学术背景，不是亚述巴尼拔的精确在位期或藏书机构成立日期。

en: Colophons are evidence for how tablets were identified, collected and transmitted.
Medical tablets are among the texts now being reconstructed from fragments.
zh: 跋记为泥版如何被标识、收藏和传承提供证据。
医学泥版是今日正由碎片重新整理的文本之一。

sources.title: Reading the Library of Ashurbanipal: project results
sources.publisher: Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft; British Museum / LMU research team
sources.evidenceNote: First-party project summary explains seventh-century tablets, colophon evidence and varied Assyrian/Babylonian and earlier sources.

sources.title: Introducing Assyrian Medicine: healthcare fit for a king
sources.evidenceNote: Research project describes the Nineveh medical corpus, its seventh-century context and reconstruction of broken clay tablets.

title.en: Sardis: stamped metal and early coinage
title.zh: 萨迪斯：金属印记与早期铸币

location.label: Sardis, western Anatolia; representative Lydian capital and minting centre

summary.en: Lydia and its neighbours developed an influential early coinage tradition using electrum, an alloy of gold and silver. Stamping pieces of specified weight tied their acceptance to an issuing authority, addressing difficulties in judging mixed metal in everyday exchanges. Archaeological finds and coin inscriptions help reconstruct this development around Sardis and the Aegean. Under Croesus, separate gold and silver issues became important, and minting continued after the Persian conquest. This was a change in the organization of payment rather than the invention of all money or trade. The precise date of the earliest coins remains disputed, and different coin types need separate histories.
summary.zh: 吕底亚及邻近地区以金银合金琥珀金发展出影响深远的早期铸币传统。在一定重量的金属块上加盖印记，使其接受程度与发行权威相联系，回应了交易中难以判断合金成色的问题。考古发现与币文帮助重建萨迪斯和爱琴海周边的发展。克罗伊斯时期，分别使用金和银的币制变得重要；波斯征服后铸币仍延续。这是支付组织方式的变化，并非所有货币或贸易的发明。最早铸币的精确年代仍有争议，不同币种需要分别研究。

dateNote.en: About 625–546 BCE is a rounded focus from the late seventh century to the conventional date for the Lydian conquest. Coin origins are disputed; minting continued under Persian rule.
dateNote.zh: 约公元前625—546年是从前7世纪晚期到吕底亚被征服传统纪年的近似研究时段。铸币起源年代仍有争议；波斯统治下仍继续铸币。

en: Electrum’s varying gold and silver content posed a problem for judging value.
Croesus’s gold and silver coinage continued in modified political circumstances after conquest.
zh: 琥珀金的金银比例不一，使价值判断较为困难。
克罗伊斯式金银币在征服之后的新政治环境中继续发行。

sources.title: Sardis
sources.evidenceNote: Provides the Lydian setting, disputed late-seventh-century coin chronology and conventional Croesus/conquest dates.

sources.title: The Coins of Sardis
sources.publisher: John H. Kroll, Archaeological Exploration of Sardis
sources.evidenceNote: Explains electrum valuation, stamped weights, excavated early coins, Croesus’s reform and continued Persian-period production.

title.en: 539 BCE: Cyrus takes Babylon and presents his rule
title.zh: 公元前539年：居鲁士占领巴比伦并阐释统治

location.label: Babylon; representative place of conquest and cylinder deposition

summary.en: After Cyrus captured Babylon in 539 BCE, a clay cylinder written in Babylonian cuneiform presented his kingship through promises of restored sanctuaries and the return of displaced cult communities. Its form belonged to a Mesopotamian tradition of royal inscriptions placed in building foundations. The document therefore offers evidence about how a new ruler sought legitimacy in a conquered city, alongside evidence for imperial policy. Later readers gave Cyrus an exceptionally positive reputation, and the cylinder acquired new symbolic meanings. Treating it as a royal statement helps separate its ancient purposes from the modern, misleading claim that it was a universal charter of human rights.
summary.zh: 居鲁士于公元前539年占领巴比伦后，一件用巴比伦楔形文字书写的泥筒，通过修复圣所和让被迁移的宗教社群归返等宣示呈现其王权。器物形制属于两河流域将王室铭文埋入建筑基础的传统。它既提供帝国政策的证据，也显示新统治者如何在被征服城市寻求正当性。后人赋予居鲁士格外正面的声誉，泥筒也获得新的象征意义。把它作为王室陈述阅读，可以区分古代用途与现代将其称为普世人权宪章的不准确说法。

dateNote.en: The conquest occurred in 539 BCE; the cylinder is catalogued to 539–538 BCE. The map marks Babylon, not the object’s present museum location.
dateNote.zh: 征服发生于公元前539年，泥筒馆藏断代为前539—538年。地图标示巴比伦，而非器物今天所在的博物馆。

en: The cylinder uses Babylonian language and a local royal-inscription form.
Its later reputation as a human-rights charter is a modern interpretation, not its ancient genre.
zh: 泥筒采用巴比伦语言与本地王室铭文形式。
“人权宪章”的声誉属于现代解释，并非其古代文献类型。

sources.title: The Cyrus Cylinder and Ancient Persia
sources.publisher: The Metropolitan Museum of Art / British Museum exhibition
sources.evidenceNote: Dates the object 539–538 BCE and explains language, foundation-deposit form and claims about restored shrines and returning peoples.

sources.title: The Later Legacy of Cyrus the Great
sources.publisher: Michael Seymour, The Metropolitan Museum of Art
sources.evidenceNote: Distinguishes ancient kingship claims from later reception, including the inaccurate universal human-rights-charter label.

title.en: Bisotun: Darius’s multilingual claim to rule
title.zh: 贝希斯敦：大流士的多语统治宣言

location.label: Bisotun cliff, Kermanshah region; representative inscription site

summary.en: Darius I placed a large relief and multilingual inscription above a route linking the Iranian plateau with Mesopotamia. The image shows the king dominating defeated opponents, while versions in Old Persian, Elamite and Babylonian tell his account of securing the throne and overcoming rebellions. The monument is indispensable evidence, but its account is also an interested royal argument about legitimacy. Comparing its languages later helped scholars recover the reading of cuneiform texts. Bisotun consequently connects two histories of knowledge: an empire’s effort to broadcast a political narrative, and the much later scholarly work that made ancient records readable again.
summary.zh: 大流士一世在连接伊朗高原与两河流域的通道上方，设置大型浮雕和多语铭文。图像表现国王压倒失败的对手；古波斯语、埃兰语和巴比伦语版本叙述他巩固王位、平定叛乱的经过。纪念物是重要史料，但也是维护王权正当性的政治陈述。后世学者通过比较这些语言，推进了楔形文字的释读。因此，贝希斯敦连接两段知识史：帝国传播政治叙事的努力，以及更晚时期使古代文献重新可读的学术工作。

dateNote.en: Approximately 521–520 BCE frames the early monument and victory narrative; the text developed in stages. These dates are not presented as Darius’s accession date or the date of every addition.
dateNote.zh: 约公元前521—520年用于呈现早期纪念物及胜利叙事；文本分阶段形成。此年代并非大流士即位日期，也不代表所有增补的时间。

en: The monument presents related versions in three languages.
Darius’s claims about opponents must be distinguished from an independent account of their legitimacy.
zh: 纪念物以三种语言呈现相互关联的版本。
大流士对对手的描述应与独立判断其正统性的叙述区分。

sources.title: Bisotun
sources.evidenceNote: Identifies the cliff setting, multilingual relief and early monument/victory chronology; the page’s accession shorthand is not reused.

sources.title: Bisotun iii. Darius’s Inscriptions
sources.evidenceNote: Scholarly analysis of the three language versions, textual evidence, condition and importance for decipherment.

title.en: Damascus: a new mosque in an ancient sacred landscape
title.zh: 大马士革：古老宗教景观中的新清真寺

location.label: Great Mosque of Damascus; representative Umayyad monument

summary.en: Under al-Walid I, the Umayyad capital gained a major congregational mosque on a site previously occupied by a Roman temple and a Christian church. The building joined the requirements of Islamic worship with the skills and visual traditions of the late antique Mediterranean. Its location within Damascus’s older street plan makes urban continuity visible even as political and religious institutions changed. The mosque is therefore useful for studying adaptation, patronage and the organization of sacred space. The present complex has a longer history of alteration and repair, so surviving features cannot all be treated as unchanged evidence from the early eighth century.
summary.zh: 瓦利德一世时期，倭马亚都城在曾有罗马神庙和基督教堂的地点营建大型聚礼清真寺。建筑把伊斯兰礼拜需求与晚期古代地中海地区的工艺及视觉传统结合起来。它处于大马士革较早的街道规划中，使政治与宗教制度变化中的城市延续清晰可见。清真寺因而适合研究改造、赞助和宗教空间组织。现存建筑群经历了更长的增改与修复，不能将其所有构件都视为8世纪早期原封不动的证据。

dateNote.en: 705–715 follows al-Walid I’s reign as the construction context; the Met identifies Damascus’s mosque with 706. The interval is not an assertion that all present structures date to these years.
dateNote.zh: 705—715年采用瓦利德一世在位期作为营建背景；大都会博物馆将大马士革清真寺关联于706年。此时段并不意味着全部现存建筑都建于这些年。

en: The site had Roman and Christian religious uses before the Umayyad mosque.
The building developed within a city whose street pattern retained earlier layers.
zh: 倭马亚清真寺之前，此地曾有罗马及基督教宗教用途。
建筑所在城市的街道格局保留了更早历史层次。

sources.title: The Art of the Umayyad Period (661–750)
sources.evidenceNote: Dates al-Walid’s reign and the Damascus project, and explains adaptation of earlier artistic and architectural traditions.

sources.title: Ancient City of Damascus
sources.evidenceNote: Identifies Roman temple/Christian basilica layers and the mosque’s place in the inherited urban plan.

title.en: Samarkand: a collaborative observatory and star catalogue
title.zh: 撒马尔罕：合作天文观测与星表编制

location.label: Ulugh Beg Observatory, Samarkand; representative scientific centre

summary.en: Ulugh Beg’s observatory brought mathematicians and astronomers together in Timurid Samarkand. Construction began in 1424, and work associated with the observatory contributed to the star catalogue published in 1437. Al-Kashi’s letters provide unusually direct evidence of discussion and problem-solving within the scholarly circle. Qadi Zada, al-Kashi and Ulugh Beg were major contributors to a collaborative enterprise whose results included astronomical tables, calendar calculations and trigonometry. The project shows how court resources could support sustained measurement and mathematical teaching. Its achievements should be credited to a community of scholars, while distinguishing the construction date from the later publication of their work.
summary.zh: 兀鲁伯的天文台把数学家与天文学家聚集到帖木儿王朝的撒马尔罕。1424年开始建设，相关研究促成1437年发表的星表。卡西写给父亲的信，为学者圈的讨论和解题活动提供了少见的直接证据。卡迪扎德、卡西与兀鲁伯是合作计划的重要贡献者，成果包含天文表、历法计算与三角学。这一项目显示宫廷资源如何支持长期测量和数学教学。其成就应归于学者群体，同时应区分天文台建设日期与研究成果后来的发表时间。

dateNote.en: 1424–1437 spans the start of construction to the catalogue’s publication in the cited university histories. It is not the complete working life of the observatory.
dateNote.zh: 1424—1437年依据所引大学学术史资料，表示从开工到星表发表的时段，并非天文台全部运作寿命。

en: Al-Kashi’s surviving letters describe scientific activity in Samarkand.
The catalogue was a collective project, with mathematical and calendrical results alongside stellar positions.
zh: 卡西现存书信描述了撒马尔罕的科学活动。
星表属于集体工作，除恒星位置外还包含数学与历法成果。

sources.title: Al-Kashi
sources.publisher: MacTutor History of Mathematics, University of St Andrews
sources.evidenceNote: Reports the 1424 construction start and discusses surviving letters as evidence for scientific work and teaching.

sources.title: Qadi Zada al-Rumi
sources.publisher: MacTutor History of Mathematics, University of St Andrews
sources.evidenceNote: Dates catalogue publication to 1437 and identifies collaboration, astronomical tables, calendar calculations and trigonometry; uncertain star totals are omitted.

title.en: Isfahan: a new capital links court, worship and trade
title.zh: 伊斯法罕：新都连接宫廷、宗教与贸易

location.label: Naqsh-e Jahan square, Isfahan; representative Safavid urban project

summary.en: Shah Abbas I moved the Safavid capital to Isfahan in 1597–1598 and reshaped the city through a new ceremonial square, connected bazaars and major buildings. Royal audience space, mosques and the entrance to the commercial district placed several institutions of government and urban life around one public setting. Court sponsorship also supported painting, manuscripts and decorative arts. The design made connections between commerce and royal authority visible, while the older city remained part of the larger urban system. Construction continued beyond Abbas’s reign, so the square’s surviving ensemble should be read as a developing project rather than a single finished moment.
summary.zh: 阿拔斯一世于1597—1598年将萨法维都城迁至伊斯法罕，并通过新礼仪广场、相连的集市及大型建筑重塑城市。王室觐见空间、清真寺和商业区入口，把政府与城市生活的多种机构汇聚在同一公共环境中。宫廷也赞助绘画、手稿和装饰艺术。规划使商业与王权之间的联系可见，而旧城仍属于更大的城市体系。工程在阿拔斯统治结束后继续，因此现存广场建筑群应被视为逐步发展的项目，而非一个瞬间完成的整体。

dateNote.en: 1597–1629 frames the capital move and Abbas I’s remaining reign. Some major buildings were completed later; the start is conventionally given as 1597–1598.
dateNote.zh: 1597—1629年涵盖迁都及阿拔斯一世余下的在位时期；部分大型建筑更晚才完成，迁都通常记为1597—1598年。

en: A bazaar linked the older city centre with the new royal square.
The square grouped royal, religious and commercial institutions in a single planned setting.
zh: 集市把较早的城市中心与新王家广场连接起来。
广场将王室、宗教和商业机构组织在同一规划环境中。

sources.title: Shah Abbas and the Arts of Isfahan
sources.evidenceNote: Dates the capital move to 1597–1598 and describes the bazaar connection, square, individual building chronologies and artistic patronage.

sources.title: Meidan Emam, Esfahan
sources.evidenceNote: Describes the public square and its integrated architectural ensemble.

title.en: 1839: the Gülhane edict promises Ottoman reforms
title.zh: 1839年：《古尔哈内敕令》提出奥斯曼改革

summary.en: The Gülhane edict announced a programme of reform under Sultan Abdülmecid in 1839. Its text promised protection for life, honour and property, more regular taxation and military service, and procedures intended to restrain arbitrary punishment. It extended these assurances across religious communities while presenting change as a restoration of just government. Reading the document shows the language through which an imperial government attempted to reorganize relations with its subjects. A proclaimed guarantee is not the same as successful implementation, and the edict did not itself create a modern democratic constitution. It became an important reference point in the longer Ottoman reform era known as the Tanzimat.
summary.zh: 1839年，阿卜杜勒迈吉德苏丹统治下的《古尔哈内敕令》宣布改革纲领。文本承诺保护生命、名誉和财产，规范征税及兵役，并以程序限制任意处罚。它把这些保障延伸至不同宗教社群，同时将改革表述为恢复公正治理。阅读文件可以了解帝国政府如何用特定语言重整与臣民的关系。公布保障不等于成功落实，敕令本身也没有建立现代民主宪法。它成为后来被称为“坦齐马特”的奥斯曼改革时代的重要参照。

dateNote.en: 1839 is the proclamation year. This event marks a reform statement, not the completion of the later Tanzimat changes or the 1876 constitution.
dateNote.zh: 1839年是敕令宣布年份。此处标示改革声明，而非后来坦齐马特改革完成，亦非1876年宪法。

en: The edict addressed taxation, military recruitment, legal procedure and protection of property.
Its guarantees were framed for subjects of different religions within an imperial monarchy.
zh: 敕令涉及税收、征兵、法律程序及财产保护。
其保障面向帝国君主制中不同宗教的臣民。

sources.title: The Gülhane Proclamation, 1839
sources.publisher: Roy Rosenzweig Center for History and New Media, George Mason University
sources.evidenceNote: English primary-document translation supplies the stated guarantees and proposed fiscal, military and judicial changes.

sources.title: The Later Ottomans and the Impact of Europe
sources.evidenceNote: Places the edict under Abdülmecid within the longer nineteenth-century reform context; the edict is not equated with later parliamentary government.

title.en: Hōryūji: building, rebuilding and Buddhist transmission
title.zh: 法隆寺：营建、重建与佛教传播

location.label: Hōryūji, Ikaruga; representative Buddhist temple precincts

summary.en: Hōryūji’s history brings written traditions, excavated remains and surviving wooden architecture into conversation. Records associate the original temple with completion in 607, while a chronicle reports a devastating fire in 670. Archaeological and architectural investigation supports the interpretation that the Western Precinct was rebuilt afterward. An Eastern Precinct was established in 739 on a different earlier site. The complex shows how Buddhist institutions and building practices were adapted in Japan through connections with the wider East Asian world. It is also a lesson in historical method: a foundation date, a later rebuilding and the age of a surviving structure are different kinds of claim.
summary.zh: 法隆寺的历史需要将文献传统、考古遗存与现存木构建筑对读。记录将原寺完成联系于607年，编年史又记载670年的严重火灾。考古与建筑研究支持西院伽蓝在火灾后重建的解释；东院则于739年在另一处更早遗址上建立。建筑群显示日本如何通过东亚联系吸收并转化佛教制度与营造方式。它也是历史方法的实例：创建年份、后来的重建日期，以及某座现存建筑的年代，属于不同的问题。

dateNote.en: 607–739 spans the recorded original foundation, post-670 rebuilding and Eastern Precinct foundation. It is not a claim that all surviving buildings date to 607 or that construction was continuous.
dateNote.zh: 607—739年涵盖文献所记原寺建立、670年后的重建及东院创建，并不表示全部现存建筑建于607年，也不表示持续施工。

en: The 670 fire is recorded in the Nihon Shoki; rebuilding is supported by archaeological and repair studies.
Western and Eastern precincts have different construction histories.
zh: 《日本书纪》记载670年火灾，考古与修缮研究支持重建说。
西院与东院具有不同营建历史。

sources.title: Buddhist Monuments in the Horyu-ji Area
sources.evidenceNote: Identifies surviving late-seventh/early-eighth-century wooden monuments and the transmission/adaptation of Buddhist architecture.

sources.title: About Horyu-ji Temple
sources.evidenceNote: Preservation account distinguishes the 607 foundation tradition, 670 fire, evidence supporting Western Precinct rebuilding and 739 Eastern Precinct foundation.

title.en: 710: Heijō becomes Japan’s capital
title.zh: 710年：平城京成为日本都城

location.label: Heijō Palace, Nara; representative imperial administrative site

summary.en: The court established Heijō-kyō in the Nara basin in 710, creating a capital whose palace organized imperial residence, ceremonies and state business. Excavations of audience halls and other structures allow researchers to connect written accounts with the physical arrangement of government. Temples and other monuments around Nara further reveal the importance of Buddhism and wider East Asian cultural exchange. The familiar label “Nara capital, 710–784” compresses a more complicated sequence: the court left for other capitals in 740 and returned in 745 before its later move to Nagaoka. A precise foundation event helps retain that changing geography rather than drawing one uninterrupted block of rule.
summary.zh: 710年，朝廷在奈良盆地建立平城京，宫城将天皇居住、礼仪与国家事务组织在同一行政空间内。对朝堂等建筑的发掘，使研究者能够把文献叙述与政府的实际空间布局联系起来。奈良周边寺院和其他建筑进一步显示佛教及东亚文化交流的重要性。常见的“奈良都城710—784年”概括压缩了复杂过程：朝廷于740年迁出、745年返回，后来再迁长冈。以具体建都事件呈现，可以保留地理变化，而不画成一段未曾中断的统治。

dateNote.en: 710 is the establishment of the capital. The later 740–745 absence is stated explicitly; this event does not encode uninterrupted residence through 784.
