dateNote.zh: 710年标示建都。后来的740—745年迁出阶段另予说明，此事件不表示朝廷直到784年始终连续驻留。

en: Heijō Palace contained spaces for residence, ritual and administration.
The capital moved away in 740 and returned in 745 before the move to Nagaoka in 784.
zh: 平城宫包含居住、礼仪及行政空间。
朝廷于740年迁出、745年返回，并于784年迁往长冈。

sources.title: Historic Monuments of Ancient Nara
sources.evidenceNote: Provides the broader Nara capital and Buddhist-monument context.

sources.title: Report 79: First Imperial Audience Hall, English summary
sources.publisher: Nara National Research Institute for Cultural Properties
sources.evidenceNote: Archaeological report summary identifies 710 establishment, palace functions, 740 departure, 745 return and 784 relocation.

title.en: 1236–1251: compiling the second Tripitaka Koreana
title.zh: 1236—1251年：编刻再雕高丽大藏经

location.label: Ganghwa Island; representative wartime supervising-office location, not later Haeinsa storage

summary.en: Goryeo organized a replacement Buddhist canon after an earlier set of printing blocks was destroyed during Mongol invasions. The project’s supervising office was established on Ganghwa Island in 1236, and the undertaking was completed in 1251. Scholars compared texts while carvers prepared more than eighty thousand wooden printing blocks, making the work both a devotional response to crisis and a demanding system of knowledge production. Its classical Chinese texts connect Korean scholarship with centuries of Buddhist translation across Asia. The surviving blocks were later transferred to Haeinsa, where purpose-built storage helped preserve them. Production, printing and long-term conservation belong to distinct stages of this history.
summary.zh: 蒙古入侵期间，较早一套佛经印版被毁后，高丽组织重新编刻大藏经。1236年在江华岛设立监督机构，工程于1251年完成。学者校勘文本，工匠制作八万余块木版，使这项工作既成为危机中的宗教回应，也成为复杂的知识生产体系。文言汉文文本把高丽学术与亚洲数世纪的佛经翻译联系起来。现存经版后来迁至海印寺，专用藏经建筑帮助其保存。制作、印刷与长期保护应作为不同历史阶段理解。

dateNote.en: 1236–1251 dates organization through completion in the Memory of the World nomination’s production account. Some heritage summaries use narrower carving dates. Ganghwa is the supervising-office reference; Haeinsa received the blocks in 1398.
dateNote.zh: 1236—1251年依据《世界记忆名录》申报书的制作过程说明，表示从组织工程到完成；部分遗产简介采用较窄的雕刻年代。江华岛是监督机构所在地，海印寺于1398年接收经版。

en: The surviving second canon comprises more than eighty thousand woodblocks.
Collation compared earlier editions; Haeinsa’s later repositories concern preservation rather than the original supervising-office site.
zh: 现存再雕大藏经包含八万余块木版。
校勘参考较早版本；海印寺后来的藏经楼属于保护阶段，并非最初监督机构所在地。

sources.title: Printing woodblocks of the Tripitaka Koreana and miscellaneous Buddhist scriptures: nomination
sources.publisher: Cultural Heritage Administration, Republic of Korea / UNESCO Memory of the World
sources.evidenceNote: Production section gives 1236 Ganghwa office and 1251 completion; also details collation, scale and 1398 transfer to Haeinsa. Other sections contain narrower carving ranges, so dates are labelled by their function.

sources.title: Haeinsa Temple Janggyeong Panjeon, the Depositories for the Tripitaka Koreana Woodblocks
sources.evidenceNote: Supports the later Haeinsa storage context and preservation through specially designed depositories; its narrower introductory carving range is not silently substituted for project dates.

title.en: 1377: Jikji is printed with movable metal type
title.zh: 1377年：《直指》以金属活字印刷

location.label: Heungdeoksa temple area, Cheongju; representative printing site

summary.en: The Buddhist anthology Jikji was printed with movable metal type at Heungdeoksa in Cheongju in 1377. A surviving second volume provides direct physical evidence for the technique in late Goryeo Korea. The text compiled teachings used in Buddhist learning, reminding us that printing technology developed within communities with particular educational and religious needs. Jikji is described as the oldest surviving dated evidence of this metal-type process; earlier Korean metal-type printing is known from references in other books. That distinction matters. It should not be treated as the invention of all printing, or as proof of an undocumented line of transmission to Gutenberg’s later European workshop.
summary.zh: 1377年，佛教选集《直指》在清州兴德寺以金属活字印刷。现存下卷为高丽晚期使用该技术提供了直接实物证据。书中汇集用于佛教学习的教诲，提醒我们印刷技术是在具有具体教育与宗教需求的社群中发展的。《直指》被视为现存最早有日期的金属活字印刷证据，而更早的高丽金属活字活动见于其他文献记载。这一区别十分重要：它并不等于所有印刷术的发明，也不能证明存在一条通往古腾堡欧洲作坊而尚无文献支持的传播路线。

dateNote.en: 1377 is the dated metal-type printing at Cheongju; UNESCO specifies July. The surviving item is volume two, and a later woodblock version dates to 1378.
dateNote.zh: 1377年为清州金属活字印刷年份，联合国教科文组织具体记为7月。现存金属活字本为下卷，另有1378年的木刻本。

en: Jikji preserves Buddhist teachings compiled in the late Goryeo period.
“Oldest surviving evidence” is different from “first use”: earlier metal-type printing is recorded in texts.
zh: 《直指》保存高丽晚期汇编的佛教教诲。
“现存最早证据”不等于“首次使用”；文献记载了更早的金属活字印刷。

sources.title: Jikji, a treasure of the world of printing
sources.evidenceNote: Custodian explains the 1377 Cheongju printing, surviving second volume, Buddhist contents and 1378 woodblock version.

sources.title: Baegun hwasang chorok buljo jikji simche yojeol (vol. II)
sources.evidenceNote: Specifies July 1377 metal-type printing and explicitly distinguishes surviving evidence from earlier printings mentioned in Korean texts.

title.en: 1592–1598: the Imjin War across East Asia
title.zh: 1592—1598年：东亚的壬辰战争

location.label: Busan, Korean Peninsula; representative initial invasion area, not the whole theatre

summary.en: Toyotomi Hideyoshi’s invasions of Joseon in 1592 and 1597 drew Korea, Japan and Ming China into a prolonged regional war. Fighting on land and sea, intervening negotiations and renewed invasion devastated communities across the Korean peninsula. Museum collections preserve weapons and official records, but also writings that reveal refugees, labour and disrupted everyday life. Admiral Yi Sun-sin’s surviving diary records combat alongside weather, personal concerns and observations of ordinary people. Reading these sources together gives the war more dimensions than a sequence of battles. The event connects the histories of neighbouring states while preserving the different experiences and purposes of their surviving witnesses.
summary.zh: 丰臣秀吉于1592年和1597年发动对朝鲜的侵略，使朝鲜、日本与明朝卷入持续多年的区域战争。陆战、海战、期间谈判与再次入侵，严重破坏了朝鲜半岛各地社群。博物馆收藏不仅有兵器与公文，也有呈现难民、劳动和日常生活破裂的文字。李舜臣留下的日记在记录战斗之外，还记下天气、个人关切与普通人的生活。把这些材料结合阅读，能够超越战役列表理解战争。事件连接邻国历史，同时保留不同见证者的经历与写作目的。

dateNote.en: 1592–1598 spans the invasions, negotiations and renewed war; the second invasion began in 1597. Busan represents an initial entry area, not every battlefield.
dateNote.zh: 1592—1598年涵盖入侵、谈判与再战；第二次入侵始于1597年。釜山代表最初进入区域，不代表所有战场。

en: Ming intervention made the conflict a war involving several East Asian states.
Yi Sun-sin’s diary spans 1592–1598 and records more than military manoeuvres.
zh: 明军介入使冲突成为涉及多个东亚国家的战争。
李舜臣日记横跨1592—1598年，记录内容不限于军事行动。

sources.title: Imjin War Hall
sources.publisher: Jinju National Museum, Republic of Korea
sources.evidenceNote: Museum narrative identifies the 1592–1598 regional war, Ming participation, negotiations, reinvasion and sources on civilian experience.

sources.title: Nanjung Ilgi: War Diary of Admiral Yi Sun-sin
sources.evidenceNote: Describes the surviving 1592–1598 handwritten diary and its military, environmental and personal observations.

title.en: 1603: Tokugawa Ieyasu establishes the Edo shogunate
title.zh: 1603年：德川家康建立江户幕府

location.label: Edo Castle area, Tokyo; representative government centre

summary.en: Tokugawa Ieyasu received the title of shogun in 1603 and established his military government at Edo after victory at Sekigahara in 1600. The appointment was a decisive institutional step, but consolidation continued: the remaining Toyotomi opposition was defeated at Osaka in 1615. Objects and images help explain how the new authority was displayed. Stirrups bearing the Tokugawa family emblem signalled elite ownership, while later portraits presented Ieyasu as a protective deity. The founding of a government and the making of its public memory were related but separate processes. This event provides a political anchor for the later growth of Edo’s urban culture.
summary.zh: 德川家康在1600年关原之战取胜后，于1603年受任将军，并在江户建立军事政府。这一任命是决定性的制度步骤，但权力巩固仍继续：丰臣方面的最后抵抗于1615年大坂之战中被击败。器物和图像有助于解释新权威如何被展示。带有德川家纹的马镫象征精英所有权，后来的肖像则将家康表现为护佑神祇。政府建立与公共记忆形成相互关联，却是不同过程。这一事件为后来江户城市文化的发展提供了政治参照。

dateNote.en: 1603 marks appointment and establishment of the Edo government. Sekigahara occurred in 1600 and the Osaka consolidation in 1615, so peace is not assumed to begin everywhere in 1603.
dateNote.zh: 1603年标示受任将军及江户政府建立。关原之战发生于1600年，权力在1615年大坂之战后进一步巩固，因此不能假定全国各地于1603年即进入和平。

en: The imperial appointment followed the 1600 victory at Sekigahara.
Later commemorative portraits reflect the construction of Ieyasu’s posthumous sacred status.
zh: 朝廷任命发生于1600年关原胜利之后。
后来的纪念肖像反映家康死后神圣地位的形成。

sources.title: Portrait of Tokugawa Ieyasu
sources.evidenceNote: Collection account distinguishes 1600, 1603 and 1615 and explains later deified portraits.

sources.title: Pair of Stirrups (Abumi)
sources.evidenceNote: Object description explains Tokugawa emblems and elite ownership and dates the family’s shogunal office from 1603.

title.en: 1946–1947: Japan’s postwar constitution
title.zh: 1946—1947年：日本战后宪法

location.label: National Diet area, Tokyo; representative constitutional government site

summary.en: Japan’s postwar constitution was promulgated on 3 November 1946 and came into force on 3 May 1947. Its text located sovereignty with the people, defined the emperor’s symbolic position and set out fundamental rights and parliamentary institutions. Article 9 renounced war as a sovereign means of settling international disputes. The National Diet Library’s documents also show deliberation and the practical steps required to bring the new order into operation, including elections and related legislation. The change took place within the postwar occupation, so constitutional commencement should not be confused with the later end of occupation. The two dates mark distinct stages in a consequential institutional transition.
summary.zh: 日本战后宪法于1946年11月3日公布，1947年5月3日生效。文本规定主权属于人民，界定天皇的象征地位，并确立基本权利与议会机构。第九条放弃以国家主权发动战争作为解决国际争端的手段。国立国会图书馆的文献还展示审议及新制度实际运作所需的步骤，包括选举和配套立法。这场变化发生于战后占领时期，因此宪法生效不能与后来占领结束混淆。两个日期标示这一重大制度转型的不同阶段。

dateNote.en: 3 November 1946 is promulgation; 3 May 1947 is entry into force. This interval records those stages, not the full period of drafting or postwar occupation.
dateNote.zh: 1946年11月3日为公布日，1947年5月3日为生效日。此区间记录这两个阶段，不是全部起草期或战后占领期。

en: Popular sovereignty and the emperor’s symbolic status are stated in the constitution.
Promulgation and entry into force occurred six months apart.
zh: 宪法明确规定人民主权与天皇的象征地位。
公布与生效相隔六个月。

sources.title: Constitution of Japan, November 3, 1946
sources.evidenceNote: Archival document commentary gives promulgation and the preceding Diet deliberations.

sources.title: Chronological Table, December 1946–June 1947
sources.evidenceNote: Records 3 May commencement, elections, related legislation and occupation-authority context.

sources.title: The Constitution of Japan
sources.publisher: National Diet Library, Japan; English text based on Government Printing Bureau edition
sources.evidenceNote: Primary text supports popular sovereignty, symbolic emperor, rights, parliamentary institutions and Article 9.

title.en: 1987: South Korea’s June democracy movement
title.zh: 1987年：韩国六月民主运动

location.label: Central Seoul; representative of protests across many South Korean cities

summary.en: In June 1987, a broad movement challenged authoritarian rule in South Korea and demanded constitutional change. Anger over the torture and death of student Park Jong-cheol, and the attempted concealment, helped mobilize protests across numerous cities. Students were joined by workers, office employees and other citizens. On 29 June, ruling-party leader Roh Tae-woo accepted demands for a constitutional change permitting direct presidential elections. The transition involved subsequent negotiation and approval, while workplace struggles continued through the summer. Presenting the movement as a sequence keeps civic action, political concessions and institutional change connected without treating one declaration as the completion of every democratic aspiration.
summary.zh: 1987年6月，韩国广泛社会运动挑战威权统治，要求修改宪制。学生朴钟哲遭刑讯致死及掩盖事件的行为激起愤怒，推动许多城市的抗议。工人、办公室职员与其他市民加入学生行列。6月29日，执政党领袖卢泰愚接受修宪并实行总统直接选举的要求。转型随后经过谈判和批准，劳工斗争则在夏季继续。将运动作为一连串过程呈现，能够联系公民行动、政治让步与制度改变，同时避免把一份声明当成所有民主诉求的完成。

dateNote.en: 1987 marks the protest and constitutional-transition year, especially the June mobilization and 29 June declaration. The Seoul pin represents a nationwide movement.
dateNote.zh: 1987年标示抗议及宪政转型之年，重点为六月动员和6月29日声明。首尔点位代表全国性运动。

en: The June mobilization spread beyond universities to workers and other urban citizens.
Direct presidential elections were a central demand accepted in the 29 June declaration.
zh: 六月动员超出大学范围，工人及其他城市居民广泛参与。
总统直选是核心诉求之一，并获6月29日声明接受。

sources.title: 6·10 Movements
sources.evidenceNote: Archive exhibition documents the torture-death trigger, multi-city protests, broad participation and continuing workers’ mobilization.

sources.title: Votes and Voices: The Advance toward Democracy in Korea
sources.publisher: National Museum of Korean Contemporary History
sources.evidenceNote: Documents the demand for direct presidential elections, Roh’s 29 June concession and subsequent constitutional approval; later present-tense evaluations are not reused.

title.en: Nok: farmers and terracotta makers
title.zh: 诺克：农耕生活与陶塑技艺

location.label: Central Nigeria; regional reference near Nok, not a single workshop

summary.en: Communities in central Nigeria made remarkable terracotta figures during a period that archaeologists associate with the Nok tradition. Farmers grew pearl millet, while sculptors modeled people, animals and composite beings with elaborate hair, jewelry and distinctive eyes. Archaeological research places the wider culture earlier than its best-known sculpture: the development of farming settlements and the emergence of figurative art are different stages. The objects offer evidence of technical skill and shared visual conventions, but their precise functions and the identities of the people represented remain uncertain. Similarities with later African sculpture do not by themselves establish an uninterrupted line of descent.
summary.zh: 尼日利亚中部的社区在考古学所称的诺克文化时期制作了出色的陶塑。农民种植珍珠粟，雕塑者塑造人物、动物及复合形象，以复杂发式、饰物和鲜明的眼部造型表现其特征。考古研究表明，诺克文化的起源早于最著名的雕塑，因此农业聚落的发展与人物陶塑的出现属于不同阶段。这些作品体现了技艺和共同的视觉传统，但具体用途与所表现人物的身份仍有不确定性。它们与后世非洲雕塑的相似之处，不能单独证明一条从未中断的传承关系。

dateNote.en: Approximate flourishing of figurative terracotta, c. 900–400 BCE; the wider Nok culture began earlier, around 1500 BCE. The pin represents central Nigeria, not a documented workshop or political boundary.
dateNote.zh: 约公元前900—400年指人物陶塑的兴盛阶段；更广泛的诺克文化约起源于公元前1500年。点位代表尼日利亚中部，不是已确定的作坊或政治疆界。

sources.title: Nok research project enters final phase
sources.evidenceNote: Direct research-institution article describes Nigerian–German fieldwork, culture from c. 1500 BCE, pearl-millet farming and the Middle Nok phase c. 900–400 BCE.

sources.title: Arts of Africa: Inside the Exhibition — Nok
sources.evidenceNote: Museum interpretation describes figurative forms and features, and places the decline of the Nok tradition around 400 BCE; functions are not treated as certain.

en: Nok farming settlements predate the best-known terracotta figures.
Sculptures preserve visual traditions, while many ritual meanings remain uncertain.
zh: 诺克农耕聚落早于最著名的陶塑作品。
陶塑保存了视觉传统，但许多仪式含义仍不明确。

title.en: Djenné-Djeno: a city in the inland Niger delta
title.zh: 杰内杰诺：尼日尔河内陆三角洲的城市

location.label: Djenné-Djeno archaeological mound, Mali; representative site point

summary.en: Djenné-Djeno reveals a long urban history in the inland Niger delta before the better-known trading town of Djenné reached prominence. Excavated layers preserve changing domestic, craft and burial spaces, allowing archaeologists to reconstruct a settlement through everyday material evidence. The older mound and the present town are separate places with overlapping histories, not two names for an unchanged city. Pottery sequences and sediment cores indicate that occupation of the older settlement declined after about 1200 and ended around 1400. Archaeological dating remains approximate, and the relationship between this decline and the growth of nearby Djenné is an interpretation tested through continuing fieldwork.
summary.zh: 杰内杰诺表明，在后来著名的贸易城镇杰内兴起之前，尼日尔河内陆三角洲已经拥有悠久的城市生活。发掘地层保存了不断变化的居住、手工业和墓葬空间，使考古学家能够从日常物质遗存重建聚落历史。旧遗址丘与今日杰内是历史相互交叠的两个地点，并非同一座始终未变的城市的不同名称。陶器序列与钻探资料显示，旧聚落约在1200年以后衰落，至1400年前后停止居住。年代仍是近似判断，旧城衰落与附近杰内发展的联系也属于有待持续考古检验的解释。

dateNote.en: Approximate archaeological span. UNESCO gives settlement from c. 250 BCE; the cited excavation report uses c. 200 BCE–1400 CE for Djenné-Djeno. These rounded estimates differ; neither implies an exact founding year.
dateNote.zh: 此为近似考古时段。联合国教科文组织将定居起点置于约公元前250年；所引发掘报告使用约公元前200年至公元1400年。这些取整估计有所不同，都不是精确建城年份。

sources.title: Old Towns of Djenné
sources.evidenceNote: Institutional heritage synthesis dates regional settlement to c. 250 BCE and distinguishes the present town and archaeological sites.

sources.title: Results of recent excavations at Jenné-jeno and Djenné, Mali
sources.publisher: Susan Keech McIntosh and Roderick McIntosh / Rice University
sources.evidenceNote: Primary archaeological research report gives c. 200 BCE–1400 CE occupation, decline after c. 1200, pottery/core methods and limits on interpreting links with modern Djenné.

en: The archaeological mound is distinct from the present town of Djenné.
Pottery and core samples help separate different occupation phases.
zh: 考古遗址丘与今日杰内城镇是不同地点。
陶器与钻探样本帮助区分不同居住阶段。

title.en: Aksum: royal conversion and Christian coinage
title.zh: 阿克苏姆：王室改宗与基督教钱币

summary.en: Christianity became associated with Aksumite kingship during the fourth century, under King Ezana. Coins provide material evidence: royal issues replaced earlier celestial symbols with the cross. Accounts of the missionary Frumentius help explain the conversion, but these written church traditions and the surviving objects are different kinds of evidence. Aksum already participated in Red Sea exchange through routes connecting its highland center with the port of Adulis. The court’s adoption of a religion therefore belonged to an interconnected African political world. Royal conversion did not mean that every subject immediately became Christian; the wider development of Christian institutions continued across later generations.
summary.zh: 四世纪埃扎纳国王统治期间，基督教开始与阿克苏姆王权结合。钱币提供了实物证据：王室铸币以十字架取代较早的天体符号。关于传教者弗鲁门提乌斯的记述有助于解释改宗，但教会文字传统与现存器物属于不同种类的证据。阿克苏姆早已通过连接高地中心和阿杜利斯港的道路参与红海交流，因此王室采纳新宗教发生在相互联系的非洲政治世界中。国王改宗并不意味着所有臣民立即成为基督徒；基督教制度的广泛发展还经历了后续许多代人。

dateNote.en: The fourth-century window represents an event whose exact year is uncertain, not a century-long conversion ceremony. Ezana’s reign is approximately dated. The pin marks Aksum, not the full kingdom.
dateNote.zh: 四世纪的时间窗口表示确切年份尚不确定，并非改宗仪式持续百年。埃扎纳的在位年代也为近似估计。点位标示阿克苏姆城，不代表整个王国。

sources.title: Foundations of Aksumite Civilization and Its Christian Legacy
sources.evidenceNote: Museum synthesis links Ezana, fourth-century Christian coin imagery and earlier Red Sea commerce; distinguishes initial elite conversion from later expansion.

sources.title: African Christianity in Ethiopia
sources.evidenceNote: Institutional interpretation compares the Frumentius church tradition with coin evidence and places conversion in the fourth century.

en: Coin symbols give material evidence for a change in royal religious identity.
Court conversion and wider Christianization unfolded on different timescales.
zh: 钱币图案为王室宗教身份变化提供了实物证据。
王室改宗与社会更广泛的基督教化有不同的时间进程。

title.en: Mapungubwe: farming, trade and a hilltop court
title.zh: 马蓬古布韦：农业、贸易与山顶王廷

location.label: Mapungubwe Hill, South Africa; representative settlement point

summary.en: At Mapungubwe, settlement layout makes social hierarchy visible: an elite occupied the hilltop while other residents lived below. Gold objects from high-status graves and imported goods connect political authority with long-distance trade reaching the Indian Ocean. That exchange rested on a regional economy of cultivation, livestock and metalworking, developed through earlier communities around the Limpopo floodplain. Archaeologists reconstruct these relationships from buildings, burials, seeds, animal bones and manufactured objects. The kingdom’s history belongs to southern Africa’s own changing societies and commercial networks. The site helps explain developments preceding Great Zimbabwe, without making every settlement in the region part of one uniform state.
summary.zh: 马蓬古布韦的聚落布局清楚呈现了社会等级：精英居于山顶，其他居民生活在山下。高等级墓葬中的金器和外来物品，将政治权力与通往印度洋的远距离贸易联系起来。这种交流依托林波波河泛滥平原周边较早社区发展出的种植、畜牧和金属加工经济。考古学家通过建筑、墓葬、种子、动物骨骼和制成品重建这些关系。王国历史属于南部非洲自身不断变化的社会与商业网络，也有助于理解大津巴布韦之前的发展，但不能因此把区域内所有聚落都归入一个统一国家。

dateNote.en: Approximate Mapungubwe hill phase, c. 1220–1300, following earlier regional settlements. These dates do not describe every site in the wider cultural landscape; the pin is on the South African side of the Limpopo region.
dateNote.zh: 约1220—1300年指马蓬古布韦山聚落阶段，之前已有较早的区域聚落。这一时段不适用于整个文化景观中的每处遗址；点位位于林波波地区的南非一侧。

sources.title: Natural & Cultural History — Mapungubwe National Park
sources.evidenceNote: Site authority dates the hill phase to 1220–1300 and describes social separation, gold graves, Indian Ocean trade and earlier farming/metalworking communities.

sources.title: Mapungubwe Cultural Landscape
sources.evidenceNote: Institutional landscape assessment places Mapungubwe within regional social change and long-distance trade; it is not a modern national boundary map.

en: Hilltop and lower settlements indicate unequal social positions.
Indian Ocean exchange depended on local farming and craft production.
zh: 山顶与山下聚落反映了不同社会地位。
印度洋交流依托当地农业与手工业生产。

title.en: Ife: sculpting sacred authority
title.zh: 伊费：以雕塑表现神圣权威

summary.en: Artists at Ife produced striking clay and cast-metal figures during a major flowering of the Yoruba city. Carefully modeled faces and elaborate crowns coexist with more stylized forms, showing that naturalism was one choice within a varied artistic language. The works are often connected with sacred kingship, yet specific portraits and original uses cannot always be identified. Archaeology also reveals paved spaces and a much longer settlement history, placing royal art within an urban environment. These achievements were made by African communities and workshops. Their resemblance to other artistic traditions is not evidence that outsiders created them, an assumption once advanced by European observers.
summary.zh: 约鲁巴城市伊费兴盛时期，艺术家制作了引人注目的陶塑和铸造金属人像。细致刻画的面容、华丽冠饰与更具程式化的形象并存，说明写实只是多样艺术语言中的一种选择。作品通常被联系到神圣王权，但具体人物身份与最初用途并不总能确定。考古发现的铺砌空间和更久远的聚落历史，也把王室艺术置于城市生活环境中。这些成就是非洲社区与作坊创造的。它们与其他艺术传统的相似，不能支持欧洲观察者曾提出的“由外来者制作”的假设。

dateNote.en: Approximate artistic flowering c. 1200–1500, within a city whose settlement history began much earlier. Individual clay and metal objects have narrower or uncertain dates. The point represents Ile-Ife, not a known workshop.
dateNote.zh: 约1200—1500年指艺术兴盛阶段，城市定居史远早于此。个别陶器和金属作品的年代可能更窄或尚不确定。点位代表伊费城，不是已确定的作坊。

sources.title: Ife (from ca. 6th century)
sources.evidenceNote: Museum synthesis describes the long urban history, artistic flowering around 1200–1500 and associations with sacred kingship.

sources.title: Western and Central Sudan, 1000–1400 A.D.
sources.evidenceNote: Museum chronology places pavements and sculpture in context and distinguishes stylistic variation from discredited external-origin explanations.

en: Naturalistic and stylized forms belong to the same varied artistic world.
Links to sacred kingship are stronger than identifications of particular portraits.
zh: 写实与程式化形式同属多样的艺术世界。
与神圣王权的联系，比具体肖像身份的判断更可靠。

title.en: Lalibela: churches carved into rock
title.zh: 拉利贝拉：从岩体中开凿的教堂

summary.en: At Lalibela, builders created churches by cutting downward into volcanic rock, leaving walls, columns and interiors as parts of the living stone. Trenches, passages and drainage works connect the religious buildings with an engineered landscape. The complex is traditionally associated with King Lalibela and the Zagwe dynasty, but the buildings need not all belong to a single construction campaign. Its organization evokes a sacred geography associated with Jerusalem while drawing on Ethiopian Christian traditions. The churches also became places of continuing worship and pilgrimage. Understanding their history requires distinguishing traditional royal attribution, architectural evidence and the later life of an active religious community.
summary.zh: 拉利贝拉的建造者向下开凿火山岩，使墙体、柱子与室内空间成为原生岩体的一部分。沟渠、通道和排水工程把宗教建筑连接成经过营造的整体景观。传统将教堂群与拉利贝拉国王及扎格维王朝联系起来，但所有建筑未必属于一次建造工程。布局借用了与耶路撒冷相关的神圣地理，也体现埃塞俄比亚基督教传统。教堂后来持续作为礼拜和朝圣场所。理解其历史，需要区分传统王室归属、建筑证据以及活跃宗教社区的后续生活。

dateNote.en: Broad twelfth–thirteenth-century construction context, not exact dates for all eleven churches. Traditional association with King Lalibela does not resolve every building phase. The pin marks the complex, not a territorial extent.
dateNote.zh: 这里采用十二至十三世纪的宽泛建造背景，并非十一座教堂各自的确切工期。与拉利贝拉国王的传统联系不能解决所有建筑分期问题。点位标示教堂群，不代表领土范围。

sources.title: Rock-Hewn Churches, Lalibela
sources.evidenceNote: Institutional heritage description documents eleven churches, rock-cut engineering and traditional association with King Lalibela; date descriptions span the twelfth and thirteenth centuries.

sources.title: Conservation of the Rock-Hewn Churches of Lalibela
sources.evidenceNote: Conservation history places the royal center in the twelfth–thirteenth centuries and gives a traditional reign of 1181–1221, used as context rather than an exact construction schedule.

en: Rock-cut churches form part of a network of passages and drainage works.
Traditional royal attribution and archaeological building phases are distinct evidence.
zh: 岩凿教堂与通道、排水设施共同构成建筑网络。
传统王室归属与考古建筑分期属于不同证据。

title.en: Mbanza Kongo: a court adopts Christianity
title.zh: 姆班扎刚果：王廷采纳基督教

location.label: Mbanza Kongo, Angola; representative royal capital

summary.en: King Nzinga a Nkuwu’s conversion in 1491 introduced Christianity into the politics and visual culture of the Kongo court. Portuguese missions brought clergy, devotional images and crosses, but Kongo rulers and artists interpreted these objects within their own understandings of authority. A military banner, for example, could be valued through existing ideas about protection and power. Later royal letters requested further religious objects, showing continuing diplomatic choices rather than a single completed transfer of culture. Mbanza Kongo’s sacred places and royal institutions also continued to shape the capital. Conversion should not be confused with Portuguese possession of an African kingdom.
summary.zh: 1491年恩津加·恩库武国王改宗，使基督教进入刚果王廷的政治与视觉文化。葡萄牙使团带来神职人员、宗教图像和十字架，但刚果统治者与艺术家依据自身对权威的理解来诠释这些物品。例如，军旗可能通过既有的护佑与力量观念而获得价值。后来的王室书信继续索取宗教用品，显示持续的外交选择，而不是一次完成的文化转移。姆班扎刚果原有的神圣场所和王室制度也继续塑造都城。改宗不应被等同于葡萄牙占有这个非洲王国。

dateNote.en: 1491 marks the king’s documented conversion and Portuguese mission. The adaptation of Christian forms continued over later centuries. The capital pin does not imply a boundary or colonial annexation.
dateNote.zh: 1491年标示有记载的国王改宗与葡萄牙使团活动。对基督教形式的本地化延续了数个世纪。都城点位不表示疆界或殖民吞并。

sources.title: Kongo Christian Art: Cross-Cultural Interaction in the Atlantic World
sources.evidenceNote: Curatorial interpretation cites the 1491 mission/conversion, exchange of devotional objects and Afonso I’s surviving 1517 letter; interpretations of the banner are explicitly qualified.

sources.title: Mbanza Kongo, Vestiges of the Capital of the former Kingdom of Kongo
sources.evidenceNote: Heritage assessment describes the longstanding capital, royal/sacred institutions and architectural changes following Portuguese contact.

en: Kongo rulers used religious objects within their own political and artistic worlds.
Royal conversion was not equivalent to Portuguese sovereignty.
zh: 刚果统治者在自身政治与艺术世界中运用宗教物品。
王室改宗不等于葡萄牙获得主权。

title.en: Gondar: a permanent royal capital
title.zh: 贡德尔：固定王都的形成

location.label: Fasil Ghebbi, Gondar, Ethiopia; representative royal enclosure

summary.en: Emperor Fasilides established a permanent capital at Gondar in 1636, creating a setting in which successive rulers added palaces and religious buildings. The royal enclosure known as Fasil Ghebbi therefore records more than one reign: its structures accumulated through a changing court society. Architecture combined Ethiopian building traditions with forms transmitted through wider regional contacts. Churches, courtly patronage and urban settlement made Gondar a center of religious and artistic activity over the following centuries. Dating the foundation helps distinguish the beginning of the capital from later construction. It also connects Ethiopian history beyond isolated monuments, linking royal institutions, craftsmen and the everyday life of a city.
summary.zh: 法西利德斯皇帝于1636年在贡德尔建立固定都城，后继统治者在此继续增建宫殿和宗教建筑。因此，法西尔盖比王宫围区记录的不只是一位君主的统治，而是建筑随着王廷社会变化不断累积的过程。建筑将埃塞俄比亚传统与更广泛区域交流传入的形式结合。教堂、宫廷赞助和城市定居使贡德尔在随后数世纪成为宗教与艺术中心。确定建都时间有助于区分都城起点与后续工程，也将埃塞俄比亚历史从孤立古迹延伸至王室制度、工匠和城市日常生活之间的联系。

dateNote.en: 1636 is the foundation of the permanent capital, not the completion date of the entire enclosure. The UNESCO property includes structures from successive seventeenth- and eighteenth-century reigns.
dateNote.zh: 1636年是固定都城的建立年份，不是整个王宫围区的竣工日期。世界遗产中的建筑来自十七至十八世纪多个连续统治时期。

sources.title: Restoration of the Fasil Ghebbi Monument, Gondar
sources.evidenceNote: Conservation history explicitly dates the permanent capital to 1636 and describes successive royal building complexes and artistic activity.

sources.title: Fasil Ghebbi, Gondar Region
sources.evidenceNote: Institutional architectural assessment describes the royal enclosure and Ethiopian, regional and imported architectural relationships; later structures are not backdated to the foundation.

en: Fasilides established Gondar as a permanent capital in 1636.
The royal enclosure grew through several reigns and building campaigns.
zh: 法西利德斯于1636年把贡德尔确立为固定都城。
王宫围区经历多个统治时期和营建阶段。

title.en: Abu Simbel: rebuilding monuments above the reservoir
title.zh: 阿布辛贝：在水库上方重建古迹

location.label: Relocated Abu Simbel temples, Egypt; representative modern site point

summary.en: The temples of Abu Simbel reopened in September 1968 after an international project cut them into numbered blocks and reassembled them above the rising waters associated with the Aswan High Dam. Engineers recreated the cliff setting while moving the monuments uphill and inland. The operation followed appeals by Egypt and Sudan and formed one part of a much wider campaign to safeguard Nubian monuments. It is a useful example of how twentieth-century infrastructure altered an ancient landscape and prompted new forms of international heritage cooperation. The date marks the relocated temples’ reopening, not their ancient construction or the completion of every Nubian rescue project.
summary.zh: 阿布辛贝神庙于1968年9月重新开放。此前的国际工程把神庙切割成编号石块，在高于阿斯旺高坝蓄水水位的地方重新组装，并重建崖壁环境，将古迹向高处和内陆迁移。这项行动响应埃及与苏丹的请求，是抢救努比亚古迹的大规模计划的一部分。它说明二十世纪基础设施如何改变古老景观，并推动新的国际遗产合作。这里的日期指搬迁后神庙重新开放，不是神庙在古代的建造时间，也不表示全部努比亚抢救工程已经完成。

dateNote.en: The relocated temples reopened on 22 September 1968. The broader Nubian campaign ran from 1960 to 1980, with other monuments moved on different schedules. The point marks the relocated site.
dateNote.zh: 搬迁后的神庙于1968年9月22日重新开放。更广泛的努比亚抢救行动持续于1960—1980年，其他古迹有各自的搬迁时间。点位标示重建后的地点。

sources.title: The story of Abu Simbel
sources.evidenceNote: Institutional project history documents the international appeal, engineering method, new site and reopening on 22 September 1968; distinguishes later Philae work.

sources.title: Nubian Monuments from Abu Simbel to Philae
sources.evidenceNote: Heritage synthesis relates the ancient monuments to the international safeguarding campaign of 1960–1980.

en: Numbered stone blocks allowed the temples to be dismantled and reassembled.
Abu Simbel was one project within a wider Nubian heritage campaign.
zh: 编号石块使拆解和重新组装神庙成为可能。
阿布辛贝只是更广泛的努比亚遗产抢救行动之一。

title.en: Caracalla extends Roman citizenship
title.zh: 卡拉卡拉扩大罗马公民权

location.label: Rome; imperial-capital reference, not the surviving papyrus findspot

summary.en: Emperor Caracalla’s Constitutio Antoniniana extended Roman citizenship across the empire’s free population, changing a legal distinction that had separated many provincial inhabitants from citizens. The measure reached people in Europe, Africa and Asia, while local communities could retain elements of their own legal traditions. A surviving Greek papyrus fragment is important evidence for the decree, although its damaged wording leaves questions about exceptions and interpretation. Citizenship in this imperial setting did not mean modern democratic participation, and enslaved people were not included as free citizens. The decree illustrates how a Mediterranean empire could reshape legal membership without erasing every local identity.
summary.zh: 卡拉卡拉皇帝颁布《安东尼努斯敕令》，把罗马公民权扩展到帝国的自由人口，改变了许多行省居民与公民之间的法律区分。措施影响欧洲、非洲和亚洲的人群，同时地方社区仍可保留部分自身法律传统。现存希腊文纸草残片是理解敕令的重要证据，但残损文字使例外条款和解释仍有争议。帝国时代的公民权不等于现代民主参与，被奴役者也未作为自由公民被纳入。敕令展示了地中海帝国如何重塑法律归属，而不抹去所有地方身份。

dateNote.en: UNESCO dates the decree to 212/213 CE; the interval preserves that uncertainty. Rome represents imperial authority. The surviving papyrus was found in Egypt and is held in Giessen, Germany.
dateNote.zh: 联合国教科文组织将敕令标为公元212或213年，此时间段保留该不确定性。罗马代表帝国权力中心；现存纸草出土于埃及，收藏于德国吉森。

sources.title: Constitutio Antoniniana
sources.evidenceNote: Institutional manuscript description dates the decree to 212/213 and describes empire-wide citizenship and continuing local legal rights.

sources.title: Constitutio Antoniniana — Memory of the World nomination
sources.publisher: Justus Liebig University Giessen / UNESCO Memory of the World
sources.evidenceNote: Manuscript nomination documents the surviving primary papyrus and its preservation; a modern description is distinguished from the fragmentary ancient text.

en: Citizenship expanded among free inhabitants across three continents.
The surviving papyrus is damaged, so some legal details remain debated.
zh: 公民权扩大到分布于三大洲的自由居民。
现存纸草已经残损，一些法律细节仍有争论。

title.en: Justinian’s legal compilation
title.zh: 查士丁尼的法律编纂

location.label: Constantinople, present-day Istanbul; representative imperial center

summary.en: Under Justinian, imperial officials assembled and reorganized Roman legal material into the compilation later known as the Corpus Juris Civilis. The work connected lawmaking with the emperor’s wider effort to strengthen government, taxation and authority. It was an intellectual and administrative project as well as an assertion of power: inherited texts had to be selected and arranged for use. Its later history was equally important, as medieval scholars studied, interpreted and taught the material. The compilation therefore links the ancient Roman legal world with later legal learning. Its promulgation should not be mistaken for proof that one identical legal practice immediately operated everywhere in the empire.
summary.zh: 查士丁尼统治下，帝国官员汇集并重新组织罗马法律材料，形成后来被称为《民法大全》的编纂成果。这项工作把立法与加强政府、税制和皇权的更广泛努力联系起来。它既是权力宣示，也是知识与行政工程：既有文本必须经过选择和整理，才能用于实践。其后续历史同样重要，中世纪学者对这些材料进行研究、解释和教学。因此，法律编纂把古罗马法律世界与后来的法学教育连接起来。但颁布法律不能被视为帝国各地立即实行完全相同法律实践的证明。

dateNote.en: 529–534 is the main compilation period identified by the Library of Congress. Later legislation and medieval reception extended beyond it. Constantinople is a center of production, not a map of uniform legal enforcement.
dateNote.zh: 529—534年是美国国会图书馆所列的主要编纂时段。后续立法和中世纪传播远超这一范围。君士坦丁堡代表编纂中心，不是法律统一执行范围的地图。

sources.title: Law Library Acquires Rare Medieval Law Manuscript
sources.evidenceNote: Library manuscript discussion dates the Corpus Juris Civilis to 529–534 and explains its later study by medieval jurists.

sources.title: The Byzantine State under Justinian I
sources.evidenceNote: Institutional synthesis places the legal codification within Justinian’s authoritarian government, taxation and territorial reorganization.

en: The compilation reorganized inherited Roman legal materials.
Medieval study gave the texts a long life beyond Justinian’s reign.
zh: 编纂工作重新组织了继承而来的罗马法律材料。
中世纪研究使这些文本的影响远远超出查士丁尼的统治时期。

title.en: Hagia Sophia: rebuilding Constantinople
title.zh: 圣索菲亚：重建君士坦丁堡

location.label: Hagia Sophia, Istanbul; representative monument point

summary.en: After the Nika uprising destroyed an earlier cathedral in 532, Justinian commissioned a new Hagia Sophia. Anthemios of Tralles and Isidoros of Miletos designed a vast domed space that combined engineering ambition with imperial religious ceremony. The building was inaugurated in December 537, but its physical form did not stop changing: the original dome collapsed in 558 and was subsequently rebuilt. Decorations and later alterations belong to several different periods. Reading the monument through these layers makes it more useful than treating it as a single untouched masterpiece. It shows how destruction, technical experimentation, patronage and worship shaped the capital’s urban landscape.
summary.zh: 532年尼卡起义焚毁较早的主教座堂后，查士丁尼下令兴建新的圣索菲亚教堂。特拉勒斯的安泰米乌斯和米利都的伊西多鲁斯设计了宏大的穹顶空间，将工程追求与帝国宗教仪式结合。建筑于537年12月启用，但形态并未就此固定：原穹顶在558年坍塌，随后重建。装饰与后续改建也来自多个时期。通过这些历史层次理解古迹，比把它看作一座始终未变的杰作更有帮助；它展示了破坏、技术试验、赞助和礼拜如何共同塑造都城景观。

dateNote.en: 532–537 marks Justinian’s main rebuilding campaign; inauguration was 27 December 537. The surviving monument includes the later dome and many subsequent changes, so not every visible element dates to this interval.
dateNote.zh: 532—537年标示查士丁尼的主要重建工程，启用日期为537年12月27日。现存建筑包含后来重建的穹顶和许多后续变化，并非所有可见部分都出自此时段。

sources.title: Hagia Sophia (532–37)
sources.evidenceNote: Curatorial architectural history gives the commission, architects, inauguration and collapse/rebuilding of the original dome.

sources.title: Historic Areas of Istanbul
sources.evidenceNote: Heritage assessment places Hagia Sophia in Constantinople’s architectural and urban history rather than treating all surviving fabric as one phase.

en: The building followed destruction during the Nika uprising.
The original dome was replaced after its collapse in 558.
zh: 教堂兴建于尼卡起义造成破坏之后。
原穹顶在558年坍塌后被重新建造。

title.en: Aachen: building a Carolingian imperial center
title.zh: 亚琛：营建加洛林帝国中心

location.label: Palatine Chapel, Aachen, Germany; representative monument point

summary.en: Charlemagne’s palace chapel at Aachen turned imperial ambition into a physical setting for worship and rule. Its octagonal plan, monumental arches and imported marbles connected a northern European court with prestigious Roman and Byzantine building traditions. The chapel belonged to a wider cultural program that encouraged books, more legible handwriting and religious art. These activities involved craftsmen, clerics and the movement of materials as well as the ruler himself. Charlemagne was buried there in 814, giving the building a further dynastic role. The surviving cathedral accumulated later additions, so its present appearance should be read as a long architectural history surrounding a Carolingian core.
summary.zh: 查理曼在亚琛修建的宫廷礼拜堂，把帝国雄心转化为礼拜与统治的实体空间。八角平面、宏大拱券和外运而来的大理石，将北欧王廷与享有威望的罗马及拜占庭建筑传统联系起来。礼拜堂属于更广泛的文化计划，涉及书籍、更清晰的书写方式和宗教艺术。这些活动依赖工匠、教士与材料流通，而不只是君主个人。查理曼于814年葬于此处，又赋予建筑王朝纪念意义。现存主教座堂累积了后来增建，因此今天的外观应被理解为围绕加洛林核心持续发展的建筑史。

dateNote.en: 793–813 follows UNESCO’s construction span for the Palatine Chapel; other short descriptions use rounded dates around 800. Later cathedral additions are outside this interval. The pin marks Aachen’s chapel.
dateNote.zh: 793—813年采用联合国教科文组织所列的宫廷礼拜堂工期；另一些简述使用800年前后的取整年代。后来主教座堂的增建不在此时段内。点位标示亚琛礼拜堂。

sources.title: Aachen Cathedral
sources.evidenceNote: Outstanding Universal Value text gives 793–813 for the Palatine Chapel and distinguishes the Carolingian core from later additions.

sources.title: Carolingian Art
sources.evidenceNote: Museum interpretation describes the octagonal chapel, marbles from Rome and Ravenna, and its relationship with manuscript and artistic reform.

en: The chapel deliberately recalled Roman and Byzantine monumental architecture.
Its Carolingian core sits within a cathedral enlarged in later centuries.
zh: 礼拜堂有意借鉴罗马与拜占庭的宏大建筑传统。
加洛林时期核心被保存在后来不断扩建的主教座堂中。

title.en: Domesday: recording land, obligations and wealth
title.zh: 末日审判调查：记录土地、义务与财富

location.label: Dunwich, Suffolk; representative community recorded in Little Domesday

summary.en: William I’s survey collected information about landholding and resources after the Norman conquest of England. Entries compare ownership and value at different moments, making the record useful for studying both political change and agricultural society. Little Domesday preserves especially detailed material for parts of eastern England, including Dunwich in Suffolk. Such records can reveal mills, livestock, tenants and obligations, but they were produced for royal administrative purposes rather than to describe every person’s life equally. Domesday is therefore a powerful but selective source. It must be interpreted through the questions officials asked, the categories they used and the places the surviving books actually cover.
summary.zh: 诺曼征服英格兰后，威廉一世的调查汇集了土地占有与资源资料。条目比较不同时点的所有权和价值，因此既可用于研究政治变化，也可研究农业社会。《小末日审判书》保存了英格兰东部部分地区尤其详细的材料，包括萨福克的邓尼奇。记录能够呈现磨坊、牲畜、佃户与义务，但其编制服务于王室行政，并非平等描述每个人的生活。因此它是一份有力但具有选择性的史料，必须结合官员提出的问题、采用的分类以及现存文书实际覆盖的地点加以解释。

dateNote.en: 1086 is the survey year, not the date of every situation described: entries also refer back to earlier ownership and values. Dunwich is a representative recorded community, not the place where the entire survey was compiled.
dateNote.zh: 1086年是调查年份，不是每项记载所描述状态的日期；条目也追溯较早的所有权和价值。邓尼奇代表一个被记录的社区，不是整项调查的编纂地点。

sources.title: Domesday Book education resource pack
sources.evidenceNote: Archive educational guide explains the 1086 survey and its administrative context; fictional classroom role-play passages were not used as historical evidence.

sources.title: Latin palaeography activities and documents — Little Domesday
sources.evidenceNote: Archive teaching edition reproduces and contextualizes a primary Little Domesday entry for Dunwich, supporting the local example and record categories.

en: The books compare landholding and resources across different dates.
An administrative record is not a complete census of individual lives.
zh: 文书比较不同日期的土地占有和资源状况。
行政记录并不是个人生活的完整人口普查。

title.en: Norman Sicily: shared skills in royal buildings
title.zh: 诺曼西西里：王室建筑中的技艺交流

location.label: Palermo, Sicily; representative center of a multi-site architectural group

summary.en: The Norman kingdom of Sicily supported buildings that brought Latin Christian, Byzantine and Islamic artistic languages into close contact. At Palermo and nearby religious centers, mosaics, architectural forms and decorative craftsmanship reveal a court able to draw on different communities and traditions. The Palatine Chapel is especially useful for studying how royal authority was expressed through this combination of skills. The surviving monuments belong to a particular twelfth-century political setting, not to an abstract culture without conflict. Architectural exchange demonstrates collaboration and adaptation, but does not by itself prove equal social status or uninterrupted religious tolerance for everyone living under Norman rule.
summary.zh: 诺曼西西里王国营建的建筑，使拉丁基督教、拜占庭和伊斯兰艺术语言密切接触。巴勒莫及附近宗教中心的镶嵌画、建筑形式和装饰工艺，显示王廷能够吸收不同社区与传统的技艺。宫廷礼拜堂尤其有助于研究王权如何通过这种结合得到表现。现存古迹属于特定的十二世纪政治环境，而不是一个没有冲突的抽象文化。建筑交流能够证明合作与改造，却不能仅凭自身就证明诺曼统治下所有居民拥有平等地位，或宗教宽容从未中断。

dateNote.en: 1130–1194 is UNESCO’s Norman-kingdom frame for the architectural group. Individual buildings have different construction and alteration dates. Palermo represents a group also including Cefalù and Monreale.
dateNote.zh: 1130—1194年是联合国教科文组织用于建筑群的诺曼王国时段。各建筑的建造和改建日期并不相同。巴勒莫代表还包括切法卢与蒙雷阿莱的建筑群。

sources.title: Arab-Norman Palermo and the Cathedral Churches of Cefalú and Monreale
sources.evidenceNote: Heritage assessment gives 1130–1194 and describes nine monuments and the interaction of architectural traditions.

sources.title: Italian Peninsula, 1000–1400 A.D.
sources.evidenceNote: Museum chronology connects Roger II and later Norman rulers with the Palatine Chapel, royal buildings and Monreale mosaics.

en: Royal buildings combined Latin Christian, Byzantine and Islamic visual traditions.
Shared craftsmanship does not alone establish social or religious equality.
zh: 王室建筑结合拉丁基督教、拜占庭和伊斯兰视觉传统。
共同工艺本身不足以证明社会或宗教平等。

title.en: Lübeck: merchants across the Baltic
title.zh: 吕贝克：跨越波罗的海的商人

summary.en: Lübeck became a leading center of Hanseatic commerce, linking Baltic and North Sea towns through merchant networks. Warehouses, churches and large merchants’ houses record wealth, while small alley dwellings and courtyards preserve a different scale of urban life. Comparing Lübeck with Visby on Gotland reveals how trade connected distinct ports rather than producing one continuous territorial state. Commercial organization depended on ships, storage, credit, local institutions and people who worked outside the richest households. The medieval city’s surviving fabric therefore allows the history of exchange to be read alongside social difference. Its prominence changed over time; the Hanseatic world was neither fixed nor identical to later national borders.
summary.zh: 吕贝克成为汉萨商业的重要中心，通过商人网络连接波罗的海与北海城镇。仓库、教堂和大型商宅记录了财富，小巷住宅与庭院则保存了另一种尺度的城市生活。将吕贝克与哥特兰岛的维斯比比较，可以看到贸易如何连接不同港口，而不是形成一个连续领土国家。商业组织依赖船只、储存、信用、地方制度，以及不属于最富裕家庭的劳动者。因而现存中世纪城市肌理使交流史能够与社会差异一同被阅读。城市地位随时间变化，汉萨世界既非固定不变，也不等同于后来的国界。

dateNote.en: 1230–1535 follows UNESCO’s period of Lübeck’s principal Hanseatic role, not the full lifespan of the city or every Hanseatic institution. The point marks one port within a wider network.
dateNote.zh: 1230—1535年采用联合国教科文组织所列吕贝克居于汉萨核心地位的时段，并非城市或所有汉萨机构的完整存在期。点位标示广泛网络中的一个港口。

sources.title: Hanseatic City of Lübeck
sources.evidenceNote: Institutional urban assessment dates the leading Hanseatic role to 1230–1535 and contrasts merchants’ districts with smaller dwellings and courtyards.

sources.title: Hanseatic Town of Visby
sources.evidenceNote: Comparative port evidence describes medieval Baltic commerce and surviving warehouses, illustrating a network of cities rather than a single country.

en: The Hanseatic world linked separate towns across maritime routes.
Merchant houses and modest alley dwellings preserve different urban experiences.
zh: 汉萨世界通过海路连接不同城镇。
商宅与简朴巷居保存了不同的城市生活经验。

title.en: The Royal Society: making experiments public
title.zh: 皇家学会：共同记录与讨论实验

location.label: London, near the original Gresham College site; representative meeting location

summary.en: A group meeting after Christopher Wren’s lecture at Gresham College in November 1660 developed into the Royal Society, which received its first royal charter in 1662. Meeting minutes show a practical culture of demonstrations, observations and debate, ranging from air pressure to instruments and everyday materials. The members drew on earlier academies and exchanged information beyond London. Their records make it possible to study unsuccessful experiments and changing standards of evidence alongside celebrated discoveries. This was one institution within a wider history of knowledge, with membership shaped by contemporary social inequalities. Its foundation did not mean that reliable science began suddenly in one country.
summary.zh: 1660年11月，克里斯托弗·雷恩在格雷沙姆学院演讲后的一次聚会，逐渐发展为皇家学会，并于1662年获得首份王室特许状。会议记录呈现了演示、观察和讨论的实践文化，内容涵盖气压、仪器与日常材料。成员借鉴较早的学术组织，并与伦敦以外的人交流信息。这些记录使人们能够在著名发现之外，研究失败的实验与不断变化的证据标准。皇家学会只是更广泛知识史中的一个机构，其成员构成受到当时社会不平等的影响。它的成立不意味着可靠科学突然在某一国家开始。

dateNote.en: The first meeting was 28 November 1660; the first charter followed in 1662. The window represents institutional formation, not the dates of every later experiment. The pin approximates the original Gresham College location.
dateNote.zh: 首次聚会发生于1660年11月28日，首份特许状颁于1662年。此时段表示机构形成，不是每项后续实验的日期。点位近似标示原格雷沙姆学院所在地。

sources.title: History of the Royal Society
sources.evidenceNote: Institutional history gives the November 1660 meeting, the 1662 charter and the early experimental and correspondence culture.

sources.title: On this day — the first Journal Book
sources.evidenceNote: Archive curator discusses primary meeting minutes, explicitly distinguishes 28 November 1660 from the later anniversary tradition and describes the founders’ debt to other academies.

en: Meeting minutes preserve experiments, debate and changing procedures.
The founders drew on earlier academies and wider correspondence networks.
zh: 会议记录保存了实验、争论和程序变化。
创办者借鉴较早学术组织，并依赖更广泛的通信网络。

title.en: British emancipation: law, compensation and apprenticeship
title.zh: 英国殖民地解放：法律、赔偿与学徒制

location.label: Westminster, London; legislative reference, not the Caribbean communities affected

summary.en: Parliament’s 1833 Slavery Abolition Act began a staged legal transition in much of Britain’s colonial empire. In the British Caribbean, formal emancipation in 1834 was commonly followed by compulsory apprenticeship, which kept many formerly enslaved people working for their former enslavers. The state arranged compensation for slaveholders, not equivalent restitution to the people they had enslaved. Parliamentary debate in 1838 records pressure to end the coercive system, and apprenticeship ended that year. The sequence separates legislation from lived freedom and makes clear why a single abolition date can mislead. It also belongs to a broader Atlantic history of resistance, abolition campaigns and unequal labor arrangements.
summary.zh: 英国议会1833年的《废除奴隶制法》在殖民帝国大部分地区启动了分阶段的法律转变。在英属加勒比，1834年的形式解放之后，许多获得解放的人仍被强制纳入学徒制，为原奴隶主劳动。国家为奴隶主安排赔偿，而未向曾被奴役者提供对等补偿。1838年的议会辩论记录了终止这种强制制度的压力，学徒制也在当年结束。这一过程区分了法律颁布与实际自由，说明为何单一的废奴年份容易误导。它同时属于更广泛的大西洋反抗、废奴运动和不平等劳动安排的历史。

dateNote.en: 1833 is the Act; 1 August 1834 marks formal Caribbean emancipation, followed in many colonies by apprenticeship until 1 August 1838. Exceptions and local implementation varied. Westminster is the legislative reference point.
dateNote.zh: 1833年为法律通过；1834年8月1日标示加勒比地区形式解放，许多殖民地的学徒制持续至1838年8月1日。例外情况与地方实施并不一致。威斯敏斯特代表立法地点。

sources.title: The West Indian colonies and emancipation
sources.evidenceNote: Institutional history identifies the 1833 Act, planter compensation, 1834 emancipation and 1838 end of apprenticeship; local exceptions are not collapsed into a single date.

sources.title: Slavery Abolition Act — House of Commons debate, 6 April 1838
sources.evidenceNote: Primary parliamentary debate documents arguments over ending apprenticeship, including conditions in Jamaica; speakers’ claims are treated as debate evidence, not neutral observation.

en: The Act, formal emancipation and the end of apprenticeship were separate stages.
Compensation went to slaveholders rather than the people they had enslaved.
zh: 法律通过、形式解放与学徒制终结是不同阶段。
赔偿付给奴隶主，而不是曾被他们奴役的人。

title.en: L’Anse aux Meadows: wood cut in 1021
title.zh: 兰塞奥兹牧草地：1021年的木材证据

location.label: L’Anse aux Meadows, Newfoundland; representative archaeological site point

summary.en: Wood from the Norse site at L’Anse aux Meadows provides a precise anchor within a broader archaeological history. Researchers identified a distinctive radiocarbon signal caused by a cosmic-ray event and counted the subsequent tree rings, dating the cutting of studied pieces to 1021. That result establishes activity in this year; it does not identify the first arrival or the full duration of occupation. Turf-and-timber structures and other remains place the wood within a Norse settlement context. Indigenous peoples had already lived in the region for millennia. The evidence concerns one episode of transatlantic travel, not the beginning of human history in the Americas.
summary.zh: 兰塞奥兹牧草地诺斯人遗址的木材，为更广泛的考古历史提供了精确时间锚点。研究者识别出宇宙射线事件造成的特殊放射性碳信号，再计算其后的树轮，将所研究木材的砍伐时间确定为1021年。这证明当年存在活动，却不能确定首次到达时间或整个居住期。草皮与木结构建筑及其他遗存，将这些木材置于诺斯人聚落环境中。原住民此前已在这一地区生活数千年。证据涉及一次跨大西洋活动，并不是美洲人类历史的起点。

dateNote.en: 1021 is a scientifically dated wood-cutting year, not an exact settlement-foundation date. The study uses the 993 radiocarbon event as a tree-ring marker. The pin marks the archaeological site.
dateNote.zh: 1021年是科学测定的木材砍伐年份，不是精确的聚落创建日期。研究以993年的放射性碳事件作为树轮标记。点位标示考古遗址。

sources.title: Evidence for European presence in the Americas in AD 1021
sources.publisher: Kuitems et al., Nature / University of Groningen repository
sources.evidenceNote: Primary research article uses the 993 radiocarbon event and tree rings to date wood cutting to 1021; it is an activity anchor rather than a full occupation chronology.

sources.title: History and culture — L’Anse aux Meadows
sources.evidenceNote: Site authority describes Norse turf-and-timber remains, excavation history and Indigenous occupation thousands of years earlier.

en: Tree rings and a radiocarbon marker date studied wood to 1021.
This does not establish the first arrival or erase earlier Indigenous histories.
zh: 树轮与放射性碳标记将所研究木材定年至1021年。
这一结果不确定首次到达时间，也不抹去更早的原住民历史。

title.en: Mesa Verde: living in cliff-side villages
title.zh: 梅萨维德：崖壁村落中的生活

location.label: Mesa Verde, Colorado; representative cliff-dwelling area

summary.en: Ancestral Pueblo communities built many of Mesa Verde’s cliff dwellings during the late twelfth and thirteenth centuries, after a much longer history of farming and settlement on the mesa. Houses, storage rooms and shared ceremonial spaces reveal households organizing food, work and community life in a demanding environment. The villages are therefore a particular phase of an ongoing history, not the whole story of the people who lived there. Residents later moved to other places and formed new communities; Pueblo peoples did not disappear when these buildings ceased to be occupied. Archaeological evidence and living descendant communities together challenge the old image of a mysterious vanished civilization.
summary.zh: 在台地已有漫长农耕与聚落历史之后，祖先普韦布洛社区于十二世纪末至十三世纪修建了梅萨维德许多崖居。住宅、储藏室和共同仪式空间，呈现家庭如何在条件严峻的环境中组织食物、劳动和社区生活。因此，这些村落是持续历史中的一个阶段，而不是当地人民的全部故事。居民后来迁往其他地方，形成新的社区；建筑停止居住，并不表示普韦布洛人消失。考古证据与仍然存在的后裔社区共同纠正了“神秘文明突然消失”的旧叙述。

dateNote.en: Rounded c. 1190–1280 window for the cliff-dwelling phase; NPS describes building from the late 1190s to the late 1270s. Mesa Verde’s earlier settlement history is much longer. The pin represents a group of villages.
dateNote.zh: 约1190—1280年为崖居阶段的取整时段；美国国家公园管理局将营建置于1190年代末至1270年代末。梅萨维德更早的定居史长得多。点位代表一组村落。

sources.title: Mesa Verde National Park
sources.evidenceNote: Institutional site history distinguishes early farming, later cliff construction and living tribal connections; dates the main cliff phase to late 1190s–late 1270s.

sources.title: Mesa Verde National Park
sources.evidenceNote: Heritage assessment describes the settlement ensemble, cliff architecture and cultural landscape; the specific cliff-phase dates follow NPS rather than a rounded general description.

en: Cliff dwellings followed earlier farming and settlement on the mesa.
Migration from the villages did not end Pueblo history or identity.
zh: 崖居出现于台地较早的农耕与定居之后。
离开村落的迁徙并未终结普韦布洛历史或身份。

title.en: Québec: settlement through Indigenous alliances
title.zh: 魁北克：原住民联盟中的殖民定居

location.label: Québec City, Canada; representative early French settlement

summary.en: Samuel de Champlain established a French base at Québec in 1608 within an already inhabited and politically connected Indigenous world. The settlement depended on exchange and alliances involving Innu, Algonquin and Wendat communities, whose knowledge and networks shaped access to the interior. In 1609 Champlain joined allies in conflict with Haudenosaunee forces, making the costs of partnership as important as commercial opportunity. Québec’s later fortifications and institutions grew from this colonial foothold, but the old city visible today was built over many periods. Its foundation is best understood through the relationships that sustained it, not as Europeans creating history on an empty landscape.
summary.zh: 1608年，塞缪尔·德·尚普兰在魁北克建立法国据点时，这里已经属于有人居住、具有政治联系的原住民世界。定居点依赖与因努、阿尔冈昆和温达特社区的交流及联盟；这些群体的知识与网络影响着通往内陆的道路。1609年，尚普兰随盟友参与对豪德诺索尼势力的战斗，说明结盟的代价与商业机会同样重要。后来的魁北克防御设施和制度从这一殖民据点发展而来，但今天的古城由多个时期营建。其起源应通过维持它的社会关系来理解，而不是把欧洲人描述为在空白土地上开创历史。

dateNote.en: 1608 marks the settlement; 1609 marks Champlain’s participation in an allied military expedition. These are connected steps, not the construction dates of all present Old Québec buildings.
dateNote.zh: 1608年标示定居点建立；1609年标示尚普兰参加盟军军事行动。这是相互联系的两个步骤，并非今日魁北克老城全部建筑的建造日期。

sources.title: Samuel de Champlain — a founding figure
sources.evidenceNote: Government historical interpretation dates the 1608 settlement and 1609 expedition, describing Indigenous intermediaries and alliances rather than an empty landscape.

sources.title: Historic District of Old Québec
sources.evidenceNote: Urban heritage assessment connects Champlain’s settlement with the later development of upper/lower town, institutions and fortifications.

en: The French base depended on Indigenous commercial and political networks.
Alliances could bring military obligations as well as trading opportunities.
zh: 法国据点依赖原住民商业与政治网络。
联盟既带来贸易机会，也可能带来军事义务。

title.en: The Royal Proclamation and the Niagara negotiations
title.zh: 皇家宣言与尼亚加拉谈判

location.label: Fort Niagara area; representative 1764 negotiation site, not the proclamation’s place of issue

summary.en: Britain’s Royal Proclamation of 1763 claimed authority to regulate colonial expansion while reserving certain lands for Indigenous peoples and restricting private land purchases. Its language must be read as a Crown document with imperial purposes, rather than a neutral account of Indigenous sovereignty. Negotiations at Niagara in 1764 involved diplomacy, renewed alliances and specific agreements, including an agreement with the Seneca concerning land near the Niagara River. Putting the documents beside the negotiations shows that colonial policy did not operate through proclamations alone. Different parties brought their own political interests and understandings, and a legal text did not eliminate conflict over land or settlement.
summary.zh: 英国1763年《皇家宣言》一方面宣称有权管理殖民扩张，另一方面为原住民保留某些土地并限制私人购地。其措辞必须被视为具有帝国目的的王室文件，而不是关于原住民主权的中立叙述。1764年的尼亚加拉谈判涉及外交、恢复联盟和具体协议，其中包括与塞内卡人就尼亚加拉河附近土地达成的协议。把文件与谈判并列，可以看到殖民政策并非仅靠宣言运作。各方带着自身政治利益和理解参与，法律文本也没有消除围绕土地与定居的冲突。

dateNote.en: The proclamation was issued on 7 October 1763; Niagara negotiations followed in 1764. The pin represents the latter diplomatic setting, not London or every territory claimed in the proclamation.
dateNote.zh: 宣言于1763年10月7日发布，尼亚加拉谈判在1764年进行。点位代表后者的外交场景，不是伦敦，也不代表宣言声称涉及的全部领土。

sources.title: The Royal Proclamation of 1763
sources.publisher: Crown-Indigenous Relations and Northern Affairs Canada
sources.evidenceNote: Government page supplies the primary proclamation text; its Crown claims, purchase restrictions and reserved-land language are treated as the document’s position.

sources.title: Upper Canada Land Surrenders and the Williams Treaties (1764–1862/1923)
sources.publisher: Crown-Indigenous Relations and Northern Affairs Canada
sources.evidenceNote: Government historical account describes the Niagara conference and a specific Seneca agreement; it is an institutional interpretation, not a substitute for every Indigenous perspective.

en: The proclamation restricted private colonial purchases of Indigenous land.
Niagara diplomacy involved specific agreements beyond the printed proclamation.
zh: 宣言限制殖民者私人购买原住民土地。
尼亚加拉外交包含超出印刷宣言文本的具体协议。

title.en: The Declaration: adopting a claim to independence
title.zh: 《独立宣言》：通过独立主张

location.label: Independence Hall, Philadelphia; representative congressional meeting place

summary.en: The Continental Congress adopted the Declaration of Independence on 4 July 1776 after voting for independence two days earlier. The document announced separation from Britain, presented grievances against the king and justified political change through claims about rights and government. Most delegates signed the engrossed parchment on 2 August, so adoption and signing were not the same event. The text’s claims became resources for later movements demanding that political practice match professed principles. The declaration itself did not establish universal equality in the new states or abolish slavery. Reading its language alongside the circumstances of its production reveals both its influence and the limits of its immediate application.
summary.zh: 大陆会议在1776年7月2日表决支持独立后，于7月4日通过《独立宣言》。文件宣布与英国分离，列举对国王的不满，并以关于权利和政府的主张论证政治变化。多数代表在8月2日签署正式誊写的羊皮纸文本，因此通过与签署并非同一事件。宣言中的主张成为后来运动要求政治实践符合公开原则的思想资源。但宣言本身没有在新国家中建立普遍平等，也没有废除奴隶制。结合产生背景阅读其语言，能够同时理解它的影响及其即时实施的局限。

dateNote.en: Congress voted for independence on 2 July, adopted the declaration on 4 July, and most signatures followed on 2 August 1776. The record represents the document’s adoption, not the entire revolution.
dateNote.zh: 议会于1776年7月2日表决支持独立，7月4日通过宣言，多数签名在8月2日完成。此条目标示文件通过，而不是整场革命。

sources.title: Declaration of Independence (1776)
sources.evidenceNote: Archive supplies the primary text and distinguishes 4 July adoption from 2 August signing; the document’s rights language is distinguished from its practical implementation.

sources.title: The Declaration of Independence
sources.evidenceNote: Institutional historical account explains the drafting committee, 2 July independence resolution and 4 July approval.

en: The independence vote, declaration’s adoption and most signatures had different dates.
Rights claims became a language later reformers used to challenge exclusion.
zh: 独立表决、宣言通过和多数签署发生在不同日期。
权利主张成为后世改革者挑战排斥现象的语言。

title.en: Cherokee removal: detention, journeys and rebuilding
title.zh: 切罗基强制迁移：拘禁、迁途与重建

location.label: New Echota, Georgia; representative homeland point, not the entire removal route

summary.en: In 1838 U.S. forces detained Cherokee people and compelled their movement west, following a treaty signed by a minority that lacked authorization from the Cherokee national government. Removal proceeded through camps and multiple overland and water routes, with disease, exposure and deaths along the way. Describing the event simply as migration hides the coercion and the political opposition to it. Families carried knowledge, institutions and relationships into the communities they rebuilt in Indian Territory, while some Cherokee remained in the East. The history therefore includes both state violence and the continuity of a people, rather than ending with a line drawn across a map.
summary.zh: 1838年，美国军队拘禁切罗基人并迫使他们西迁，其依据是一份由未获切罗基民族政府授权的少数人签署的条约。迁移经过营地和多条陆路、水路，途中发生疾病、暴露于恶劣环境和死亡。仅把这一事件称为“迁徙”，会掩盖其中的强制性和政治反对。家庭将知识、制度和社会关系带到印第安领地重建的社区，也有部分切罗基人留在东部。因此，这段历史既涉及国家暴力，也涉及一个民族的延续，并不会随着地图上的一条路线而结束。

dateNote.en: 1838–1839 marks the principal forced-removal episode; earlier removals and later rebuilding fall outside the interval. The representative homeland pin does not depict all detention sites, routes or destinations.
dateNote.zh: 1838—1839年标示主要强制迁移阶段；更早迁移与后续重建不在此时段内。故土代表点不描绘全部拘禁地、路线或目的地。

sources.title: What Happened on the Trail of Tears?
sources.evidenceNote: Institutional account explains the unauthorized treaty minority, widespread opposition and coercive removal context.

sources.title: Transportation During the Cherokee Removal, 1837–1839
sources.evidenceNote: Historical study describes military detention, camps, overland/water transportation and the human consequences; no single precise death total is asserted.

en: The removal treaty was opposed by the Cherokee national leadership and many citizens.
Multiple routes and camps shaped experiences of forced displacement.
zh: 迁移条约受到切罗基民族领导层和许多成员反对。
多条路线与多个营地共同塑造了被迫流离的经历。

title.en: Seneca Falls: debating women’s rights
title.zh: 塞尼卡福尔斯：讨论妇女权利

location.label: Wesleyan Chapel, Seneca Falls, New York; representative convention site

summary.en: Participants at the Seneca Falls convention debated women’s social, civil and religious rights in July 1848. The Declaration of Sentiments adapted the language of the U.S. Declaration of Independence to criticize legal and political inequalities, including exclusion from voting. The published convention report preserves resolutions, signatures and discussion, showing an organized effort to make claims publicly reviewable. Elizabeth Cady Stanton, Lucretia Mott and other organizers worked within reform networks that overlapped with abolitionism; Frederick Douglass supported the suffrage demand. The gathering was an influential episode within a much longer and more diverse history of women’s activism, rather than the moment all women began to seek rights.
summary.zh: 1848年7月，塞尼卡福尔斯大会的参加者讨论妇女的社会、公民和宗教权利。《感伤宣言》借用美国《独立宣言》的语言，批评包括投票排斥在内的法律与政治不平等。公开发表的大会报告保存了决议、签名和讨论，显示参与者有组织地把主张置于公共审议之中。伊丽莎白·卡迪·斯坦顿、卢克丽霞·莫特等组织者活动于与废奴主义交叠的改革网络；弗雷德里克·道格拉斯支持妇女选举权要求。大会是更漫长、更多样的妇女行动史中的重要一环，而不是所有妇女从此才开始争取权利。

dateNote.en: The convention met on 19–20 July 1848. The record dates this particular gathering and its texts, not the beginning of women’s activism everywhere. The pin represents the Wesleyan Chapel.
dateNote.zh: 大会于1848年7月19—20日举行。此条目确定的是这次集会及其文本的时间，不是世界各地妇女行动的起点。点位代表卫斯理教堂。

sources.title: Report of the Woman’s Rights Convention, Seneca Falls, 1848
sources.evidenceNote: Archive transcription of the primary 1848 convention report supplies meeting dates, declarations, resolutions and proceedings.

sources.title: Declaration of Sentiments
sources.evidenceNote: Institutional interpretation explains drafting, reform networks and the document’s relationship with the Declaration of Independence.

en: The Declaration of Sentiments reworked the language of independence and equality.
The published report records a particular coalition, not all women’s experiences.
zh: 《感伤宣言》改写了独立与平等的政治语言。
大会报告记录一个特定联盟，并不代表所有妇女的经验。

title.en: The Canadian Pacific Railway: the last spike and its workers
title.zh: 加拿大太平洋铁路：最后一根道钉与劳动者

location.label: Craigellachie, British Columbia; representative last-spike ceremony site

summary.en: The last-spike ceremony at Craigellachie in November 1885 marked completion of the Canadian Pacific Railway’s transcontinental track. The railway fulfilled a major promise associated with British Columbia’s entry into Confederation and enabled the movement of people, goods and information. Its construction also depended on dangerous labor, including the work of Chinese migrants who faced discrimination and harsh conditions. Railway expansion crossed Indigenous lands and accompanied displacement. The famous ceremonial photograph does not show Chinese workers, illustrating how public images can conceal essential contributors. Studying the engineering achievement together with labor and land history gives a fuller account of how a national transport system was built.
summary.zh: 1885年11月在克雷盖拉奇举行的最后一根道钉仪式，标示加拿大太平洋铁路横贯大陆线路完成铺轨。铁路兑现了与不列颠哥伦比亚加入联邦相关的重要承诺，并推动人员、货物和信息流动。但建设也依赖危险劳动，其中包括面对歧视与恶劣条件的华人移工。铁路扩张穿越原住民土地，并伴随驱逐与流离。著名仪式照片中没有华工，说明公共图像可能遮蔽关键贡献者。把工程成就与劳动、土地历史一同研究，才能更完整地理解国家运输系统如何被建成。

dateNote.en: The ceremonial last spike was driven on 7 November 1885. This dates track completion, not the start of all subsequent passenger services. The pin marks Craigellachie, not the full route or the workers’ places of origin.
dateNote.zh: 最后一根道钉仪式于1885年11月7日举行。此日期指铺轨完成，不是所有后续客运服务的开行时间。点位标示克雷盖拉奇，不代表整条线路或工人的原乡。

sources.title: Last Spike — Treasures Revealed, Episode 16
sources.evidenceNote: Archive discussion of the primary photograph documents the date, Chinese laborers’ absence from the image, dangerous working conditions and Indigenous displacement.

sources.title: Discover Canada — Canada’s History
sources.evidenceNote: Institutional history connects the 1885 railway with British Columbia’s Confederation promise and acknowledges European and Chinese workers and anti-Chinese discrimination.

en: Track completion was celebrated at Craigellachie on 7 November 1885.
Labor exploitation and Indigenous dispossession formed part of the railway’s history.
zh: 1885年11月7日，克雷盖拉奇举行了铺轨完成庆典。
劳动剥削与原住民失地也是铁路历史的一部分。

title.en: Montgomery: organizing a bus boycott
title.zh: 蒙哥马利：组织公共汽车抵制运动

summary.en: After Rosa Parks’s arrest in December 1955, Black residents of Montgomery sustained a boycott of segregated city buses. The campaign grew from earlier organizing, including the Women’s Political Council, and relied on walkers, carpools, churches, fundraising and the Montgomery Improvement Association. Martin Luther King Jr. became a prominent spokesman, but the movement’s endurance depended on a much wider community. Legal action by women challenging bus segregation also proved crucial, with federal courts ruling against the system in 1956. The episode shows how everyday transport could become a field of political struggle, and how collective organization and litigation worked together to change public institutions.
summary.zh: 罗莎·帕克斯于1955年12月被捕后，蒙哥马利的黑人居民持续抵制实行种族隔离的市内公共汽车。运动建立在妇女政治委员会等组织此前的工作之上，依靠步行、拼车、教会、筹款和蒙哥马利改进协会维持。马丁·路德·金成为著名发言人，但运动能够坚持，有赖于更广泛的社区。妇女针对公共汽车隔离提出的诉讼同样关键，联邦法院于1956年裁定隔离制度违法。此事展示日常交通如何成为政治斗争场所，以及集体组织与诉讼如何协同改变公共机构。

dateNote.en: The boycott ran from 5 December 1955 to 20 December 1956; earlier organizing and arrests preceded it. The year interval includes the protest and legal outcome, not the entire civil rights movement.
dateNote.zh: 抵制从1955年12月5日持续至1956年12月20日，此前已有组织活动和逮捕事件。此时段包括抗议与法律结果，不是整个民权运动。

sources.title: Montgomery Bus Boycott
sources.publisher: The Martin Luther King, Jr. Research and Education Institute, Stanford University
sources.evidenceNote: University research synthesis dates the boycott, describes pre-existing Women’s Political Council organizing and relates protest to the federal court outcome.

sources.title: Montgomery Bus Boycott
sources.evidenceNote: Institutional account includes Claudette Colvin, Rosa Parks, organizers, residents and legal plaintiffs, supporting a collective rather than single-hero explanation.

en: The Women’s Political Council and local residents built essential organizing networks.
Community protest and a separate legal challenge both helped end bus segregation.
zh: 妇女政治委员会与当地居民建立了重要组织网络。
社区抗议与独立的法律挑战共同推动公共汽车隔离终结。

title.en: Monte Albán: shaping a Zapotec capital
title.zh: 蒙特阿尔班：营建萨波特克都城

location.label: Monte Albán, Oaxaca, Mexico; representative archaeological site point

summary.en: The builders of Monte Albán transformed a hilltop above the Oaxaca valleys into a monumental center with terraces, plazas, temples and a ball court. Over centuries the city became a major focus of Zapotec political life. Tombs, carved inscriptions and residential remains connect public authority with households, ancestors and ritual practices. Its engineered landscape shows that urban history includes the sustained labor of shaping ground and managing space, not just the names of rulers. Changes in the city’s political importance did not end Zapotec society. The archaeological site represents a long, internally varied urban history, with particular buildings and objects belonging to different phases.
summary.zh: 蒙特阿尔班的建造者把瓦哈卡谷地上方的山顶改造成拥有台地、广场、神庙和球场的纪念性中心。经过数世纪发展，城市成为萨波特克政治生活的重要核心。墓葬、雕刻铭文与居住遗存，将公共权力与家庭、祖先和仪式实践联系起来。经过大规模整治的景观说明，城市史也包括塑造地形和组织空间的持续劳动，而不只是统治者姓名。城市政治地位的变化没有终结萨波特克社会。遗址代表漫长且内部多样的城市历史，具体建筑和器物属于不同阶段。

dateNote.en: Approximate principal urban span c. 500 BCE–850 CE; institutional descriptions sometimes round the endpoint to 800. Individual buildings have separate chronologies, and later use of the site continued beyond political decline.
dateNote.zh: 主要城市阶段约为公元前500年至公元850年；一些机构简述将终点取整为800年。各建筑有不同年代，城市政治衰落后遗址仍有后续使用。

sources.title: Historic Centre of Oaxaca and Archaeological Site of Monte Albán
sources.evidenceNote: Institutional site assessment gives the major urban span around 500 BCE–850 CE and describes terraces, ceremonial buildings, ball court and tombs.

sources.title: The Tombs of Monte Albán
sources.publisher: Instituto Nacional de Antropología e Historia, Mexico
sources.evidenceNote: National archaeological authority describes the Zapotec capital, residential tombs, ancestor-related interpretations and the approximate end of its political prominence.

en: Terraces and leveled spaces turned a hilltop into a major urban center.
The decline of the capital did not mean the disappearance of Zapotec people.
zh: 台地与平整空间把山顶改造成重要城市中心。
都城衰落并不意味着萨波特克人消失。

title.en: Nasca and Palpa: drawing on the desert
title.zh: 纳斯卡与帕尔帕：在沙漠地表绘图

location.label: Nasca desert, Peru; regional reference within a much wider geoglyph landscape

summary.en: Communities on Peru’s southern coast created lines and large figures by altering the dark surface stones of the desert, exposing lighter material below. The landscape contains geometric designs as well as images of animals and plants, made over a long period rather than in one project. Archaeologists distinguish different traditions and phases, including Paracas and Nasca contexts. The labor and repeated use of this landscape suggest important social and ceremonial purposes, but no single explanation accounts securely for every design. Proposed relationships with ritual, movement and astronomical observation must be assessed as interpretations. The drawings are evidence of human landscape-making, with precise meanings that often remain debated.
summary.zh: 秘鲁南海岸的社区通过改变沙漠深色地表石层、露出下方较浅物质，制作线条和大型图形。景观中既有几何形，也有动植物形象，形成于漫长时期，而非一次工程。考古学家区分不同传统和阶段，包括帕拉卡斯与纳斯卡背景。营造劳动和反复使用显示其可能具有重要社会与仪式功能，但没有单一解释能够可靠涵盖所有图案。与仪式、行进和天文观察的可能联系，必须作为解释加以检验。这些图画证明人类塑造了景观，而具体意义往往仍有争议。

dateNote.en: Broad archaeological span c. 500 BCE–500 CE for the listed geoglyph tradition. Individual figures have different and sometimes uncertain dates. The representative desert pin does not locate every design.
dateNote.zh: 约公元前500年至公元500年为所列地画传统的宽泛考古时段。个别图形年代各异，有些尚不确定。沙漠代表点不标示每幅图案的位置。

sources.title: Lines and Geoglyphs of Nasca and Palpa
sources.evidenceNote: Heritage description dates the broad tradition c. 500 BCE–500 CE and describes geometric and figurative designs in a desert landscape.

sources.title: Nasca and Palpa — ICOMOS advisory evaluation
sources.evidenceNote: Archaeological advisory assessment describes surface techniques, different cultural phases and proposed functions; hypotheses are not presented as settled explanations.

en: Removing or rearranging dark surface stones exposed lighter desert ground.
The geoglyphs belong to multiple phases, with functions that remain debated.
zh: 移除或重新排列深色表层石块，可显露较浅的沙漠地面。
地画属于多个阶段，其功能仍有争论。

title.en: Palenque under Pakal: a royal building program
title.zh: 帕卡尔时期的帕伦克：王室营建

location.label: Palenque, Chiapas, Mexico; representative Maya royal center

summary.en: During K’inich Janaab’ Pakal’s long reign, Palenque became a major center of royal building and carved historical memory. The Temple of the Inscriptions linked a monumental structure with a royal tomb and a written account of dynastic history. Its completion continued under Pakal’s successor, so the monument should not be assigned entirely to one ruler’s lifetime. Archaeologists have also documented water channels beneath the funerary complex, adding engineering evidence to interpretations of its sacred setting. The city’s architecture, inscriptions and burial spaces allow different forms of evidence to be compared. They reveal a particular Maya court, not a single unified empire covering every Maya community.
summary.zh: 基尼奇·哈纳布·帕卡尔长期统治期间，帕伦克成为王室营建和雕刻历史记忆的重要中心。铭文神庙把纪念性建筑、王陵和王朝史文字记录结合。工程在帕卡尔继承者统治下继续完成，因此不能把整座古迹都归入一位统治者的生前。考古学家也在陵墓建筑群下方发现水道，为其神圣环境的解释补充了工程证据。城市建筑、铭文与墓葬空间使不同证据能够相互比较；它们呈现一个具体的玛雅王廷，而不是覆盖所有玛雅社区的单一统一帝国。

dateNote.en: 615–683 is Pakal’s reign, used to frame the building program. The Temple of the Inscriptions was completed under K’inich Kan Bahlam, whose reign followed in 683–702. The pin marks Palenque, not all Maya territories.
dateNote.zh: 615—683年为帕卡尔在位期，用于界定营建背景。铭文神庙在继任者基尼奇·坎·巴兰683—702年统治期间完成。点位标示帕伦克，不代表全部玛雅地区。

sources.title: Palenque — investigations beneath the Temple of the Inscriptions
sources.publisher: Instituto Nacional de Antropología e Historia, Mexico
sources.evidenceNote: National archaeological research account gives Pakal’s 615–683 reign, continuation under his successor and physical evidence of water channels; sacred associations remain interpretations.

sources.title: Pre-Hispanic City and National Park of Palenque
sources.evidenceNote: Institutional assessment describes the city’s architecture and sculptural reliefs within the wider Maya cultural setting.

en: Inscriptions, a royal tomb and monumental architecture reinforced dynastic memory.
Construction phases crossed the boundary between Pakal’s reign and his successor’s.
zh: 铭文、王陵与纪念性建筑共同强化王朝记忆。
营建阶段跨越帕卡尔与其继承者的统治时期。

title.en: The Dresden Maya Codex: calendars and the sky
title.zh: 德累斯顿玛雅抄本：历法与天空

location.label: Northern Yucatán, Mexico; approximate regional reference, not a proven manuscript workshop

summary.en: The manuscript known as the Dresden Maya Codex preserves a learned world in which calendars, astronomy, divination and ritual were closely connected. Its painted pages contain numerical tables associated with Venus, eclipse calculations and ceremonial cycles. The book’s material form also matters: a folded screen of prepared bark paper carried signs, numbers and figures across many pages. Its conventional dating around 1250 is approximate, and a northern Yucatán origin remains a scholarly proposal rather than a documented workshop address. Studying the manuscript as a working intellectual artifact reveals accumulated observation and calculation, while avoiding the mistake of treating every calendrical table as a prediction of a single future event.
summary.zh: 被称为德累斯顿玛雅抄本的手稿，保存了历法、天文、占卜与仪式紧密相连的知识世界。彩绘页面包含与金星相关的数表、食象计算和礼仪周期。书籍物质形式同样重要：处理过的树皮纸折成屏风式长册，承载文字、数字和图像。通常采用的约1250年定年仍是近似判断，北尤卡坦起源也属于学术推测，而不是已确认的作坊地址。把它视为实际使用的知识器物，可以看到观察与计算的累积，同时避免把每个历法表格都误解为对某个单一未来事件的预言。

dateNote.en: 1250 is a conventional approximate date, not a known year of copying. The manuscript may come from northern Yucatán; the pin is only a regional reference and does not claim a secure production site.
dateNote.zh: 1250年是惯用近似年代，不是已知的抄写年份。手稿可能来自北尤卡坦；点位仅作区域参照，不声称确定制作地点。

sources.title: The Dresden Maya Codex — collection guide
sources.publisher: Saxon State and University Library Dresden (SLUB)
sources.evidenceNote: Holding institution describes the bark-paper screenfold, astronomical and ritual contents, approximate date c. 1250 and possible northern Yucatán origin; outdated survival-count claims were excluded.

sources.title: The Dresden Maya Codex: Content
sources.publisher: Saxon State and University Library Dresden (SLUB)
sources.evidenceNote: Collection interpretation explains Venus, eclipse and calendrical tables; this is a scholarly description of a primary manuscript rather than a modern predictive reading.

en: Astronomical tables were embedded in ritual and calendrical knowledge.
The manuscript’s date and northern Yucatán origin remain approximate.
zh: 天文数表属于仪式与历法知识的一部分。
手稿年代与北尤卡坦起源仍是近似判断。

title.en: Tenochtitlan: siege, alliances and conquest
title.zh: 特诺奇蒂特兰：围城、联盟与征服

location.label: Historic center of Mexico City; representative Tenochtitlan-Tlatelolco siege area

summary.en: The defeat of Tenochtitlan in 1521 resulted from a coalition that included Spaniards and large numbers of Indigenous allies with their own aims. Tlaxcala, Texcoco and other communities were political actors, not simply an anonymous background to Hernán Cortés. Fighting, destruction and the capture of Cuauhtémoc transformed the Mexica capital and opened a new phase of colonial rule. Sources differ in how they narrate surrender, capture and the final days, so the event should not be reduced to one heroic account. Nor did the fall of the capital end all Indigenous resistance or erase the societies whose choices helped shape the conquest.
summary.zh: 1521年特诺奇蒂特兰战败，是由西班牙人与拥有自身目标的大量原住民盟友组成的联盟造成的。特拉斯卡拉、特斯科科等社区是政治行动者，而不是埃尔南·科尔特斯故事中无名的背景。战斗、破坏与夸乌特莫克被俘改变了墨西加都城，并开启殖民统治的新阶段。不同史料对投降、被俘和最后数日的叙述有所差异，因此不应把事件简化为单一英雄故事。都城陷落也没有终结全部原住民抵抗，更没有抹去那些通过自身选择影响征服进程的社会。
