dateNote.en: 1521 marks the siege’s culmination; Cuauhtémoc was captured on 13 August. Conquest and resistance extended beyond this city and year. The pin represents the historic capital, not the coalition’s territory.
dateNote.zh: 1521年标示围城的结局，夸乌特莫克于8月13日被俘。征服与抵抗超出这座城市及这一年份。点位代表历史都城，不是联盟疆域。

sources.title: 13 de agosto de 1521 — the final days of Tenochtitlan
sources.publisher: Universidad Nacional Autónoma de México, Noticonquista
sources.evidenceNote: University historical interpretation compares accounts of Cuauhtémoc’s capture and identifies several Indigenous allies; contested narrative details are not flattened into certainty.

sources.title: México 500: La fuerza indígena en la caída de Tenochtitlan
sources.publisher: UNAM, Dirección General de Divulgación de la Ciencia
sources.evidenceNote: University interview with INAH historian Clementina Battcock explains the decisive role and independent interests of Indigenous allies; uncertain troop totals were omitted.

en: Indigenous alliances were central to the defeat of the Mexica capital.
The city’s fall did not end Indigenous political agency or resistance.
zh: 原住民联盟对墨西加都城的战败至关重要。
都城陷落没有终结原住民的政治能动性或抵抗。

title.en: Potosí: silver, water and coerced labor
title.zh: 波托西：白银、水力与强制劳动

location.label: Potosí and Cerro Rico, Bolivia; representative mining-city point

summary.en: Silver mining around Cerro Rico transformed Potosí during the sixteenth century and connected the Andean highlands with a wider imperial economy. Production required more than the mine itself: reservoirs, channels and water-powered mills processed ore, while mercury supplied from Huancavelica helped extract silver. The city’s wealth depended in part on coerced Indigenous labor under the colonial mita, and its separated neighborhoods reflected profound inequality. Following this production chain makes trade history concrete, linking mountains, water engineering, labor obligations and overseas currency flows. The end of this display interval is only a guide to the initial expansion; mining and its social consequences continued long afterward.
summary.zh: 十六世纪，富山周边的白银开采改变了波托西，并把安第斯高地与更广泛的帝国经济连接起来。生产所需远不止矿井：水库、引水渠和水力磨坊用于处理矿石，从万卡韦利卡运来的汞则帮助提取白银。城市财富部分依赖殖民米塔制度下受强制征调的原住民劳动，分隔的街区也体现深刻不平等。追踪生产链可使贸易史变得具体，将山地、水利工程、劳动义务和海外货币流动连接。此展示时段的终点只是初期扩张的阅读界限；采矿及其社会后果此后仍长期延续。

dateNote.en: 1545–1600 frames the sixteenth-century expansion, beginning with the conventional date of the Cerro Rico silver discovery. 1600 is a rounded reading-window endpoint, not closure of the mines or end of the mita.
dateNote.zh: 1545—1600年界定十六世纪扩张阶段，起于富山发现白银的惯用年份。1600年只是取整的阅读窗口终点，不表示矿山关闭或米塔制结束。

sources.title: City of Potosí
sources.evidenceNote: Heritage assessment documents hydraulic processing, mercury amalgamation, forced mita labor, separated neighborhoods and silver flows to Spain; large historical population estimates were not repeated.

sources.title: Santa Bárbara mining complex — Peru’s Tentative List submission
sources.publisher: Permanent Delegation of Peru to UNESCO
sources.evidenceNote: State-authored nomination describes mercury supply from Huancavelica to Potosí and cites the 1545 silver date; this is Peru’s submission, not an independent UNESCO endorsement of every claim.

en: Water infrastructure and imported mercury linked Potosí to a wider production network.
Colonial silver wealth was intertwined with coerced Indigenous labor.
zh: 水利设施与外运汞把波托西连接到更广泛的生产网络。
殖民白银财富与原住民强制劳动相互交织。

title.en: Cartagena: a fortified port in the Atlantic world
title.zh: 卡塔赫纳：大西洋世界的设防港口

location.label: Cartagena de Indias, Colombia; representative historic port point

summary.en: Cartagena’s defenses grew as the Caribbean port became a strategic link in Spain’s colonial maritime system. Fortifications protected a sheltered bay, while streets, churches, houses and working neighborhoods developed within and around the defended city. This commercial history also includes the trafficking of enslaved Africans through the port into South America. Archives associated with the city preserve evidence of that trade and the treatment of enslaved people, complicating an account focused only on military architecture. The walls were extended and altered over several centuries. Reading port, defenses and documentary records together reveals how commerce, imperial competition and coerced movement shaped one urban landscape.
summary.zh: 卡塔赫纳成为西班牙殖民海运体系中的战略纽带时，其防御工程不断发展。防御设施保护着避风海湾，街道、教堂、住宅和劳动者街区则在设防城市内外形成。这段商业史也包括被奴役的非洲人经港口被运往南美洲。与城市相关的档案保存了这种贩运及被奴役者待遇的证据，使仅聚焦军事建筑的叙述更加复杂。城墙经历数世纪扩建和改造。把港口、防御设施与文献记录一同阅读，可以看到商业、帝国竞争和强制人口流动如何塑造同一城市景观。

dateNote.en: 1586–1700 frames the early development of the surviving defensive system. UNESCO dates major fortification work from 1586, with extensions continuing into the eighteenth century; 1700 is not a completion date.
dateNote.zh: 1586—1700年用于界定现存防御体系的早期发展。联合国教科文组织把主要工程起点置于1586年，其扩建延续到十八世纪；1700年不是竣工年份。

sources.title: Port, Fortresses and Group of Monuments, Cartagena
sources.evidenceNote: Institutional assessment describes the strategic port, defense system from 1586 and later extensions, together with urban neighborhoods.

sources.title: Cartagena — Periodic Reporting, Cycle 3, Section II
sources.publisher: Colombian World Heritage property authorities / UNESCO World Heritage Centre
sources.evidenceNote: State/property periodic report identifies the Negros y Esclavos archive and explicitly connects Cartagena with the trafficking of enslaved Africans to South American colonies.

en: Fortification construction and extension continued across several centuries.
The port’s history includes the forced transport of enslaved Africans.
zh: 防御设施的建造与扩建延续数世纪。
港口历史包括对被奴役非洲人的强制运输。

title.en: Mexico’s 1917 Constitution: social claims in law
title.zh: 墨西哥1917年宪法：把社会诉求写入法律

summary.en: The constitution published in February 1917 translated major demands of the Mexican Revolution into a new legal framework. Its provisions addressed secular education, land and natural resources, and labor, making social questions central to constitutional politics. The constituent assembly at Querétaro debated how a revolutionary state should define property, public authority and workers’ protections. The original printed text allows those commitments to be examined directly, while later interpretation explains the political struggle behind them. Constitutional promises did not automatically produce immediate land redistribution or equal working conditions. The document matters both as a statement of aspirations and as a framework contested and implemented through subsequent political action.
summary.zh: 1917年2月公布的宪法，将墨西哥革命中的重要要求转化为新的法律框架。条款涉及世俗教育、土地与自然资源以及劳动，使社会问题成为宪政政治的核心。克雷塔罗的制宪议会讨论革命国家应如何界定财产、公共权力和劳动者保护。原始印刷文本使这些承诺可以被直接检视，后来的解释则说明背后的政治斗争。宪法承诺不会自动带来即时土地再分配或平等劳动条件。文件既是愿望的表达，也是此后政治行动不断争论和实施的制度框架。

dateNote.en: The constitution was promulgated and published on 5 February 1917 following the Querétaro assembly. The record refers to the original document, not a claim that every provision was immediately implemented or remains unchanged.
dateNote.zh: 宪法在克雷塔罗会议后，于1917年2月5日颁布和公布。此条目指原始文件，并不声称所有条款立即实施，或此后从未修改。

sources.title: The Constitution of 1917 — The Mexican Revolution and the United States
sources.evidenceNote: Institutional exhibition explains the Querétaro convention and the social roles of Articles 3, 27 and 123; an erroneous article-count statement on the page was not repeated.

sources.title: Constitución Política de los Estados Unidos Mexicanos — original publication, 5 February 1917
sources.evidenceNote: Primary official-gazette facsimile of the constitution as originally published; distinguished from later amended versions and from actual implementation.

en: Articles on education, land and labor made social reform a constitutional issue.
The written guarantees and their later implementation are different histories.
zh: 有关教育、土地和劳动的条款使社会改革成为宪法议题。
书面保障与后来的实际实施属于不同历史过程。

title.en: Brasília: planning a new capital
title.zh: 巴西利亚：规划一座新都城

location.label: Brasília, Brazil; representative planned civic center

summary.en: Brazil built a new federal capital in its interior through an ambitious program of planning and construction in the late 1950s. Lúcio Costa’s urban plan organized circulation and civic functions, while Oscar Niemeyer designed prominent government buildings. Construction began in 1956, the planning competition selected Costa’s proposal in 1957, and federal institutions moved to Brasília in 1960. These distinct steps make clear that a capital is an administrative project as well as a collection of buildings. The celebrated monumental plan should not be mistaken for the whole city’s social history or for an empty landscape without previous inhabitants. Building and urban change continued after the inauguration.
summary.zh: 1950年代末，巴西通过雄心勃勃的规划与建设工程，在内陆营建新的联邦首都。卢西奥·科斯塔的城市规划组织交通和公共功能，奥斯卡·尼迈耶设计重要政府建筑。工程始于1956年，科斯塔方案于1957年规划竞赛中获选，联邦机构在1960年迁入巴西利亚。这些不同步骤说明，首都既是建筑集合，也是行政工程。著名的纪念性规划不能被等同于整座城市的社会史，也不能让人把当地想象成此前没有居民的空白景观。首都启用之后，建设和城市变化仍继续进行。

dateNote.en: 1956–1960 marks the initial construction and transfer-of-capital program. The design competition was in 1957; later monuments and urban districts were completed afterward. The point represents the planned civic center, not the entire Federal District.
dateNote.zh: 1956—1960年标示初期建设与迁都工程。设计竞赛在1957年举行，后续古迹性建筑和城区在此后继续完成。点位代表规划公共中心，不是整个联邦区。

sources.title: Brasilia
sources.evidenceNote: Institutional assessment dates the initial project to 1956–1960 and identifies Costa’s urban plan and Niemeyer’s architecture; its empty-land rhetoric is not adopted.

sources.title: Brasília historical timeline
sources.publisher: Government of the Federal District, Brazil — Atlas do Distrito Federal
sources.evidenceNote: Official timeline distinguishes construction in 1956, the 1957 plan competition, government transfer in 1960 and later building milestones.

en: Planning, construction and the transfer of federal institutions were separate steps.
The celebrated civic plan is one part of a much wider urban history.
zh: 规划、建设和联邦机构迁移是不同步骤。
著名公共中心规划只是更广泛城市史的一部分。
